neutral_en: At [ORGANIZATION_A], loans exceeding the single-borrower lending limit continued for a relatively long period. The actual debtors applied for loans using other people’s names, repeatedly provided joint and several guarantees, and in a considerable number of cases the addresses of the loan applicants and joint and several guarantors were recorded as the same location. At that time, [PERSON_A] was the chairman of the board of [ORGANIZATION_A], and [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] were identity guarantors. [ORGANIZATION_C] conducted a special inspection of [ORGANIZATION_A] from November 22, 1999, to November 27, 1999, sent [ORGANIZATION_A] a notice on December 23, 1999, containing the inspection results and requests for disciplinary action against the relevant officers and employees, and that notice was received by [ORGANIZATION_A] on December 27, 1999. [PERSON_F] actively participated in the illegal and improper loans by obtaining loans after the approval of the loan-handling employees and the credit committee or board of directors. A claim was raised that [PERSON_F]’s conduct created a risk that [ORGANIZATION_A] would suffer loss and that, because of that loss, a burden related to [PERSON_D]’s status as an identity guarantor would arise; however, there was no evidence that [ORGANIZATION_A] could be regarded as having recognized this. All loans related to the losses concerning [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] were extended before December 27, 1999. Although [PERSON_F] did not directly handle the illegal and improper loans, [PERSON_F] obtained loans after the approval of the loan-handling employees and the credit committee or board of directors.
neutral_ko: [ORGANIZATION_A]에서는 동일인 대출한도를 초과한 대출이 비교적 장기간 지속되었다. 실제 채무자들은 다른 사람의 명의를 빌려 대출을 신청했고, 반복적으로 연대보증을 섰으며, 대출신청인과 연대보증인의 주소가 같은 장소로 기재된 경우도 적지 않았다. [PERSON_A]는 당시 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 이사장이었고, [PERSON_B]와 [PERSON_C]는 신원보증인이었다. [ORGANIZATION_C]는 1999년 11월 22일부터 1999년 11월 27일까지 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 대한 특별검사를 실시했고, 1999년 12월 23일 검사 결과와 관련 임직원에 대한 징계 요구를 담은 통보서를 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 발송했으며, 그 통보서는 1999년 12월 27일 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 접수되었다. [PERSON_F]는 대출 담당직원과 여신위원회 또는 이사회의 승인을 거쳐 대출을 받음으로써 불법·부당 대출에 적극 가담했다. [PERSON_F]의 행위로 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 손해가 발생할 우려가 있었고, 그 손해로 인해 [PERSON_D]의 신원보증인 지위와 관련된 부담이 발생할 우려가 있었다는 주장이 제기되었으나, [ORGANIZATION_A]가 이를 인식했다고 볼 증거는 없었다. [PERSON_B]와 [PERSON_C]에 관한 손해와 관련된 대출은 모두 1999년 12월 27일 이전에 시행되었다. [PERSON_F]는 불법·부당 대출을 직접 담당하지 않았다는 사정이 있었지만, 대출 담당직원과 여신위원회 또는 이사회의 승인을 거쳐 대출을 받았다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] (aged 2 at the time) received treatment at [INSTITUTION_A] on 1998. 12. 11., the day after undergoing heart surgery. When the blood potassium concentration rises to 6.5–7 mmol/L or higher, the risk of cardiac arrest increases, and at 10 mmol/L or higher, it was generally a situation in which a heart attack would be induced. At around 01:46 on 1998. 12. 11., the blood potassium concentration was measured at 8.10 mmol/L; on retesting at around 01:51, it was measured at 5.59 mmol/L, and at around 03:28, at 4.28 mmol/L. Subsequently, it was measured at 17.56 mmol/L at around 07:16, 9.39 mmol/L at around 08:55, and 15.55 mmol/L at around 09:53, and normalized to 3.81 mmol/L at around 13:21. The medical staff at [INSTITUTION_A] decided to maintain [PERSON_A] in a sedated state, administered sedatives and muscle relaxants, and continuously monitored oxygen saturation, electrocardiography, and blood pressure. The MRI examination showed findings of overall brain damage in [PERSON_A] and suggested hypoxic brain injury caused by an overall reduction in the oxygen supplied to the brain rather than by vascular occlusion. There was an expert opinion that a decrease in arterial partial pressure of oxygen to 74 mmHg was difficult to regard as clinically significant hypoxia and that, based solely on the findings appearing in the medical records, it was difficult to explain [PERSON_A]'s brain injury. On the premise that [PERSON_A] actually had hyperkalemia, there was an allegation that, from around 01:51 to around 07:16 on 1998. 12. 11., delayed diagnosis and treatment of the hyperkalemia caused or worsened hypoxemia, leading to hypoxic brain injury.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A](당시 만 2세)는 심장수술을 받은 다음날인 1998. 12. 11. [INSTITUTION_A]에서 치료를 받았다. 혈중 칼륨농도가 6.5-7mmol/L 이상으로 올라가면 심정지가 초래될 위험성이 커지고, 10mmol/L 이상이면 일반적으로 심장마비가 유발될 상황이었다. 1998. 12. 11. 01:46경 혈중 칼륨농도는 8.10mmol/L로 측정되었고, 01:51경 재검사에서는 5.59mmol/L, 03:28경에는 4.28mmol/L로 측정되었다. 이후 07:16경에는 17.56mmol/L, 08:55경에는 9.39mmol/L, 09:53경에는 15.55mmol/L로 측정되었고, 13:21경에는 3.81mmol/L로 정상화되었다. [INSTITUTION_A] 의료진은 [PERSON_A]에게 진정상태를 유지하기로 하고 진정제와 근육이완제를 투여했으며, 산소포화도·심전도·혈압을 지속적으로 모니터했다. MRI 검사에서 [PERSON_A]의 뇌 전반이 손상된 소견이 나타났고, 혈관 폐색보다는 뇌로 공급되는 산소의 전반적 감소로 인한 저산소성 뇌손상을 시사하였다. 동맥혈산소분압 74㎜Hg로의 감소는 임상적으로 의미 있는 저산소증으로 보기 어렵고, 의무기록에 나타난 소견만으로는 [PERSON_A]의 뇌손상을 설명하기 어렵다는 감정 의견이 있었다. [PERSON_A]에게 실제로 고칼륨혈증이 있었다는 전제에서, 1998. 12. 11. 01:51경부터 07:16경까지 고칼륨혈증에 대한 진단과 치료가 지연되어 저산소혈증이 발생 또는 확대되고 저산소성 뇌손상으로 이어졌다는 주장이 있었다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a sixth-grade elementary-school student. Students associated with [PERSON_B] repeatedly assaulted and harassed [PERSON_A] at school over several months. The school was providing education aimed at preventing group harassment, and the students associated with [PERSON_B] had received that education. [PERSON_A] later developed symptoms including post-traumatic stress disorder and died by suicide. During a school trip, [PERSON_A] was also ostracized by other classmates, and on the day of the suicide [PERSON_A] had been scolded by a parent. After the assaults and harassment became known, [PERSON_D] and [PERSON_E] did not accept [PERSON_A]'s parents' request to separate [PERSON_A] from the students associated with [PERSON_B]; instead, they had those students prepare written apologies and obtained promises from their parents concerning treatment costs and prevention of recurrence. During a later school trip, [PERSON_D] and [PERSON_E] assigned a student who was friendly with [PERSON_A] to the same group.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 초등학교 6학년 학생이었다. [PERSON_B] 측 학생들은 수개월 동안 학교에서 [PERSON_A]에게 반복적으로 폭행과 괴롭힘을 가했다. 당시 학교에서는 집단 괴롭힘 예방교육이 실시되고 있었고 [PERSON_B] 측 학생들도 그 교육을 받았다. [PERSON_A]는 이후 외상 후 스트레스 장애 등의 증상을 겪다가 자살로 사망했다. 수학여행 중 [PERSON_A]는 다른 급우들에게 따돌림을 당했고, 자살 당일에는 부모에게 꾸중을 들은 사정도 있었다. 폭행과 괴롭힘이 알려진 뒤 [PERSON_D]와 [PERSON_E]는 [PERSON_A] 부모의 분리 요청을 받아들이지 않고 [PERSON_B] 측 학생들에게 사과문을 작성하게 하고 그 부모들로부터 치료비 부담과 재발 방지에 관한 약속을 받았다. 이후 수학여행에서 [PERSON_D]와 [PERSON_E]는 [PERSON_A]와 친분이 있는 학생을 같은 조에 배정했다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_GROUP_A] were confined at [INSTITUTION_A] or [INSTITUTION_B] at various times between about December 1988 and September 1998. Some described confinement without proper process, forced labor, and beatings or administration of sedatives when they refused the labor or protested. After [PERSON_A] left with family assistance on February 1, 1997, [PERSON_A] told the responsible official, [PERSON_B], on February 3 about unlawful confinement, forced labor, and beatings and requested corrective action. [PERSON_B] mentioned compensation or correction and sent [PERSON_A] away but did not inspect the facilities, question those involved, examine records, or take other follow-up action. That day facility employees assaulted [PERSON_A] and took [PERSON_A] back, and mistreatment including assaults on some confined people reportedly continued. [PERSON_GROUP_A] alleged physical and emotional harm from the operators' conduct and the supervising official's inaction.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was 12 years and 8 months old at the time of the incident and was living at [INSTITUTION_A] while training to become a professional soccer player. [PERSON_A] attended winter training in [LOCATION_A] from January 4 to January 27, 2007, rested for about four days, and then trained at [INSTITUTION_A]'s residential training facility from February 1 to February 13. About one week later, [PERSON_A] participated in another one-week winter training session in [LOCATION_B]. During that session, the players woke at about 6 a.m. and went to bed at about 10 p.m. each day and took part in morning and afternoon training or practice matches. About 48 players trained under two supervisors. [PERSON_A] died from acute cardiac death during training. A diagnosis and opinion from [INSTITUTION_B] described the acute cardiac death as related to stress or overwork, and the record did not identify an unusual cardiac constitution or pre-existing cardiac condition before the incident. Before [PERSON_A] was transported to [INSTITUTION_C], the supervisors at the scene did not perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 사고 당시 12세 8개월이었고 전문 축구선수 훈련을 위해 [INSTITUTION_A]에 들어가 생활하고 있었다. neutral_en: [PERSON_GROUP_A] owned land and a factory in [LOCATION_A], and [PERSON_B] carried out a land-filling project that raised the ground level of adjacent [PROPERTY_A]. After the land filling, the maximum amount of water that [LOCATION_A] could hold before [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory would flood was estimated to have decreased from 368,000 cubic meters to 67,000 cubic meters, and the cumulative rainfall threshold for flooding under ordinary soil conditions was estimated to have decreased from 352 millimeters to 172 millimeters. Before the project, [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory had not flooded when water levels reached 10.96 meters, 10.63 meters, 11.03 meters, and 10.8 meters. During [STORM_B] on September 13, 2003, however, the land and factory flooded when the highest water level was 7.64 meters and cumulative rainfall was about 179 millimeters. Flood damage occurred during [STORM_A] and [STORM_B]. The investigative materials described circumstances in which the raised ground level of [PROPERTY_A] restricted rainwater flowing away from [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory. After [STORM_B], [PERSON_A] reported to [INSTITUTION_A] that products such as washbasins and machinery such as kilns had been damaged by flooding. [PERSON_A] also alleged that flooding prevented operation of the factory from around September 2000 through around December 2006 and caused business losses.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 [LOCATION_A]에 토지와 공장을 보유하고 있었고, [PERSON_B]는 인접한 [PROPERTY_A]의 지반을 높이는 성토사업을 시행했다. 성토 뒤 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장이 침수되기 전 [LOCATION_A]가 저장할 수 있는 최대 수량은 368,000세제곱미터에서 67,000세제곱미터로 감소했고, 통상적인 토양 상태에서 침수가 시작될 수 있는 누적 강우량도 352밀리미터에서 172밀리미터로 감소한 것으로 조사되었다. 성토 전에는 수위가 10.96미터, 10.63미터, 11.03미터, 10.8미터에 이른 때에도 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장이 침수되지 않았지만, 2003년 9월 13일 [STORM_B] 때에는 최고 수위가 7.64미터이고 누적 강우량이 약 179밀리미터인 상태에서 토지와 공장이 침수되었다. [STORM_A]와 [STORM_B] 때 토지와 공장에 침수 피해가 발생했다. 조사자료에는 [PROPERTY_A]의 성토로 인해 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장에서 흘러나가는 빗물의 흐름이 제한된 사정이 기재되어 있었다. [STORM_B] 뒤 [PERSON_A]는 [INSTITUTION_A]에 세면대 제품과 가마 등 기계가 침수로 손상되었다고 신고했다. [PERSON_A]는 침수로 2000년 9월경부터 2006년 12월경까지 공장을 가동하지 못해 영업손실도 발생했다고 주장했다.

neutral_en: [INSTITUTION_A] comprehensively succeeded to the rights and obligations of [INSTITUTION_B]. [PERSON_B] was working at a three-story residential construction site under [PERSON_A]'s management and supervision. At about 18:00 on June 12, 1990, [PERSON_B] stepped on a projecting third-floor window while attempting to reach the roof as instructed by [PERSON_A]; because the window was not properly secured, [PERSON_B] fell to the ground together with the window. [PERSON_B] sustained spinal fractures and other injuries and received inpatient and outpatient treatment for 73 days after the accident. The total treatment cost was [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], of which [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] was borne by [INSTITUTION_B] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C] by the insured person. [INSTITUTION_B] paid its share of the treatment cost to [INSTITUTION_C] on October 2, 1990.
neutral_ko: [INSTITUTION_A]는 [INSTITUTION_B]의 권리와 의무를 포괄적으로 승계했다. [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]의 관리·감독 아래 3층 주택 신축공사 현장에서 일하고 있었다. 1990년 6월 12일 18시경 [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]의 지시에 따라 옥상으로 올라가기 위해 3층의 돌출된 창문을 밟았는데, 창문이 제대로 고정되어 있지 않아 창문과 함께 지상으로 추락했다. [PERSON_B]는 이 사고로 척주 골절 등의 상해를 입었고 사고 후 73일 동안 입원 및 통원치료를 받았다. 총 치료비는 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]였고, 그중 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]는 [INSTITUTION_B]가 부담했으며 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C]는 피보험자 본인이 부담했다. neutral_en: [ORGANIZATION_B] conducted external audits of [COMPANY_B]'s ninth- and tenth-period financial statements. [ORGANIZATION_B] neglected procedures for collecting and comparing and verifying sufficient and appropriate audit evidence, and issued an unqualified opinion in the audit report without discovering the fact that [COMPANY_B] had engaged in accounting fraud. [ORGANIZATION_A] purchased shares of [COMPANY_B] believing that the audit report representing [COMPANY_B]'s financial condition had been properly prepared and published and that the share price had been formed based on its contents. After the fact that [COMPANY_B] had engaged in accounting fraud became known, its share price fell. [COMPANY_A]'s side argued that the rise in the share price after the stock transfer plan between [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_C] was reported and disclosed, and the fall in the share price due to the so-called “dumping” after the fact that [COMPANY_B] had engaged in accounting fraud became known, were unrelated to false statements in the audit report.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A], born in 1986, had received care for congenital scoliosis found at age three and was admitted to [INSTITUTION_A] on November 8, 2004. The spinal curvature measured 66 degrees, and strength and sensation in both legs were normal. To prevent future neurological injury, clinicians operated from 7:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. on November 12, removing portions of vertebrae and discs and correcting the spine with rods. Immediately after surgery, [PERSON_A] completely lost strength and sensation in both legs. Clinicians performed two further operations on November 13 and 15 to find the cause but observed no active hematoma, bleeding, or spinal-cord compression. Some function returned, but permanent partial paralysis of both legs and bowel and bladder impairment remained; [PERSON_A] could not walk and required a wheelchair and twelve hours of adult assistance each day. Neural monitoring was used during the first operation, but [INSTITUTION_A] said part of the stored data had been damaged and could not be produced.

neutral_en: On April 1, 1996, [COMPANY_A] lent [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] to its affiliate [COMPANY_B] as a credit loan and, separately on the same day, lent [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] secured by 320,000 unlisted shares of its affiliate [COMPANY_C]. On April 29, 1996, [COMPANY_B] additionally borrowed [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_A] as a credit loan, and the total loan amount was [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]. [INSTITUTION_A] pointed out to [COMPANY_A] that the collateral value for the stock-collateralized loan was insufficient and that additional collateral was needed. [COMPANY_A] requested additional collateral from [COMPANY_B], but [COMPANY_B] did not provide additional collateral. Subsequently, the personnel in charge at [COMPANY_A] decided to convert [COMPANY_B]'s collateral-backed loan into a credit loan and requested related materials, but around March 31, 1997, [COMPANY_B] sent only an official letter requesting the conversion without submitting financial statements, audit reports, or other materials. [PERSON_E] conducted a corporate evaluation using only publicly available materials, without [COMPANY_B]'s financial statements and audit reports, and when the result was below the threshold score for a credit loan, reassessed it by assigning high scores to some items so that it became 52.32 points. Although [PERSON_A] knew of the indication that additional collateral should be obtained, [PERSON_A] signed the loan approval document and the committee resolution without separate verification, and [PERSON_B] also signed the committee resolution without separate verification. As a result, the stock-collateralized loan to [COMPANY_B] was converted into a credit loan. According to [COMPANY_B]'s audit report, at the time of the conversion to a credit loan, [COMPANY_B] had incurred losses in 1995 and 1996, and its comprehensive corporate evaluation score was at most 47.63 points. On January 20, 1998, [COMPANY_A] received repayment of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_B] out of the existing loan amount, but around November 5, 1998, [COMPANY_B] defaulted. After the stock-collateralized loan among [COMPANY_B]'s loans was converted into a credit loan, [COMPANY_B] defaulted, and the remaining loan amount, including the converted [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], was being repaid at an annual interest rate of 8.5% applicable to claims of financial institutions without collateral. Around December 1997, [COMPANY_A] established mortgages on 17 properties owned by [COMPANY_B] as collateral for the existing debt. When [COMPANY_B]'s tenant demanded the cancellation of the mortgages on the condition that the lease agreement be extended, an officer of [COMPANY_B] canceled the mortgages around July 22, 1998, using cancellation documents that had been kept in storage. To attract and maintain employee retirement reserve insurance contracts with [COMPANY_E] and [COMPANY_F], [PERSON_A] purchased and then sold beneficiary certificates issued by financial institutions. When [COMPANY_A] sold the beneficiary certificates purchased on September 4, 1996, on December 15, 1997, it incurred a loss of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], and it incurred losses of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C], respectively, from selling beneficiary certificates on February 2 and February 5, 1998. When [COMPANY_F] demanded that [COMPANY_A] cancel the insurance contract or provide a loan equal to twice the reserve, [COMPANY_A] sold the beneficiary certificates at a loss to resolve the liquidity shortage and respond to the refund request resulting from cancellation of the insurance contract.
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_A]는 1996년 4월 1일 계열사인 [COMPANY_B]에 신용대출로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]을 대출하면서, 같은 날 별도로 계열사인 [COMPANY_C]의 비상장주식 32만 주를 담보로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]을 대출하였다. [COMPANY_B]는 1996년 4월 29일 [COMPANY_A]로부터 신용대출로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]을 추가로 대출받았고, 전체 대출액은 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]이었다. [INSTITUTION_A]는 [COMPANY_A]에 주식담보부 대출의 담보가치가 부족하여 추가 담보가 필요하다고 지적하였다. [COMPANY_A]는 1998년 1월 20일 [COMPANY_B]로부터 기존 대출금 중 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]을 상환받았지만, [COMPANY_B]는 1998년 11월 5일경 부도가 났다. [COMPANY_B]의 임차인이 임대차계약 연장을 조건으로 근저당권 해지를 요구하자, [COMPANY_B]의 임원이 1998년 7월 22일경 보관 중이던 해지서류를 사용하여 근저당권을 해지하였다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_E]와 [COMPANY_F]에 대한 종업원퇴직적립보험계약을 유치하고 유지하기 위하여 금융기관이 발행한 수익증권을 매입한 뒤 매도하였다. [COMPANY_A]는 1996년 9월 4일 매입한 수익증권을 1997년 12월 15일 매도하면서 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]의 손실을 입었고, 1998년 2월 2일과 2월 5일 수익증권 매도로 각각 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] 및 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C]의 손실을 입었다. [COMPANY_F]가 [COMPANY_A]에 보험계약의 해지 또는 준비금의 2배에 해당하는 대출을 요구하자, [COMPANY_A]는 유동성 부족을 해소하고 보험계약 해지에 따른 환급요청에 대응하기 위하여 수익증권을 손실을 보면서 매도하였다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] is identified as the company that entered into a construction machinery lease agreement with [PERSON_A]. If the construction machinery lease agreement, in which [COMPANY_A] is the lessor and [COMPANY_B] is the lessee, includes the general conditions of the standard contract form as an attachment, [COMPANY_A]'s principal obligations include preventive maintenance, obtaining insurance, obtaining the operator's license, carrying out regular inspections for the normal operation of the construction machinery, and ensuring that the operator performs work under the direction and supervision of the lessee's site supervisor; [COMPANY_B]'s principal obligations include informing the operator, before work begins, of underground utilities and above-ground hazards at the work site and ensuring that the construction machinery can work safely and stably. Under the agreement, the operating hours of the construction machinery were set at 8 hours per day and 200 hours per month, and the accident report stated that the site working hours were from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. [PRODUCT_A] entered the site at around 6:00 a.m. on December 17, 2019, and the accident occurred at around 6:30 a.m. on the same day. At that time, [COMPANY_B] instructed work during the dark pre-dawn hours before sunrise in winter. The accident resulted in victims, and [COMPANY_B] paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] in insurance benefits to the victims. [PERSON_A] claimed that, while turning in accordance with the signaler's signal to unload the attachments needed to extend the crawler tracks in a dark and narrow space between buildings, the center of gravity shifted toward the rear and the machine collided with a building. neutral_en: Around 1998, [COMPANY_C] entered into a purchase-of-goods contract concerning [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_B], received delivery of [PRODUCT_A] from [COMPANY_B] on October 31, 2000, and began operation around March 29, 2001. Around 10:34 a.m. on April 1, 2011, [PRODUCT_C] among the 19-stage blades constituting the compressor of [PRODUCT_B] within [PRODUCT_A] fractured. The fracture damaged all of the compressor blades, and consequently damaged the turbine blades and the upper bearing pads, among other components. [COMPANY_C] suffered damage from this accident, and the amount of that damage was assessed at [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. On January 31, 2011, [COMPANY_A] entered into a comprehensive property insurance contract concerning [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_C] and paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] as insurance benefits for part of the accident damage. [COMPANY_A] claimed that [PRODUCT_C] had fine cracks from the time of manufacture. [ORGANIZATION_A] prepared the final accident-cause investigation report, and that report and witness testimony were presented as evidence supporting [COMPANY_A]’s claim concerning fine cracks. It is recorded that the investigation proceeded without [COMPANY_B]’s participation and that fragments of the fractured blade were lost. [COMPANY_A] claimed that an incomplete [PRODUCT_C] with a manufacturing defect, caused by fine cracks arising during the manufacturing process or the use of a material vulnerable to corrosion, caused the [PRODUCT_B] accident. [COMPANY_A] claimed that the [PRODUCT_B] accident occurred at 26,332 operating hours, within the maintenance interval of the notified 48,000 equivalent-base-load operating hours.

neutral_en: [ORGANIZATION_A] was the organization where [PERSON_A] worked and was responsible for employee health management. [PERSON_A] had direct supervisors and coworkers and had previously taken about nine months of leave roughly ten years before the incident. After returning to work on March 19, 1993, [PERSON_A] performed firefighting duties. Coworkers stated that [PERSON_A] generally worked without notable problems, apart from reporting headaches beginning about one month before the incident. On the day before the incident, [PERSON_A] suddenly told an outside employee giving a briefing at the fire station that the employee was trying to install a dangerous device. [PERSON_A]'s supervisors then checked the personnel record and learned of the earlier period of leave. [PERSON_A] was subsequently removed from night-duty and fire-response duties and allowed to rest in the waiting room. The next day, [PERSON_B] died as a result of violence by [PERSON_A]. The coworkers' accounts did not describe notable psychotic symptoms or violent behavior by [PERSON_A] between the return to work and the incident.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a minor, and [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] were the parents. [PERSON_C] was admitted to [INSTITUTION_A] around September 12, 2012, for induced labor. After receiving labor-inducing medication, [PERSON_C] experienced uterine contractions at three- to five-minute intervals around 21:00 on September 15, 2012, and gave birth to [PERSON_A] at around 23:03. At birth, [PERSON_A] had almost no crying or movement. The newborn records noted cephalohematoma, severe molding, rapid breathing at 60–70 breaths per minute, nostril flaring, chest retraction, oxygen saturation of 82%, and flaccidity of the limbs. Later examinations showed intraventricular hemorrhage, periventricular hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, and [PERSON_A] was diagnosed with perinatal asphyxia, respiratory distress syndrome, and cephalohematoma. [PERSON_A] currently has cerebral palsy, developmental disability, and limb spasticity associated with generalized cerebral atrophy and ischemic brain injury in both hemispheres and cannot independently perform activities other than holding up the head. No nursing or delivery records concerning the conditions of [PERSON_C] and the fetus were created for approximately 21:00 to 22:50 on September 15, 2012. Before delivery, no abnormal condition was recorded other than gestational thrombocytopenia in [PERSON_C].

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a party to a dispute involving [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], and [ORGANIZATION_A]. After confirming that a vacancy had arisen among the members of [ORGANIZATION_B] and that additional members could be recruited, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] arranged for [PERSON_A] to enter into a membership agreement. On April 28, 2006, in the presence of [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C], [PERSON_A] prepared a membership agreement and [COMPANY_A]'s memorandum of agreement performance through their intermediation. [COMPANY_A]'s memorandum of agreement performance included a statement that, if [PERSON_A] could not be registered as a member due to, among other things, not meeting the membership qualifications, [COMPANY_A] would register [PERSON_A] through an individual allocation so that there would be no problem with [PERSON_A] moving into [PROPERTY_A]. At the time of the intermediation, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] knew that [PERSON_A] did not have the membership qualifications, but they did not verify whether [COMPANY_A] had the authority or ability to have [PERSON_A] move into [PROPERTY_A] through an individual allocation or otherwise, nor did they explain the risk arising from its being impossible. [PERSON_A]'s contract stated “2002 year month day,” rather than the actual drafting date of April 28, 2006; [PERSON_A] paid the member contribution directly to [COMPANY_A] and paid the entire amount in a lump sum before the unit-number drawing. [PERSON_C] received [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] out of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_A] as an intermediation fee and prepared and delivered a written undertaking of responsibility stating that, if a contractual problem arose for [PERSON_A], [PERSON_C] would repay [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. Before and after entering into the contract with [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] continued to intermediate [COMPANY_A]'s contracts for recruiting additional members, and even on May 9, 2006, after the contract was entered into, they intermediated another person's contract for recruiting an additional member. If [COMPANY_A] entered into contracts after entering into the contract with [PERSON_A] while greatly exceeding the additional recruitment limit of 19 units, there was a high risk that it would become unable to perform the contract with [PERSON_A]. Of the eight people whose contracts [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] intermediated, four, including [PERSON_A], did not receive an apartment allocation and did not receive a refund of the principal they had paid to [COMPANY_A].

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a male approximately 22 years old and was enrolled at [INSTITUTION_B]. On February 18, 2011, at 20:22, [PERSON_A] first presented to the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A], complaining of headache, nausea, and vomiting, and the blood test results, vital signs, and pulse were all within the normal range. The medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] administered [PRODUCT_A], a medication for treating vomiting, to [PERSON_A], and at 21:43, [PERSON_A] was discharged home after the symptoms improved. On February 19, 2011, at 4:32, [PERSON_A] presented to the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A] for the second time, complaining of the same symptoms as during the first visit. The medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] took measures including additionally administering [PRODUCT_A] to [PERSON_A], having [PERSON_A] take deep breaths, and supplying oxygen; however, from 5:50, [PERSON_A] was unable to clearly express his wishes, complained of difficulty breathing and abdominal pain, and became pale. The medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] closely observed [PERSON_A]. At 7:45, emergency department physician on duty [PERSON_B] was informed that [PERSON_A] was in a comatose state, and at 7:55 performed a brain CT, then immediately took measures including transferring [PERSON_A] to the intensive care unit and conducting blood tests. It was presented that, although [PERSON_A]'s condition rapidly deteriorated about one hour after the second visit to [INSTITUTION_A], the nurse did not report [PERSON_A]'s condition to the doctor and took no action until [PERSON_A] lost consciousness. [PERSON_A] died. [PERSON_C], a professor of neurology, expressed the view that [PERSON_A] was presumed to have died as a series of symptoms associated with neuroleptic malignant syndrome progressed, including metabolic acidosis, increased myoglobin, and brain death due to cerebral edema. There was a claim that the medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] excessively administered [PRODUCT_A] to [PERSON_A] and that this caused neuroleptic malignant syndrome; however, an explanation was presented that it was difficult to regard the medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] as having excessively administered [PRODUCT_A] and that it could not be regarded as having violated the recommended dosing interval. In addition, an explanation was presented that, even if [PRODUCT_A] had been administered in excess of the maximum recommended daily amount for use, it was difficult to regard the symptoms that appeared in [PERSON_A] as having been caused by neuroleptic malignant syndrome resulting from an excessive administration of [PRODUCT_A].

neutral_en: On October 2, 2014, [PERSON_A] went to the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A] with lower-back pain. [PERSON_B] identified spinal-canal stenosis at lumbar levels 4-5 and a left-sided herniated disc on magnetic-resonance images and, after explaining that only symptom-relief treatment would be available during the holiday period, transferred [PERSON_A] to nearby [INSTITUTION_B]. The imaging report also recorded a substantial spinal epidural hematoma from thoracic level 12 to lumbar level 1 with at least moderate spinal-cord compression, but [PERSON_B]'s transfer document listed only the stenosis and herniated disc. [INSTITUTION_B]'s record likewise did not mention the hematoma. While receiving pain-control treatment, [PERSON_A] developed worse pain and leg paralysis on October 4. When [PERSON_A] returned to [INSTITUTION_A] on October 6, the bleeding extended from thoracic levels 9 through 12, and heavy bleeding associated with a blood-thinning medication occurred during surgery to remove the hematoma. [PERSON_A] was left with permanent lower-body paralysis and could no longer stand or walk. The parties disputed whether the hematoma was identified early enough for medication and coagulation checks and close monitoring, whether the receiving clinicians and the patient and family were adequately told about the hematoma and possible emergency surgery, and whether earlier surgery could have prevented the paralysis.

[INSTITUTION_B]의 기록에도 혈종은 기재되지 않았다. [PERSON_A]는 통증 조절 치료를 받다가 10월 4일 통증이 심해지고 다리 마비가 나타났다. 10월 6일 [INSTITUTION_A]로 돌아왔을 때 출혈은 흉추 9번부터 12번까지 확대되어 있었고, 혈종 제거수술 중 출혈성 약물과 관련된 대량 출혈도 발생하였다. 이후 [PERSON_A]는 서거나 걸을 수 없는 영구적인 하지마비 상태가 되었다. 혈종을 조기에 확인해 약물·응고상태를 검사하고 세밀히 관찰했는지, 전원받은 의료진과 환자·보호자에게 혈종과 응급수술 가능성을 충분히 알렸는지, 더 빠른 수술이 마비를 막을 수 있었는지가 다투어졌다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was admitted through the emergency room of [INSTITUTION_A] on January 14, 1998, due to severe dizziness and other symptoms. Based on the results of the medical history and visual examination of [PERSON_A], [PERSON_C] diagnosed cerebral infarction and administered an antiplatelet agent; the following day, an MRI showed multiple lacunar cerebral infarctions in the right cerebellum of [PERSON_A]. Based on [PERSON_A]'s symptoms and examination results, [PERSON_C] consulted with the supervising professor on January 17 and decided to conduct cerebral angiography to determine whether there was a cerebrovascular abnormality. For [PERSON_A]'s cerebral angiography, [PERSON_D] inserted a catheter into the right inguinal femoral artery and injected contrast medium with a syringe. While imaging the right vertebral artery, [PERSON_A] suddenly complained of a headache, so [PERSON_D] stopped the examination. [PERSON_A] lost consciousness, and a follow-up brain CT scan performed the same day confirmed infarctions in the brainstem and cerebellum. [PERSON_A] died on February 5, 1998, without regaining consciousness. The cause of [PERSON_A]'s death was cerebral infarction caused by a thrombus or atherosclerotic material in the body blocking the basilar artery; however, it was not established whether the pressure generated when [PERSON_D] administered the contrast medium caused the thrombus or other material to break off. At the time of the procedure, [PERSON_D] used a method of administering contrast medium little by little with a syringe, stopping the administration when a blood vessel appeared on the screen and continuing to administer contrast medium until it appeared when it was not clearly visible. At the time of admission, [PERSON_A] had lifestyle habits of obesity and excessive smoking and drinking, and the results of the examination and detailed tests confirmed severe cerebral infarction. Even if the symptoms of cerebral infarction temporarily improved with treatment, the possibility of recurrence was high. Before the procedure, [PERSON_C] did not provide [PERSON_A] with sufficient explanation.

[PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_A]의 증상과 검사 결과에 따라 1월 17일 지도교수와 상의하여 뇌혈관 이상 여부를 확인하기 위한 뇌혈관조영술 검사를 실시하기로 결정하였다. [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]의 뇌혈관조영술을 위해 우측 서혜부 대퇴동맥에 카테터를 삽입하고 주사기로 조영제를 투여하면서 우측추골동맥을 촬영하던 중 [PERSON_A]가 갑자기 두통을 호소하자 검사를 중단하였다. [PERSON_A]는 의식을 상실하였고, 같은 날 추적 뇌 CT에서 뇌간과 소뇌의 경색이 확인되었으며, 의식을 회복하지 못한 채 1998년 2월 5일 사망하였다. [PERSON_A]의 사망 원인은 체내의 혈전이나 동맥경화성 물질이 기저동맥을 막아 발생한 뇌경색이었으나, 혈전 등이 떨어져 나온 원인이 [PERSON_D]가 조영제를 투여할 때 발생한 압력 때문인지는 밝혀지지 않았다. [PERSON_D]는 시술 당시 주사기를 사용하여 조영제를 조금씩 투여하면서 화면에 혈관이 보이면 투여를 중단하고, 잘 보이지 않으면 보일 때까지 조영제를 투여하는 방법을 사용하였다. [PERSON_A]는 입원 당시 비만과 과도한 흡연·음주의 생활습관을 가지고 있었고, 진찰과 정밀검사 결과 중증의 뇌경색으로 확인되었다. 뇌경색은 치료로 증세가 일시적으로 호전되더라도 재발 가능성이 높았다. 시술 전에 [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_A]에게 설명을 충분히 하지 않았다.

neutral_en: On the evening of March 3, 2004, after drinking with friends, [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] and was stopped by personnel from [ORGANIZATION_B] at about 22:30. A breath test at about 22:43 measured a blood-alcohol concentration of 0.055%. [PERSON_A] immediately requested a blood test, but no approved blood-collection container was available at the location, so another officer went to obtain one. During the wait, the officer accompanied [PERSON_A] to [INSTITUTION_A] and prepared identification records and a statement. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] with [PERSON_B] aboard. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] had children, and [COMPANY_A] was the importing company of [VEHICLE_A]. At around 10:50 a.m. on May 4, 2018, [PERSON_A] was driving [VEHICLE_A] on [LOCATION_C] from the Hoedeok direction toward the Nonsan direction, and proceeded along the shoulder near [LOCATION_A]. Subsequently, [PERSON_A] proceeded straight at [LOCATION_B], collided with the guardrail ahead, and fell. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] died in the accident. Around the time of the accident, [VEHICLE_A] traveled at high speed along the shoulder for approximately 300 m at a speed of 321.9 km/h or more, and its emergency warning lights were operating. The accident occurred at around 10:50 a.m. in clear weather. Before reaching the accident location, [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] at speeds ranging from 128.7 km/h to 160.9 km/h, and [PERSON_B], her husband, was seated in the passenger seat. At the time, [PERSON_A] was 66 years old, had no significant health problems, and had no record of being charged administrative fines for speeding or other reasons. [VEHICLE_A] was completely burned in the accident. The dashcam recordings of vehicles nearby at the time of the accident recorded [VEHICLE_A] from approximately 10 seconds before the accident until the time of the accident, and video analysis showed that [VEHICLE_A]'s brake lights were not illuminated. The brake lights of most vehicles operate through a switch connected to the brake pedal, so, absent special circumstances, the brake lights illuminate when the brake pedal is pressed. [PERSON_A]는 6월 30일 입원한 뒤 7월 1일 09시부터 10시 20분까지 조영술을 받고 10시 37분 병실로 옮겨졌다. 12시 2분부터 입술이 실룩이는 간헐적 경련이 시작되어 16시 1분 잠시 가라앉았다가 16시 20분 다시 나타났다. 17시 26분 촬영한 MRI에서 왼쪽 중대뇌동맥의 급성 뇌경색이 보였고, 18시 52분 중환자실로 옮겨졌다. 7월 13일 우회로 조성술을 받고 7월 20일 퇴원했지만 영구적인 오른쪽 편마비와 언어기능 저하가 남았다. neutral_en: The road connecting [LOCATION_A] was a 9.6 m-wide, two-way, two-lane asphalt-paved road with a centerline, and at the end of a straight section in a mountainous inland area, it continued into a curve bending to the right. There was a retaining wall and a railway on the left side of the road, and a guardrail and a river on the right. The accident site was shaded, and snow covered the area up to near the centerline, making the centerline difficult to see; approximately 100 m of the lane in which the passenger car was traveling was icy and slippery. The accident date was January 18, which was in winter, and the weather at the time of the accident was clear. It appears that snow fell in the area before the accident, but the exact time and amount of the snowfall were not confirmed. [ORGANIZATION_A] did not install warnings or danger signs indicating an icy road at the accident site and did not carry out ice-removal work. The dump truck driver who witnessed the incident stated to the police that the road surface before the accident site was in normal condition and that it was a place where many accidents occurred because drivers unfamiliar with the area became flustered and braked suddenly at the icy right-curving section that appeared suddenly. [ORGANIZATION_A] claimed that the daily traffic volume at the accident site was at least 4,000 vehicles, but that no other traffic accidents occurred before or after the accident and that many vehicles passed through without difficulty. The records do not confirm whether any traffic accident other than this matter occurred at the accident site. After [PERSON_D] overtook [VEHICLE_A] approximately 300 m before the accident site, [PERSON_D] proceeded toward the accident site and braked to reduce speed. When [PERSON_D] braked, the rear of the passenger car rotated toward the front and entered the opposite lane, causing the passenger car to strike the cement retaining wall, slide, and collide with [VEHICLE_B], which was traveling in the opposite lane.

[ORGANIZATION_A]은 사고 지점에 빙판길을 알리는 경고나 위험표지판을 설치하지 않았고, 빙판 제거 작업도 실시하지 않았다. 목격한 덤프트럭 운전자는 경찰에서 사고 지점 전의 노면은 정상 상태였고, 지리에 익숙하지 않은 운전자들이 갑자기 나타난 결빙된 우측 굴곡 구간에서 당황하여 급제동하다가 사고가 많이 발생하는 곳이라고 진술했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은 사고 지점의 하루 교통량이 4,000대 이상이었지만 사고 전후에 다른 교통사고가 발생하지 않았고, 많은 차량이 어려움 없이 통행했다고 주장했다. 사고 지점에서 이 사건 외의 교통사고가 발생했는지는 기록상 확인되지 않았다. [PERSON_D]가 사고 지점 약 300m 전에서 [VEHICLE_A]를 추월한 후 사고 지점을 진행하다가 속도를 줄이려고 제동했다. [PERSON_D]가 제동하는 순간 승용차의 후미가 앞쪽으로 돌면서 반대 차로로 들어갔고, 그 결과 승용차가 반대 차로에서 진행하던 [VEHICLE_B]와 충돌하기 전에 시멘트 방호벽을 충격한 후 미끄러졌다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] entered into a contract for construction of power-generation facilities with [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], and [COMPANY_D] on December 22, 2003. [COMPANY_B] entered into a supply contract for [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_E], and [COMPANY_E] received [PRODUCT_A] from a Japanese company and supplied it to [COMPANY_B], after which [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], and [COMPANY_D] installed [PRODUCT_A] at [COMPANY_A]'s power-generation facility and completed the power-generation facility construction. [COMPANY_A] began test operation of [PRODUCT_A] on August 3, 2006, and began commercial operation of [PRODUCT_A] on December 2, 2006. During an insulation test, one insulation bolt of [PRODUCT_A] was found to be broken, and an ultrasonic inspection found that four additional insulation bolts were damaged. Accordingly, [PRODUCT_A] was repaired, including by replacing all 18 insulation bolts, including the five damaged insulation bolts. [COMPANY_A] was unable to operate the power plant normally during the approximately 40-day repair period. When [PRODUCT_A] was not operating, all power-generation equipment functionally connected to [PRODUCT_A] could not be operated, and power production was therefore halted. This accident occurred due to a defect in the manufacture or installation of [PRODUCT_A]. Due to this accident, [COMPANY_A] was unable to produce electricity for 40 days, from August 1, 2007, to September 9, 2007, and consequently suffered damage of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A].

[COMPANY_B]가 [COMPANY_E]와 [PRODUCT_A] 공급계약을 체결했고, [COMPANY_E]가 일본 업체로부터 [PRODUCT_A]를 납품받아 [COMPANY_B]에게 공급했으며, [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], [COMPANY_D]가 [COMPANY_A]의 발전시설에 [PRODUCT_A]를 설치하고 발전설비공사를 완공했다. [COMPANY_A]는 2006년 8월 3일 [PRODUCT_A]의 시험운전을 시작했고, 2006년 12월 2일부터 [PRODUCT_A]의 상업 운전을 시작했다. 절연 테스트 중 [PRODUCT_A]의 절연볼트 1개가 파손된 것이 발견되었고, 초음파 검사에서 절연볼트 4개가 추가로 손상된 것이 발견되었다. 이에 따라 손상된 절연볼트 5개를 포함해 절연볼트 18개 전체를 교체하는 등 [PRODUCT_A]를 수리했다. [PERSON_A]와 [COMPANY_A] 사이에는 [COMPANY_A] 소속 대리운전자가 운전 중 발생시킨 사고로 인한 손해를 보장하는 자동차종합보험계약이 [COMPANY_B]와 체결되어 있었다. [COMPANY_B]는 사고 당시 [PERSON_A]가 안전띠를 착용하지 않았다고 주장하였다.

neutral_en: Ten affected people, including the juveniles [PERSON_A], [PERSON_C], [PERSON_F], and [PERSON_I], reported emotional distress from the manner in which an investigator employed by [ORGANIZATION_A] conducted interviews. After [PERSON_K] asked [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_F] specific questions about the time, place, preparation, and details of the suspected conduct, [PERSON_K] rewrote their short answers so that the record appeared to contain a detailed, continuous, voluntary account. During later questioning and investigation, the discrepancy between the questions, the short answers, and the written account made it harder for the four juveniles to explain and respond. They further alleged that a trusted adult was excluded and that they were not adequately told or given a meaningful opportunity to decline to answer or to have an adviser present. [ORGANIZATION_A] disputed the additional allegations about the interview process and the resulting harm beyond the altered records.

neutral_en: the affected people are [PERSON_A] and three others, and the involved entity is [ORGANIZATION_A]. After falling on 2015. 12. 28. while bracing the fall with the right hand and then being unable to raise the arm, [PERSON_B] was admitted to [INSTITUTION_A] on 2015. 12. 29. After conducting MRI and other examinations, the medical staff at [INSTITUTION_A] diagnosed [PERSON_B] as having a right shoulder full-thickness rotator cuff tear and findings of shoulder impingement syndrome, and planned arthroscopic surgery under general and local anesthesia. At approximately 10:15 on 2015. 12. 30., [PERSON_C] induced general anesthesia in [PERSON_B] by intravenous injection in the operating room and maintained the general anesthesia with Sevorane and nitrous oxide. For a brachial plexus block, [PERSON_C] administered local anesthesia by injecting a mixture of lidocaine and ropivacaine into [PERSON_B]'s neck, instructed [PERSON_D] at approximately 10:42 to monitor [PERSON_B]'s condition, and then left the operating room. The surgery began at approximately 11:00, and during the surgery [PERSON_B] developed hypotension and oxygen saturation also declined. At approximately 11:17, [PERSON_C] received a call from [PERSON_D], returned to the operating room, checked [PERSON_B]'s condition, and at approximately 11:20 administered epinephrine and other agents. When [PERSON_B]'s condition did not recover, [PERSON_C] stopped the surgery, changed [PERSON_B] from a seated position to a supine position, and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR). The medical staff at [INSTITUTION_A] transferred [PERSON_B] to [INSTITUTION_B], but [PERSON_B] was in cardiac arrest upon arrival at the emergency room of [INSTITUTION_B] at approximately 13:33 and died around that time. [PERSON_B] was 73 years old at the time of the surgery, was taking medication for hypertension and an antithrombotic agent, and preoperative test results showed that pulmonary function had decreased to 47%. [PERSON_B]'s blood pressure was approximately 110/65 mmHg at around 10:10 on the day of surgery, decreased to 70/42 mmHg at around 10:25, recovered to approximately 140/85 mmHg after ephedrine was administered, then decreased again to 75/55 mmHg at around 10:45 and recovered to approximately 95/65 mmHg after ephedrine was administered. [PERSON_B]'s blood pressure decreased to approximately 80/55 mmHg at around 11:00, recovered to approximately 98/63 mmHg after ephedrine was administered, and episodes of hypotension repeated. Oxygen saturation was maintained at 97% but sharply decreased to 89% at around 11:15. After hearing the vital-sign monitor alarm, [PERSON_D] called [PERSON_C] four times, at approximately 10:42, 11:00, 11:13, and 11:17. [PERSON_C] answered the call at approximately 10:42, received the monitor readings, and instructed that ephedrine be administered, but did not answer the call at approximately 11:00. In the emergency situation, after [PERSON_C] responded to [PERSON_D]'s call, [PERSON_C] administered a blood-pressure-raising agent to [PERSON_B], changed [PERSON_B]'s position, and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation, but [PERSON_B]'s condition did not recover.
neutral_ko: 관련 관련자는 [PERSON_A] 외 3인이며, 관련 기관은 [ORGANIZATION_A]이다. [PERSON_B]은 2015. 12. 28. 오른손으로 바닥을 짚으며 넘어진 후 팔을 올릴 수 없어 2015. 12. 29. [INSTITUTION_A]에 입원하였다. [INSTITUTION_A] 의료진은 MRI 검사 등을 거쳐 [PERSON_B]에게 오른쪽 어깨 전층 회전근개파열과 어깨충돌 증후군 소견이 있다고 진단하고, 전신마취 및 국소마취 아래 관절경을 이용한 수술을 계획하였다. 2015. 12. 30. 10:15경 [PERSON_C]은 수술실에서 [PERSON_B]에게 정맥 주사로 전신마취를 유도하고, 세보레와 아산화질소로 전신마취를 유지하였다. [PERSON_C]은 상완신경총 차단술을 위하여 [PERSON_B]의 목 부위에 리도카인과 로피바카인을 혼합 투여하여 국소마취를 하였고, 10:42경 [PERSON_D]에게 [PERSON_B]의 상태를 지켜보도록 지시한 후 수술실에서 나왔다. 수술은 11:00경 시작되었고, 수술 중 [PERSON_B]에게 저혈압이 발생하였으며 산소포화도도 하강하였다. [PERSON_C]은 11:17경 [PERSON_D]의 전화를 받고 수술실로 돌아와 [PERSON_B]의 상태를 확인한 후 11:20경 에피네프린 등을 투여하였다. [PERSON_B]의 상태가 회복되지 않자 [PERSON_C]은 수술을 중단시키고, [PERSON_B]을 앉은 자세에서 바로 누운 자세로 변경한 후 심폐소생술(CPR)을 시행하였다. [INSTITUTION_A] 의료진은 [PERSON_B]을 [INSTITUTION_B]으로 전원하였으나, 13:33경 [INSTITUTION_B] 응급실 도착 당시 [PERSON_B]은 심정지 상태였고 그 무렵 사망하였다. [PERSON_B]은 수술 당시 73세였고, 고혈압 및 항혈전제를 복용 중이었으며, 수술 전 검사결과 폐기능이 47%로 저하되어 있었다. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] and [COMPANY_A] were identified as the parties in this matter. The pilots of [PRODUCT_A] flew at an altitude of 1828.8m, where visibility was poor and the temperature fell to as low as -8℃. The pilots of [PRODUCT_A] did not activate the pitot heat intended to prevent the pitot tubes from icing. Because the pitot heat was not activated, the pitot tubes froze, and as a result the speed indicated on the airspeed indicator decreased differently from the actual speed, while the trailing edge of the stabilizer moved downward and the helicopter’s attitude tilted forward. Without properly understanding the situation, the pilots increased power in an attempt to increase speed after observing that [PRODUCT_A]’s speed on the airspeed indicator was decreasing. As a result of the pilots increasing power after observing that [PRODUCT_A]’s speed on the airspeed indicator was decreasing, [PRODUCT_A] entered a steep dive. While the pilots belatedly attempted to recover [PRODUCT_A]’s attitude, one of [PRODUCT_A]’s main rotor blades struck the rear fuselage. After the main rotor blade struck the rear fuselage, [PRODUCT_A] crashed. The flight manual warned of the possibility of abnormal stabilizer operation and explained how to respond to it. Given the characteristics of [PRODUCT_A] in this matter, it was something the pilots could readily know that abnormal stabilizer operation could be caused by icing of the pitot tubes. [PERSON_A] claimed that a pitot heat automatic activation device, a pitot heat activation indicator and warning device, a pitot tube icing detection device, a device for automatically switching the stabilizer to manual mode in the event of icing, a device that minimizes the stabilizer operating angle to approximately 25° in automatic mode, and a stabilizer warning light device should have been adopted.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]와 [COMPANY_A]가 이 사건의 당사자로 표시되었다. [PRODUCT_A]의 조종사들은 시계가 불량하고 기온이 영하 8℃까지 내려가는 고도 1828.8m 상공을 비행하였다. [PRODUCT_A]의 조종사들은 피토트 튜브의 결빙을 방지하기 위한 피토트 히트를 작동시키지 않았다. 피토트 히트를 작동시키지 않아 피토트 튜브가 얼었고, 그 결과 실제 속도와 다르게 속도계에 나타나는 속도가 감소했으며 스태빌레이터의 뒷전이 내려가 헬기의 자세가 앞쪽으로 기울어졌다. 조종사들은 이러한 상황을 제대로 파악하지 못한 채 속도계상 [PRODUCT_A]의 속도가 떨어지는 것을 보고 속도를 증가시키려고 출력을 높였다. 조종사들이 속도계상 [PRODUCT_A]의 속도가 떨어지는 것을 보고 출력을 높인 결과 [PRODUCT_A]가 급강하하게 되었다. 조종사들이 뒤늦게 [PRODUCT_A]의 자세를 회복하려고 시도하는 과정에서 [PRODUCT_A]의 주회전날개 중 하나가 후방 동체에 부딪혔다. 주회전날개가 후방 동체에 부딪힌 후 [PRODUCT_A]가 추락하였다. 비행교범은 스태빌레이터의 비정상적인 작동 가능성을 경고하고 그에 대처하는 방법을 설명하였다. 이 사건 [PRODUCT_A]의 특성상 스태빌레이터의 비정상적인 작동이 피토트 튜브의 결빙 때문에 초래될 수 있다는 점은 조종사들이 쉽게 알 수 있는 내용이었다. [PERSON_A]는 피토트 히트 자동작동장치, 피토트 히트 작동지시 및 경고 장치, 피토트 튜브 결빙 탐지 장치, 결빙 시 스태빌레이터의 수동모드 자동전환 장치, 자동모드에서 스태빌레이터 작동각도를 약 25°로 최소화하는 장치, 스태빌레이터 경고등 장치가 채택되었어야 한다고 주장하였다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_B] owned [VESSEL_A] and chartered it to [COMPANY_C] for 24 months on September 12, 2000. [COMPANY_C] then chartered [VESSEL_A] to [PERSON_A] for the same period. On August 25, 2001, [PERSON_A] entered into a contract to transport frozen fish from fishing grounds to [LOCATION_B]. On September 9, 2001, [VESSEL_A] transshipped [SHIPMENT_A] from [VESSEL_B] and [SHIPMENT_B] from [VESSEL_C], remained in [LOCATION_A] while taking on frozen fish from other fishing vessels, departed on October 22, 2001, and arrived at [LOCATION_B] on October 31. The contracts required the cargo hold to be maintained at −18 °C. During unloading at about 14:00 on November 1, 2001, [SHIPMENT_A] and [SHIPMENT_B], both consisting of frozen Pacific saury, were found to be severely dried and discolored. [COMPANY_A], which had issued marine cargo insurance for the shipments, paid insurance benefits to [COMPANY_F] and [COMPANY_G] after the cargo damage. [PERSON_A] issued and delivered bills of lading for [SHIPMENT_A] and [SHIPMENT_B]. [COMPANY_A] alleged that the actual transport and handling of the cargo by [PERSON_A]'s side was related to the cargo damage.

neutral_en: At about 7:40 a.m. on October 3, 2006, in dense fog, a 25-ton [VEHICLE_A] struck a slower one-ton truck, stopped in the second lane, and remained without a rear warning marker or other safety measures. A van and several passenger vehicles then collided in sequence, and some also remained in the travel lanes without warnings. [PERSON_A] exited one of the vehicles and moved toward the first lane to escape a fire in the third lane. A car carrier traveling in the first lane struck [PERSON_A]'s foot with a rear wheel, causing a pelvic fracture, amputation of the right leg, and other injuries. In the third lane, collisions involving a tanker and later vehicles caused a fire with multiple casualties. The parties disputed how the initial and later drivers' failures to keep lookout and following distance and their failure to secure stopped vehicles contributed to [PERSON_A]'s flight and the later impact.

neutral_en: [PERSON_B] was an employee of [COMPANY_A]. Through [PERSON_B]'s husband, [PERSON_C] provided [PERSON_B] with a copy of [PERSON_A]'s identification card and seal. [PERSON_B] did not verify whether the person requesting an account in [PERSON_A]'s name or the person who would receive the account book was [PERSON_A] or had lawful authority from [PERSON_A]. Using the identification copy and seal, [PERSON_B] completed an ordinary deposit application and cash-card application in [PERSON_A]'s name, created the account and card, and gave them to [PERSON_C]. [PERSON_A] operated an orthopedic clinic, and [PERSON_D] was [PERSON_A]'s employee. [PERSON_D] asked [COMPANY_B] to transfer treatment payments to the account opened in [PERSON_A]'s name. [COMPANY_B] treated the account as [PERSON_A]'s legitimate account and deposited the treatment payments into it. The funds were later withdrawn, and [PERSON_A] did not receive the corresponding treatment payments.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] rented [PROPERTY_A] from [PERSON_B] from 2017. 5. 25. to 2019. 24., and [COMPANY_A] acquired ownership of all of [PROPERTY_B] on 2019. 1. 15. [PROPERTY_B] received approval for use around 1977. After receiving a certified-content notice from [PERSON_A] around 2019. 2. 13. requesting that [COMPANY_A] clearly state its intention to renew the lease agreement and its intention to enter into an agreement with a new tenant, [COMPANY_A] sent [PERSON_A] a certified-content notice on 2019. 3. 6. stating that it was planning and preparing to construct a new building within several years; that, if a renewal of the agreement was requested, it would increase the deposit and monthly rent by 5% each and specifically notify the plans for demolition and reconstruction at the time of the renewal agreement; and that it would also specifically notify the plans for demolition and reconstruction when entering into a new agreement with a new tenant. After clearly stating that [PERSON_A] had no intention to renew, [PERSON_A] vacated [PROPERTY_A] on 2019. 24., but did not actually arrange a new tenant for [COMPANY_A] or provide information about a person seeking to become a new tenant. After [COMPANY_A] leased [PROPERTY_A] to [PERSON_C] and others around 2019. 7. 4., it ultimately set the lease term for all of [PROPERTY_B] at 36 months. The special provisions of the new lease agreement and the settlement agreement included the plan to demolish and reconstruct all of [PROPERTY_B], the construction time around 2022. 3., and a required period of one year, and a floor plan was also attached. The new lease agreement that [COMPANY_A] entered into with [PERSON_C] and others specifically stated the plan to demolish and reconstruct all of [PROPERTY_B], as well as the construction timing and required period.

neutral_en: A non-self-propelled barge, [VEHICLE_B], owned by [COMPANY_C], was towed after being connected to the stern of [VEHICLE_A] by a rope approximately 300 m long; [VEHICLE_B] was carrying the deckhouse of a vessel under construction and three empty containers, and [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], employees of [COMPANY_C], were aboard. After departure, fog repeatedly became dense and then thinned around the route, and from around 22:00 on 2006. 7. 12., the fog became dense and visibility was limited to approximately less than 15 m. Even while visibility was limited to approximately less than 15 m, [VEHICLE_A] continued navigating without sounding its whistle. [PERSON_C] detected [VEHICLE_C] navigating at a distance of approximately 9.26 km by radar, but continued navigating as it was, having incorrectly judged that [VEHICLE_C] would safely cross approximately 3.70–5.56 km ahead of [VEHICLE_A]'s bow. At around 03:35 on 2006. 13., as [VEHICLE_C] approached from ahead, [VEHICLE_A], sensing a risk of collision, changed direction to avoid [VEHICLE_C], but the forward end of the towed [VEHICLE_B] collided with the left side of [VEHICLE_C]. While visibility was extremely limited by dense fog, the captain of [VEHICLE_C], [PERSON_D], operated [VEHICLE_C] while neglecting radar lookout for surrounding vessels and without sounding the whistle. As a result of the collision, [VEHICLE_C] capsized, and seven crew members, including captain [PERSON_D], went missing and died; crew member [PERSON_F] was rescued with injuries including hypoxic encephalopathy. Immediately before the collision, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], who were aboard [VEHICLE_B], were sleeping in the cabin and fell from their beds onto the deck at the moment of the collision. After inspecting the hull of [VEHICLE_B], [PERSON_A] discovered signs of the collision, informed [VEHICLE_A]'s navigator, [PERSON_C], of that fact, and demanded that [PERSON_C] wake [VEHICLE_A]'s captain and report it; however, [PERSON_C] ignored the report, took no subsequent action, and continued navigating. At the time of the collision, [VEHICLE_B] was not equipped with facilities such as a whistle or siren capable of emitting sound signals, and it did not display sidelights or a sternlight. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] boarded to manage the cargo and not to assist in navigating [VEHICLE_A]. Although visibility was extremely poor because of the fog, there was a substantial likelihood that if [VEHICLE_B]'s side had properly made sound and light signals, [VEHICLE_C]'s side would have noticed the presence of [VEHICLE_B] and prevented the collision by slowing down or changing direction in advance. Because [VEHICLE_B]'s side made no sound or light signals, [VEHICLE_C]'s side did not notice the presence of [VEHICLE_B], and there was a substantial likelihood that, as a result, it failed to prevent the collision by slowing down or changing direction in advance.
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_C] 소유의 자력 항행능력이 없는 부선인 [VEHICLE_B]를 길이 약 300m의 밧줄로 [VEHICLE_A]의 선미에 연결하여 예인했고, [VEHICLE_B]에는 건조 중인 선박의 갑판실과 빈 컨테이너 3개가 실려 있었으며 [COMPANY_C]의 직원인 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]가 승선했다. 출항 후 항로 주변에는 안개가 반복적으로 짙어졌다가 옅어졌고, 2006. 7. 12. 22:00경부터는 안개가 짙어져 시계가 약 15m 미만으로 제한되었다. 시계가 약 15m 미만으로 제한된 상태에서도 [VEHICLE_A]는 기적을 울리지 않은 채 항해를 계속했고, [PERSON_C]은 레이더로 약 9.26km 거리에서 항해하는 [VEHICLE_C]를 발견했으나 [VEHICLE_C]가 [VEHICLE_A]의 선수 전방 약 3.70~5.56km 거리를 두고 안전하게 횡단할 것이라고 잘못 판단한 채 그대로 항해했다. 2006. 13. 03:35경 [VEHICLE_C]가 선수 전방에서 접근하자 충돌 위험을 느낀 [VEHICLE_A]가 방향을 변경하여 [VEHICLE_C]를 피했으나, 예인되던 [VEHICLE_B]의 앞머리와 [VEHICLE_C]의 왼쪽 부분이 서로 충돌했다. 짙은 안개로 시계가 극도로 제한된 상태에서 [VEHICLE_C]의 선장 [PERSON_D]는 주변 선박에 대한 레이더 경계를 소홀히 하고 기적도 울리지 않은 채 [VEHICLE_C]를 운항했다. 이 충돌로 [VEHICLE_C]가 전복되었고, 선장 [PERSON_D]를 포함한 선원 7명이 실종되어 사망했으며, 선원 [PERSON_F]은 저산소성 뇌병증 등의 상해를 입은 채 구조되었다. 충돌 직전 [VEHICLE_B]에 승선한 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 선실에서 잠을 자고 있었고, 충돌 순간 침대에서 떨어져 갑판으로 나왔다. [PERSON_A]는 [VEHICLE_B]의 선체를 점검한 뒤 충돌 흔적을 발견하고 그 사실을 [VEHICLE_A]의 항해사 [PERSON_C]에게 알리면서 [VEHICLE_A]의 선장을 깨워 보고해 달라고 요구했으나, [PERSON_C]은 그 보고를 무시하고 사후 조치를 하지 않은 채 계속 항해했다. 충돌 당시 [VEHICLE_B]에는 음향신호를 내보낼 수 있는 기적이나 사이렌 등의 시설이 장착되어 있지 않았고, 현등 및 선미등을 밝히지 않았다. [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]의 승선 목적은 화물 관리였으며, [VEHICLE_A]의 항해를 보조하기 위한 것은 아니었다. 안개로 시계가 극히 불량했지만, [VEHICLE_B] 측에서 음향신호와 등화신호를 제대로 했다면 [VEHICLE_C] 측이 [VEHICLE_B]의 존재를 알아채고 사전에 감속하거나 방향을 변경하여 충돌을 방지했을 개연성이 상당했다. [VEHICLE_B] 측의 음향신호와 등화신호가 없었기 때문에 [VEHICLE_C] 측이 [VEHICLE_B]의 존재를 알아채지 못했고, 그 결과 사전 감속이나 방향 변경을 하지 않아 충돌을 방지하지 못했을 개연성이 상당했다.

neutral_en: [ORGANIZATION_A] purchased shipping documents from [COMPANY_C] and, at that time, entered into an export bill insurance contract with [INSTITUTION_A] to secure payment of the export proceeds, but did not receive collateral from [COMPANY_C]. In bill-of-exchange transactions under documents-against-acceptance terms, the importer could receive the shipping documents and take delivery of the goods simply by accepting the bill of exchange, and whether the bill of exchange would be duly paid depended on the importer's willingness and ability to pay. [ORGANIZATION_A] provided foreign-exchange loans to [COMPANY_C] by purchasing bills of exchange secured by bills of lading, and purchased, without receiving collateral, bills of exchange issued under documents-against-acceptance terms and the shipping documents. At [COMPANY_C]'s request, [ORGANIZATION_A] changed the acceptor of the bill of exchange from the original importer to [COMPANY_B]. [ORGANIZATION_A] did not receive payment of the export proceeds from [COMPANY_B], claimed insurance proceeds from [INSTITUTION_A], but did not receive the insurance proceeds either, and therefore failed to recover an amount equivalent to the export proceeds. The fact that [ORGANIZATION_A] purchased the bills of exchange and shipping documents without collateral and changed the acceptor of the bills of exchange became one of the causes of the circumstances in which [ORGANIZATION_A] did not receive the insurance proceeds and failed to recover an amount equivalent to the export proceeds. While already delinquent on its foreign-exchange loan debt to [ORGANIZATION_A], [COMPANY_C] suddenly made many requests to purchase shipping documents under documents-against-acceptance terms, and the export unit prices on the export declarations were excessively high compared with the average export unit prices. [COMPANY_A] alleged that the president of [COMPANY_B], when accepting on December 19, 1996 bills of exchange on which he was designated as the payer, received from [BANK_A] the shipping documents, including the bills of lading, and was in possession of the bills of lading at the time the goods were delivered.

neutral_en: The parties to the case are identified as [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B]. Around October 7, 1993, [PERSON_A] visited [INSTITUTION_A], operated by [PERSON_B], and consulted about plastic surgery, saying that [PERSON_A] wanted to raise the forehead and chin and have double-eyelid surgery. On November 17, 1993, [PERSON_A] paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] to [PERSON_B] and underwent surgery to insert silicone implants into the chin and forehead areas and double-eyelid surgery. [PERSON_A] subsequently requested additional surgery from [PERSON_B] and, around December 13, 1994, underwent additional corrective surgery that slightly reduced the size of the double eyelids and replaced the implants inserted in the forehead and chin with thinner ones. After the surgery to insert silicone implants into the chin and forehead areas, the double-eyelid surgery, and the subsequent additional corrective surgery, the silicone inserted into [PERSON_A]'s chin area began to move diagonally around December 1997. Around October 1998, the silicone implant partially protruded into the mouth, and hair did not partially regrow in the 5 cm scar that developed on the head while the silicone was being inserted. According to the results of questioning [PERSON_B] personally and other materials, [PERSON_B] explained at the time of the surgery that bleeding, inflammation, the size of the implant, and the possibility that its size could differ from what [PERSON_B] wanted, as well as the possibility that some hair might not grow at the incision site on the head, could occur, but did not sufficiently explain that the implant could move.

[PERSON_A]는 이후 [PERSON_B]에게 재수술을 요구했고, 1994. 12. 13.경 쌍꺼풀의 크기를 약간 줄이고 이마와 턱에 넣었던 보형물의 크기를 보다 얇은 것으로 교체하는 추가교정수술을 받았다. 턱과 이마 부위에 실리콘 보형물을 삽입하는 수술과 눈 쌍꺼풀 수술 및 그 후의 추가교정수술이 있은 뒤, 1997. 12.경부터 [PERSON_A]의 턱 부위에 삽입된 실리콘이 대각선으로 이동하기 시작했다. 1998. 10.경에는 실리콘 보형물이 입안 내로 일부 돌출되었고, 실리콘을 삽입하면서 머리 부위에 생긴 5cm의 반흔에 부분적으로 머리털이 재생되지 않았다. 제공된 진술에 따르면, [PERSON_B]는 수술 당시 출혈, 염증, 보형물의 크기가 본인이 원하는 것과 다를 수 있다는 점, 머리 절개 부위에 일부 머리털이 자라지 않을 수 있다는 점을 설명했으나, 보형물이 움직일 수 있다는 점은 충분히 설명하지 않았다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_C], an orthopedic surgeon at [INSTITUTION_A] affiliated with [COMPANY_A], conducted a physical assessment of [PERSON_A]. [PERSON_A] sustained injuries including an open comminuted fracture of the proximal portion of the left femur in the traffic accident. After assessing [PERSON_A]’s physical condition, [PERSON_C] reported that the range of motion of the left hip was almost normal and that abduction was somewhat limited but was expected to recover normally after removal of the intramedullary nail, and that the range of motion of the knee joint was normal. Subsequently, another physical assessment was conducted for [PERSON_A], and, unlike the previous assessment, the result was that a permanent impairment of joint stiffness had occurred due to the limitation of the hip’s range of motion. The record did not provide a sufficient basis to recognize that the subsequent physical assessment accurately reflected [PERSON_A]’s current symptoms, nor did circumstances appear showing that there had been an objective error in the examination for [PERSON_C]’s assessment or in the process of evaluating the degree of impairment.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] and four others, as landowners, raised a dispute concerning the compensation appraisal against [COMPANY_A] and two others. [COMPANY_B] and [COMPANY_C] selected [LOCATION_A] building site, 215㎡, as the comparison standard land for the land listed as No. 7, and [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, as the comparison standard land for the lands listed as Nos. 8 and 9. [COMPANY_A] also selected [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, as the comparison standard land for the land listed as No. 9. [COMPANY_A] and the other appraisal businesses conducted appraisals by examining the actual conditions of the land and its surrounding environment and analyzing the regional factors and individual factors in comparison with the comparison standard land. [COMPANY_A] determined that the area adjacent to the land listed as No. 9 was an area of potential residential land between a road and a river, and viewed the opposite side as having apartment complexes and existing residential areas formed there, with subway construction underway. [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, had been publicly announced since 1992 as land whose actual land category was a recreation area and which adjoined on one side a road at least 25 m wide, and was the site of [PROPERTY_A], which had previously been used as a swimming pool. [PERSON_A] claimed that [COMPANY_A] had conducted an appraisal contrary to the actual conditions of the land and that [PERSON_A] had suffered loss corresponding to the difference between the appropriate loss-compensation price and the actual compensation amount. Of the 453㎡ of [LOCATION_C] building site near the lands listed as Nos. 1 through 6, 354㎡ was purchased by agreement around January 1996, and [LOCATION_D] dry field, 62㎡, was purchased by agreement around 1995. [LOCATION_E] paddy field, 278㎡, was expropriated; three parcels, including [LOCATION_F], were sold around April 11, 1995; and [LOCATION_G] building site, 77㎡, was sold around February 28, 1998. Because the transaction dates of the nearby lands were after approval of the residential land development project plan, it appeared that the transaction prices included a substantial portion of the development gains from that development project.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A] 외 4인은 토지 소유자들로서 [COMPANY_A] 외 2인을 상대로 보상 평가와 관련된 분쟁을 제기하였다. [COMPANY_B]와 [COMPANY_C]는 목록 제7번 토지의 비교표준지로 [LOCATION_A] 대 215㎡를, 목록 제8·9번 토지의 비교표준지로 [LOCATION_B] 답 1,024㎡를 선정하였다. [COMPANY_A]도 목록 제9번 토지의 비교표준지로 [LOCATION_B] 답 1,024㎡를 선정하였다. [COMPANY_A] 외 감정평가업자들은 토지의 실제 현황과 주변환경 등을 확인하고 비교표준지와의 지역요인 및 개별요인을 분석하여 감정평가를 수행하였다. [COMPANY_A]는 목록 제9번 토지의 인접 지역을 도로와 강 사이의 택지 후보지 지역으로 판단하였고, 그 맞은편에는 아파트단지와 기존주택지 등이 형성되어 있으며 지하철 공사가 진행 중인 것으로 보았다. [LOCATION_B] 답 1,024㎡는 1992년부터 실제 지목이 유원지 및 폭 25m 이상의 도로 한 면에 접한 토지로 공고되었고, 과거 수영장으로 사용된 [PROPERTY_A]의 부지였다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]가 토지의 실제 현황에 반하는 감정을 하여 적정한 손실보상가격과 실제 보상액의 차액에 해당하는 손해를 입었다고 주장하였다. 목록 제1 내지 6번 토지 인근의 [LOCATION_C] 대 453㎡ 중 354㎡는 1996년 1월경 협의매수되었고, [LOCATION_D] 전 62㎡는 1995년경 협의매수되었다. [LOCATION_E] 답 278㎡는 수용되었고, [LOCATION_F] 등 3필지는 1995년 4월 11일경 매매되었으며, 1998년 2월 28일경 [LOCATION_G] 대 77㎡는 매도되었다. 인근 토지들의 거래일시가 택지개발사업계획 승인 후였기 때문에 그 거래가격에는 해당 개발사업으로 인한 개발이익이 상당 부분 포함된 것으로 보였다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A], a four-year-old child, visited a swimming facility operated by [INSTITUTION_A] with a caregiver. [PERSON_A] entered the pool without the caregiver and without a life jacket or flotation tube. The operator and on-site staff did not adequately monitor the young child's access or use of safety equipment or prevent the danger. [PERSON_A] drowned and died. The caregiver and the facility disputed the degree to which inadequate parental supervision and inadequate facility safety management each contributed to the death.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] newly purchased a [PRODUCT_A] vehicle from [PERSON_D], who worked at [COMPANY_C], for [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], and asked [PERSON_D] to sell [VEHICLE_A], which [PERSON_A] had been using previously, for [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] and use the proceeds to settle the payment for the [PRODUCT_A] vehicle. [PERSON_D] agreed to sell [PERSON_A]'s vehicle for [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] and promised to settle the payment for the [PRODUCT_A] vehicle with the sale proceeds by May 17, 2000. [PERSON_A] handed [PERSON_D] the documents necessary to register the transfer of the vehicle, and [PERSON_D] took [VEHICLE_A]. [PERSON_E] agreed to pay [PERSON_D] [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] by May 17, 2000, and took delivery of [VEHICLE_A]. At that time, [PERSON_E] belonged to [COMPANY_D], a used-car sales business operated by [PERSON_C]. Without informing [PERSON_C], [PERSON_E] looked for a buyer for [VEHICLE_A] and, deciding that it would be difficult to sell it at the asking price through [COMPANY_D], around April 21, 2000, entrusted the sale of [VEHICLE_A] again to a friend, [PERSON_F], and delivered the vehicle to [PERSON_F]. While displaying [VEHICLE_A] near the parking lot of [COMPANY_E] and brokering its sale from April 21, 2000, on the 27th of the same month [PERSON_F] asked [PERSON_G] to bring [VEHICLE_A] to [PERSON_F]'s home for the purpose of having it repaired at a repair shop. [PERSON_G] received the key to [VEHICLE_A], which was kept at the [COMPANY_E] office, from an employee and caused an accident while driving [VEHICLE_A] to [PERSON_F]'s home. [PERSON_C] did not know that [VEHICLE_A] had been privately entrusted by [PERSON_E]. [PERSON_F] took delivery of, managed, and displayed [VEHICLE_A], and at the time of the accident intended to repair it in order to increase the vehicle's value. After the accident, the sales business [COMPANY_E], to which [PERSON_F] belonged, actually purchased [VEHICLE_A]. [PERSON_C] did not participate in dealing with the aftermath of the accident.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_C]에 근무하는 [PERSON_D]로부터 [PRODUCT_A] 차량을 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]에 새로 구입하면서, 이전부터 사용하던 [VEHICLE_A]를 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]에 팔아 그 돈으로 [PRODUCT_A] 차량 대금을 정산해 달라고 부탁하였다. [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]의 차량을 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]에 팔아주기로 하고, 2000년 5월 17일까지 그 매도대금으로 [PRODUCT_A] 차량 대금과 정산하기로 약속하였다. [PERSON_A]는 차량 이전등록에 필요한 서류를 [PERSON_D]에게 건네주었고, [PERSON_D]는 [VEHICLE_A]를 가져갔다. [PERSON_E]는 2000년 5월 17일까지 [PERSON_D]에게 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]을 지급하기로 약정하고 [VEHICLE_A]를 인도받았다. 당시 [PERSON_E]는 [PERSON_C]가 운영하는 중고자동차 매매업소 [COMPANY_D]에 소속되어 있었다. [PERSON_E]는 [PERSON_C]에게 알리지 않고 [VEHICLE_A]의 구매자를 찾다가, [COMPANY_D]에서 의뢰가격에 판매하기 어렵다고 판단하여 2000년 4월 21일경 친구인 [PERSON_F]에게 [VEHICLE_A]의 매매를 다시 위탁하고 차량을 인도하였다. 2000년 4월 21일부터 [COMPANY_E] 주차장 부근에서 [VEHICLE_A]를 전시하여 매매를 중개하던 중, 같은 달 27일 [PERSON_F]는 정비소에서 수리할 목적으로 [PERSON_G]에게 [VEHICLE_A]를 자신의 집까지 가져다 달라고 부탁하였다. [PERSON_G]는 [COMPANY_E] 사무실에 보관되어 있던 [VEHICLE_A]의 열쇠를 직원에게 받아 [PERSON_F]의 집으로 [VEHICLE_A]를 운전하여 가던 중 사고를 일으켰다. [PERSON_C]는 [VEHICLE_A]가 [PERSON_E]에 의해 개인적으로 위탁된 사실을 알지 못했다. [PERSON_F]는 [VEHICLE_A]를 인도받아 관리하고 전시했으며, 사고 당시 차량의 가치를 높이기 위해 수리하려고 했다. 사고 후 [PERSON_F]가 소속된 매매업체 [COMPANY_E]가 [VEHICLE_A]를 실제로 매수하였다. [PERSON_C]는 사고 수습 과정에 참여하지 않았다.

neutral_en: The parties to this case included [ORGANIZATION_A], [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], and [PERSON_D]. [PERSON_B] was an obstetrician-gynecologist, [PERSON_C] was an internist, and [PERSON_D] was a nursing assistant. At approximately 10:50 a.m. on February 18, 2004, [PERSON_B] began a resection of [PERSON_A]'s labia minora after inducing anesthesia. When [PERSON_A] continued to move during the surgery, [PERSON_D] administered more anesthetic than the appropriate dose. At approximately 10:57 a.m., the pulse oximeter sounded an alarm, and [PERSON_A] stopped breathing. At [PERSON_B]'s request, [PERSON_C] attempted endotracheal intubation of [PERSON_A] but failed, and provided artificial ventilation using an Ambu bag. At approximately 11:10 a.m., [PERSON_A] was transported by ambulance and arrived at the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A] at approximately 11:20 a.m. When [PERSON_A] arrived at the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A], [PERSON_A]'s oxygen saturation was low at 82%. After receiving oxygen through an oxygen mask in the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A], [PERSON_A]'s oxygen saturation recovered to 100% at approximately 11:25 a.m. The medical staff at [INSTITUTION_A] administered 3–4 L of intravenous fluids for approximately one hour immediately after [PERSON_A] was transferred to the emergency department. After the administration of fluids, [PERSON_A]'s oxygen saturation fell to 72%, breathing difficulty worsened, and convulsions occurred at approximately 2:00 p.m. At approximately 3:00 p.m., a chest radiograph showed findings of pulmonary edema in [PERSON_A], and [PERSON_A] received diuretic treatment around that evening. [PERSON_A] did not regain consciousness, remained in a vegetative state with hypoxic brain injury, and died on July 31, 2008. [PERSON_B] claimed that, during the process of changing the intravenous fluids, the pulse oximeter came off [PERSON_A]'s finger and, although it was reattached, it did not operate. The medical experts stated that it was difficult to clearly distinguish whether irreversible brain damage had already occurred on arrival at the emergency department, or whether hypoxic brain injury occurred after arrival at the emergency department due to a new condition such as pulmonary edema. Oxygen saturation below 85% constitutes severe hypoxemia requiring immediate action, and exposure to severe hypoxemia below 72% for more than 4 minutes may result in irreversible hypoxic brain injury.
neutral_ko: 관련자에는 [ORGANIZATION_A], [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], [PERSON_D]가 포함되어 있었다. [PERSON_B]은 산부인과 전문의였고, [PERSON_C]는 내과 전문의였으며 [PERSON_D]는 간호조무사였다. 2004년 2월 18일 10시 50분경 [PERSON_B]은 [PERSON_A]에게 마취유도 후 소음순 절제술을 시작하였다. 수술 중 [PERSON_A]가 계속 움직이자 [PERSON_D]가 적정 투여량보다 많은 마취제를 투여하였다. 10시 57분경 맥박산소계측기에서 경고음이 울렸고 [PERSON_A]의 호흡이 정지되었다. [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_B]의 요청을 받아 [PERSON_A]에게 기관내 삽관을 시도하였으나 실패하였고, 앰부를 사용하여 인공호흡을 하였다. 11시 10분경 [PERSON_A]는 구급차로 이송되었고, 11시 20분경 [INSTITUTION_A] 응급실에 도착하였다. [PERSON_A]가 [INSTITUTION_A] 응급실에 도착했을 때 산소포화도는 82%로 낮았다. [INSTITUTION_A] 응급실에서 산소마스크로 산소를 공급받은 뒤 11시 25분경 [PERSON_A]의 산소포화도는 100%로 회복되었다. [INSTITUTION_A] 의료진은 [PERSON_A]가 응급실로 옮겨진 직후 약 1시간 동안 3~4L의 수액을 투여하였다. 수액 투여 후 [PERSON_A]의 산소포화도가 72%로 떨어지고 호흡곤란이 심해졌으며, 14시경 경련이 발생하였다. 15시경 흉부 방사선검사에서 [PERSON_A]에게 폐부종 소견이 발견되었고, 그날 저녁 무렵 이뇨제 치료를 받았다. [PERSON_A]는 의식을 회복하지 못하고 저산소성 뇌손상으로 식물인간 상태에 있다가 2008년 7월 31일 사망하였다. [PERSON_B]는 수액을 교환하는 과정에서 맥박산소계측기가 [PERSON_A]의 손가락에서 빠졌고, 다시 부착했으나 작동하지 않았다고 주장하였다. 감정의사들은 응급실 도착 당시 이미 비가역적인 뇌손상이 발생했는지, 또는 응급실 도착 후 폐부종과 같은 새로운 상태로 저산소성 뇌손상이 발생했는지를 명확히 구별하기 어렵다는 의견을 밝혔다. 산소포화도 85% 미만은 심각한 저산소혈증으로 즉각적인 조치가 필요하며, 72% 미만의 심각한 저산소혈증에 4분 이상 노출되면 비가역적인 저산소성 뇌손상을 입을 수 있다.

neutral_en: affected person 1 and two others were family members of [PERSON_A], and [ORGANIZATION_A] managed the area around [LOCATION_A], including the accident site. At around 18:30, [PERSON_A] went to [LOCATION_A] with university seniors and peers in the same year and went swimming near the accident site at around 19:20. The water at the accident site was 50–80 cm deep toward the middle, but it became suddenly deeper near the sandy area on the right, with a point having a maximum depth of approximately 2.5 m, and [PERSON_A] fell into the water at that point and could not get out. A report of the accident was received at around 19:30, and rescue personnel arrived at the accident site at around 19:36 and performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation on [PERSON_A] with the assistance of a doctor, but there was no improvement. [PERSON_A] was transported by ambulance to [INSTITUTION_A] at around 19:44. The H0002 record states that [PERSON_A] died at around 20:20 from cardiac arrest caused by asphyxiation and hypothermia. The H0003 record states that [PERSON_A] was transported to [INSTITUTION_A] at around 19:44 but died around the time of arrival at the hospital. One 60 cm wide and 20 cm high “No Swimming” sign was installed near the accident site, but there were no barriers preventing visitors from accessing the area or signs prohibiting entry. From around 18:00 to around 21:00 on the day of the accident, the temperature near [LOCATION_A] was 30.7–27.1°C, and sunset was at around 19:44. The number of paid visitors on the day of the accident reached approximately 800. There is a record that [PERSON_A] was a university student approximately 21 years old at the time of the accident.

After [PERSON_D] stole a van owned by [PERSON_E], a vehicle theft report was made, and 40 minutes after that report, [PERSON_D] kidnapped [PERSON_B] and moved [PERSON_B]. [PERSON_C] died. [PERSON_D] contacted [PERSON_C] using [PERSON_B]'s mobile phone and demanded that [PERSON_C] personally bring [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] in cash, and two police officers belonging to [ORGANIZATION_A] rode in the back seat of the passenger car driven by [PERSON_C]. After the police officers got out of the vehicle, they instructed [PERSON_C] to leave the scene and return home. [PERSON_C] set down the cash and left the scene, but did not follow the instruction to return home; instead, [PERSON_C] drove back to the scene and struck [PERSON_D]'s van. Even after [PERSON_B] got out of the van and fled, [PERSON_C] continued struggling physically with [PERSON_D] to apprehend [PERSON_D], and followed while holding the driver's-side door of the van. [PERSON_C] did not use the gas gun handed over by [PERSON_A] and struggled physically with [PERSON_D], who was expected to be carrying a shotgun or other weapon. [PERSON_C] died after struggling physically with [PERSON_D].

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] made decisions refusing to reappoint [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B], and [PERSON_D], and they sought damages from [COMPANY_A] for losses after the refusal of reappointment. [COMPANY_A] made a decision refusing to reappoint [PERSON_A] on August 31, 1997, [PERSON_B] on February 28, 1999, and [PERSON_D] on February 29, 2004. After the decisions refusing reappointment, [COMPANY_A] did not allow [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B], or [PERSON_D] to return to their positions. [PERSON_A] was born in 1953, [PERSON_B] in 1948, and [PERSON_D] in 1958. The age-based retirement age for [PERSON_A] was set to occur after 2018, for [PERSON_B] after 2013, and for [PERSON_D] after 2023. While several state agencies conducted overlapping investigations over an extended period and announced differing investigation results, the mental suffering experienced by [PERSON_A]'s family appears to have been greater than that experienced in other ordinary similar incidents. Not enough scene photographs were attached to the investigation records to determine whether bloodstains, bone fragments, or brain tissue were scattered at the scene. During the autopsy, [PERSON_A]'s left-hand wound was not incised to determine whether there was subcutaneous bleeding, and the stomach contents were not analyzed to investigate the estimated time of death. In addition, [ORGANIZATION_B] did not investigate whether the firearm had bloodstains or soil on it, or record the results. Although [PERSON_A] had three gunshot wounds, only two cartridge cases were initially found at the scene, and the timing and circumstances of the discovery of one additional cartridge case were not explained. The serial number of the rifle at the scene was typed and then altered by hand, but there was no explanation, and although the examination result stated that the firing marks on the three cartridge cases were identical, only a photograph of one cartridge case was attached. It has not been clearly established to date whether [PERSON_A]'s cause of death was homicide or suicide, and [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] experienced mental suffering as a result. If the necessary investigative measures had been carried out, it might have been possible to determine the cause of [PERSON_A]'s death, but because those measures were not carried out, it has remained impossible to reach a clear conclusion to date as to whether it was homicide or suicide.
