[PERSON_A] conceived [ALLOY_B], made by mixing [ALLOY_C] and [ALLOY_D] at ratios of 6:4, 7:3, and 8:2, respectively, and requested [PERSON_B] to analyze and optimize the physical properties of [ALLOY_B]. Around August 2008, it became known that [ALLOY_B] had exceptionally high strength but was brittle, and the pursuit of a patent application and commercialization was abandoned. Around December 2008, after receiving a request from [COMPANY_B] to cast mobile-phone hinges using an alloy stronger than existing commercial alloys, [PERSON_A] pursued the development of a new alloy based on the past experience of developing [ALLOY_B]. While conducting experiments in his laboratory to develop a new [PRODUCT_B] alloy containing [ALLOY_A], [PERSON_B] specifically reported to [PERSON_A] the contents of each experiment and the schedule for the next experiment before and after each experiment. Together, around February 16, 2009, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] cast exterior parts for mobile phones as prototypes of new [PRODUCT_B] alloys at [COMPANY_A]’s factory, and after [PERSON_B] completed the physical-property analysis of the cast products, development of [ALLOY_A] was completed. After developing [ALLOY_A], [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] did not proceed with the procedure of transferring [PERSON_A]’s share to [COMPANY_A], and sought to register the invention in its entirety solely in [PERSON_B]’s name and jointly obtain profits through [BUSINESS_A]; in fact, they entered into license agreements concerning [ALLOY_A] with [COMPANY_C] and [COMPANY_D]. It is recorded that [PERSON_A] transferred [PERSON_A]’s share to [PERSON_B] without informing [COMPANY_A] that [ALLOY_A] had been completed, thereby causing [PERSON_B] to register it alone, and that [COMPANY_A] suffered damage because [PERSON_B] was caused to enter into license agreements with other companies through the arrangement of [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_C]. They knew or could have known that [PRODUCT_A] would be sprayed in or near the areas where the veterans served, and that the veterans could thereby be repeatedly exposed to [CHEMICAL_A], but, at the direction of [INSTITUTION_A], they did not place warning labels on the containers concerning the harmful effects of [CHEMICAL_A] on the human body or precautions. Around early 1965, [COMPANY_A] developed an analytical method capable of detecting [CHEMICAL_A] concentrations down to 1 ppm or less, established manufacturing specifications reducing the concentration of [CHEMICAL_A] to approximately 1 ppm, and knew a method of reducing the risk of [CHEMICAL_A] contamination through a wastewater-treatment process. [COMPANY_B] did not establish manufacturing standards concerning the concentration of [CHEMICAL_A], but knew that the risk of contamination could be reduced by adding information about the harmfulness of [CHEMICAL_A], the existence of that analytical method, and the wastewater-treatment process. [COMPANY_C] adopted a different manufacturing process and produced [PRODUCT_A] containing [CHEMICAL_A] at 0.1 ppm or less. The relevant [PERSON_A] who served in [LOCATION_A] developed [DISEASE_A] after their service ended, following exposure during their service to [CHEMICAL_A] contained in [PRODUCT_A] sprayed or remaining in their service areas and elsewhere. [DISEASE_B], including the diabetes suffered by [PERSON_A], was not a disease that arose only from exposure to [CHEMICAL_A] contained in [PRODUCT_A], but was a disease that could arise from various congenital and acquired factors. The mere existence of a statistical association between [DISEASE_B] and exposure to [PRODUCT_A], together with the circumstance that [PERSON_A] suffered from [DISEASE_B], did not by itself establish that each [PERSON_A]'s [DISEASE_B] arose from exposure to [CHEMICAL_A] in [PRODUCT_A] sprayed at the time of the [LOCATION_A] war. As a result, our country's soldiers who participated in the [LOCATION_A] war suffered physical and mental distress, and even when soldiers who returned home after their service ended suffered from [DISEASE_A], it was difficult for them to know for some time that the disease had been caused by [PRODUCT_A].
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]들은 [LOCATION_A]에 파병되어 복무한 참전군인들 또는 그 유족들이었고, [LOCATION_A]에서 살포된 [PRODUCT_A]에 노출된 후 귀국하여 질병이 발생하였다고 주장하였다. [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]는 [PRODUCT_A]를 제조하여 [INSTITUTION_A]에 판매했고, [CHEMICAL_A]가 함유된 [PRODUCT_A]에 노출되면 인체에 유해한 결과가 발생할 위험을 인식하고 있었다. 이들은 [PRODUCT_A]가 참전군인들의 복무지역이나 인근에 살포되어 참전군인들이 [CHEMICAL_A]에 반복적으로 노출될 수 있음을 알거나 알 수 있었고, [INSTITUTION_A]의 지시에 따라 용기에 [CHEMICAL_A]의 인체 유해성이나 주의사항에 관한 경고 표시를 하지 않았다. [COMPANY_A]는 1965년 초경 [CHEMICAL_A] 농도를 1ppm 이하까지 탐지할 수 있는 분석방법을 개발하고 [CHEMICAL_A] 농도를 약 1ppm 수준까지 낮추는 제조명세서를 수립했으며, 폐수처리공정으로 [CHEMICAL_A] 오염 위험을 줄이는 방법을 알고 있었다. [COMPANY_B]는 [CHEMICAL_A] 농도에 관한 제조 기준을 세우지 않았으나 [CHEMICAL_A]의 유해성 정보, 해당 분석방법의 존재 및 폐수처리공정 등을 추가하여 오염 위험을 줄일 수 있다는 점을 알고 있었다. [COMPANY_C]는 다른 제조공정을 채택하여 [CHEMICAL_A]가 0.1ppm 이하로 함유된 [PRODUCT_A]를 생산했다. [LOCATION_A]에 참전한 관련 [PERSON_A]들에게 복무 종료 후 [DISEASE_A]이 발생했으며, 이는 복무기간 동안 [PRODUCT_A]에 포함된 [CHEMICAL_A]에 노출된 후 복무지역 등에 살포되거나 잔류한 [PRODUCT_A]로부터 발생한 노출과 관련되었다. [PERSON_A]들이 앓은 당뇨병 등 [DISEASE_B]은 [PRODUCT_A]에 포함된 [CHEMICAL_A] 노출로만 발생하는 질환이 아니라 여러 선천적·후천적 요인으로 발생할 수 있는 질환이었다. [DISEASE_B]과 [PRODUCT_A] 노출 사이에 통계학적 연관성이 있고 [PERSON_A]들이 [DISEASE_B]을 앓았다는 사정만으로는 각 [PERSON_A]의 [DISEASE_B]이 [LOCATION_A]전 당시 살포된 [PRODUCT_A]의 [CHEMICAL_A]에 노출되어 발생했다고 볼 수 없었다. 그 결과 [LOCATION_A]전에 참전한 우리나라 군인들이 육체적·정신적 고통을 받았고, 복무 종료 후 귀국한 군인들이 [DISEASE_A]을 앓더라도 한동안 그 질병이 [PRODUCT_A]로 인해 발생했다는 점을 알기 어려웠다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] asserted rights against [ORGANIZATION_A] as a party on the side of the original owner of the land in this matter. [PERSON_B] was assessed for [PROPERTY_B], and [PROPERTY_A] was subsequently divided from [PROPERTY_B]. [ORGANIZATION_A] completed a registration of preservation of ownership of [PROPERTY_A] in its own name on May 25, 1988, and then sold it to [COMPANY_A]; [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] respectively completed registrations of transfer of ownership in their own names on November 7, 1994, and January 21, 2008. After [ORGANIZATION_A]'s registration of preservation of ownership, registrations of transfer of ownership were completed in the order of [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B]. [ORGANIZATION_A] asserted that [PROPERTY_A], as an appurtenant facility of farmland purchased by the government, had been purchased together with that farmland and that a registration of preservation of ownership had therefore been completed, but the fact that [PROPERTY_A] had been distributed together with that farmland was not confirmed, and at the time [ORGANIZATION_A] sold [PROPERTY_A] to [COMPANY_A] and completed the registration of transfer of ownership, ownership of [PROPERTY_A] had already reverted to the original owner. The official responsible for [ORGANIZATION_A] sold [PROPERTY_A] to [COMPANY_A] and completed the registration of transfer of ownership without confirming that ownership of [PROPERTY_A] had reverted to the original owner. It is presented that, if [ORGANIZATION_A] caused damage to the original owner by disposing of the farmland to a third party without confirming that it was required to complete a registration of transfer of ownership back to the original owner, damage would occur to the original owner.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]가 이 사건 토지의 원소유자 측 당사자로서 [ORGANIZATION_A]를 상대로 권리를 주장했다. [PERSON_B]는 [PROPERTY_B]를 사정받았고, 그 후 [PROPERTY_B]에서 [PROPERTY_A]가 분할되었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 1988년 5월 25일 [PROPERTY_A]에 관하여 자신의 명의로 소유권보존등기를 마친 뒤 [COMPANY_A]에 매도했으며, [COMPANY_A]는 1994년 11월 7일, [COMPANY_B]는 2008년 1월 21일 각각 자신의 명의로 소유권이전등기를 마쳤다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 소유권보존등기 후 [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B] 순서로 소유권이전등기가 이루어졌다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [PROPERTY_A]가 정부가 매수한 농지의 부속시설로서 해당 농지와 함께 매수되어 소유권보존등기가 이루어졌다고 주장했지만, [PROPERTY_A]가 해당 농지와 함께 분배되었다는 사실은 확인되지 않았고, [ORGANIZATION_A]가 [COMPANY_A]에 매도하여 소유권이전등기를 마칠 당시 [PROPERTY_A]의 소유권은 이미 원소유자에게 환원되어 있었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 담당공무원이 [PROPERTY_A]의 소유권이 원소유자에게 환원된 사실을 확인하지 않은 채 [COMPANY_A]에 매도하고 소유권이전등기를 해주었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]가 원소유자에게 다시 소유권이전등기를 해주어야 한다는 점을 확인하지 않은 채 해당 농지를 제3자에게 처분함으로써 원소유자에게 손해를 입혔다면, 원소유자에게 손해가 발생한다는 내용이 제시되어 있다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was cultivating perennial flowering crops within [LOCATION_A] using [PRODUCT_A]. [COMPANY_A] manufactured [PRODUCT_A]. During the fermentation process of [PRODUCT_A], gas was generated for 40 days or more, far exceeding the 15 to 20 days stated on the packaging as the period for ammonia gas generation. The roses cultivated by [PERSON_A] suffered damage, including withering, during the application and fermentation processes of [PRODUCT_A]. Prolonged exposure to the gas generated from [PRODUCT_A] was one of the major causes of the withering of [PERSON_A]'s roses. Unfermented organic fertilizer, which inevitably generates gases harmful to crop growth during the fermentation process, was unsuitable for use on perennial flowering crops that had already been planted and were growing within [LOCATION_A]. [PERSON_A] did not follow exactly the instructions for use stated on the packaging and elsewhere for [PRODUCT_A]. [COMPANY_A] supplied [PRODUCT_A] to [PERSON_A] through a sales distributor, and knew or could have known that [PERSON_A] would use [PRODUCT_A] to cultivate roses intended for shipment to the market.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [LOCATION_A] 내에서 [PRODUCT_A]를 사용하여 다년생 화훼작물을 재배하고 있었다. [COMPANY_A]가 [PRODUCT_A]를 제조하였다. [PRODUCT_A]의 발효과정에서 포장지에 명시된 암모니아 가스 발생기간인 15일 내지 20일을 훨씬 초과하여 40일 이상 가스가 발생하였다. [PERSON_A]가 재배하던 장미가 [PRODUCT_A]의 살포 및 발효과정에서 고사하는 등의 피해를 입었다. [PRODUCT_A]에서 발생한 가스에 장기간 노출된 것이 [PERSON_A]의 장미 고사의 주요 원인 중 하나였다. 발효과정에서 작물의 생육에 유해한 가스가 필연적으로 발생하는 미발효 유기질 비료는 [LOCATION_A] 내에 이미 심어져 생육 중인 다년생 화훼작물에 사용하기에 부적합하였다. [PERSON_A]는 [PRODUCT_A]의 포장지 등에 명시된 설명방법을 그대로 따르지 않았다. [COMPANY_A]는 판매대리점을 통하여 [PRODUCT_A]를 [PERSON_A]에게 공급했고, [PERSON_A]가 [PRODUCT_A]를 시장 출하를 전제로 한 장미 재배에 사용하리라는 사정을 알았거나 알 수 있었다.

neutral_en: In the project for supplying boiler equipment ordered by [COMPANY_C], [COMPANY_B], which formed a consortium with [COMPANY_A], entrusted [COMPANY_D] with arranging sea transportation for [PRODUCT_A]. [COMPANY_D] entered into three cargo transportation charterparty agreements with [COMPANY_E] for the transportation of [PRODUCT_A], and those agreements specified a condition under which the shipowner bears all costs and responsibilities during loading, stowage, and discharge (Full Berth Term, FBT), as well as freight terms. [COMPANY_E] entered into a charterparty agreement with [COMPANY_F], and [COMPANY_F] entered into a charterparty agreement with [COMPANY_G] on terms of Free In and Out, Stowed and Trimming (FIOST), under which the charterer bears the loading, discharging, stowage, and trimming costs. On January 11, 2013, after receiving [PRODUCT_A] from [COMPANY_A], [COMPANY_G] issued [DOCUMENT_A], identifying [COMPANY_A] as the shipper, [COMPANY_C] as the consignee, and [COMPANY_B] as the notify party. The terms on the reverse side of [DOCUMENT_A] included a provision that the carrier bears no responsibility for damage occurring before loading or after discharge, and a provision that the carrier’s performing assistants, agents, and subcontractors receive the same contractual protections and payment limits as the carrier. At [COMPANY_A]’s request, [COMPANY_G] took back [DOCUMENT_A], stamped “Surrender” on its face, and arranged for the goods to be delivered to the consignee without collecting the original. neutral_en: From around March 2004, [PERSON_B] held the position of chairperson of [ORGANIZATION_A], the business group to which [COMPANY_A] belonged, while serving as a director or representative director of [COMPANY_A]. [PERSON_A] served as the representative director of [COMPANY_A] from around July 2011 to around March 2016. Around the time the contract was concluded, [ORGANIZATION_A] had a circular shareholding structure in which [COMPANY_A] held shares in [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_B] held shares in [COMPANY_C], and [COMPANY_C] held shares in [COMPANY_A]. From around 2006 to around 2014, [COMPANY_A], as the major shareholder of [COMPANY_B], entered into about ten derivative contracts and some amendment agreements with [COMPANY_F], [COMPANY_G], and others, using [COMPANY_B] shares as the underlying assets, in order to maintain control. Under these contracts, the counterparties were to hold [COMPANY_B] shares during the contract period and exercise their voting rights in favor of [COMPANY_A], while [COMPANY_A] was to pay the agreed fees; at maturity, if the share price of [COMPANY_B] was lower than the reference price, [COMPANY_A] was to settle the loss with the counterparties, and if the share price was higher than the reference price, [COMPANY_A] was to receive settlement of all or part of the profit. Around January 2012, [ORGANIZATION_B] and [COMPANY_A] entered into a derivative contract under which [ORGANIZATION_B] would acquire and hold during the contract period the preferred shares left unsubscribed in [COMPANY_D]'s paid-in capital increase, [COMPANY_A] would pay the agreed fees, and at maturity, if [COMPANY_D]'s share price had fallen below the reference price, the loss would be settled, while if it had risen, part of the profit would be distributed. Around April 2014, the two sides entered into an amendment agreement strengthening the requirements for early termination of that contract. Under some of [COMPANY_A]'s contracts, if [COMPANY_B]'s share price fell below its level at the time the contract was concluded, [COMPANY_A] would bear all of the loss at maturity, and the agreed fees were excessive compared with [COMPANY_A]'s operating profit. [PERSON_B] knew the outlook for the shipping industry, [COMPANY_B]'s financial condition, and its share-price trend, among other matters, around the time the contract was concluded, and directly concluded the contract dated March 31, 2011 with [COMPANY_G] after receiving reports from the Strategic Planning Headquarters of [ORGANIZATION_A] and materials concerning items for the board of directors. At the time the contract was concluded, [COMPANY_A] was bearing considerable costs because of large fee payments and valuation losses arising from other derivative contracts, and the contract had a structure under which a substantial loss could arise if [COMPANY_D]'s share price fell at maturity. [COMPANY_A]'s directors reviewed the contract's profitability based only on materials evaluating the price of [COMPANY_D]'s preferred shares and the future share-price range around the time the contract was concluded, and then concluded the contract. Although the review materials indicated that the possibility was high that [COMPANY_D]'s share price would not exceed the break-even point, the directors expected profits from a rise in the share price. When existing derivative contracts had ended and a situation arose in which a large settlement amount had to be paid immediately to the counterparties, [COMPANY_A]'s representative director and directors concluded contracts that prevented termination of the contracts and extended their terms. They expected to reduce the negative effects of the financial risks resulting from termination of the existing contracts and future settlement losses, and the contract conclusion prevented an immediate large cash outflow, allowing the funds to be used for the company's operations.

neutral_en: At about 6:00 p.m. on February 3, 1997, [PERSON_A], a parking attendant employed by [COMPANY_A], entered [VEHICLE_A], owned by [COMPANY_B] and parked at [LOCATION_A], started it, and moved the transmission selector from park to drive. [VEHICLE_A] immediately moved forward, struck other parked vehicles and [PROPERTY_A] in sequence, and damaged several vehicles and part of the facility. [COMPANY_C] had manufactured [VEHICLE_A] in 1996. Before the incident, there was no known problem with the engine, transmission, brakes, or electronic control unit and no prior sudden-acceleration event; a post-incident inspection likewise found no component abnormality. [PERSON_A] alleged that the placement of the engine-control unit, absence of added electromagnetic shielding, and lack of electromagnetic-interference testing caused the movement. [COMPANY_C] raised the possibility that [PERSON_A] pressed the accelerator while shifting. The owner's manual instructed the driver to check pedal positions and keep the brake depressed while starting and shifting.

neutral_en: It is recorded that the accident occurred due to the acts of the operating crew of [PRODUCT_A]. The bodies of [PERSON_GROUP_A] were severely damaged by the fires and explosions that occurred after [PRODUCT_A] crashed. [PERSON_GROUP_B] experienced considerable difficulty while visiting several hospitals to identify and recover the bodies and remains of the deceased. Despite two DNA comparison tests, the bodies and remains could not be fully identified and recovered, and a funeral had to be held while unidentified body parts and remains remained in quantities far greater than the portions that had been identified. For more than five years after the accident, compensation was not properly provided due to differences between the positions of [PERSON_GROUP_B] and [COMPANY_A] regarding the amount of damages. [COMPANY_A] offered to pay special consolation money in addition to damages to the bereaved families of the deceased passengers, and some bereaved families accepted the offer and received settlement money.
neutral_ko: [PRODUCT_A]의 운항승무원들의 행위로 사고가 발생한 것으로 기록되어 있다. [PRODUCT_A]가 추락한 뒤 발생한 화재와 폭발로 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 신체가 심하게 손상되었다. [PERSON_GROUP_B]는 여러 병원을 다니며 사망자들의 시신과 유골을 확인하고 수습하는 데 상당한 곤란을 겪었다. 두 차례의 유전자(DNA) 대조검사에도 불구하고 시신과 유골을 온전히 확인·수습하지 못했으며, 신원이 확인되지 않은 시신 부분과 유골이 확인된 부분보다 훨씬 많이 남은 상태에서 장례를 치러야 했다. 사고 후 5년 이상이 지나도록 [PERSON_GROUP_B]와 [COMPANY_A] 측의 손해배상액에 관한 입장 차이로 손해보상이 제대로 이루어지지 않았다. neutral_en: At about 7:40 a.m. on October 3, 2006, in dense fog, [PERSON_A] drove a 25-ton [VEHICLE_A] into a slower one-ton [VEHICLE_B], left [VEHICLE_A] stopped in the second lane, and did not place a rear warning marker or take other safety measures. From 7:41 a.m., several vehicles collided in sequence and some occupants moved to the shoulder. At about 7:53 a.m., a cargo truck driven by [PERSON_B] struck a tanker stopped partly on the shoulder and partly in the third lane; exposed engine and frame components produced sparks that ignited fuel spilled from earlier vehicles. [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D], who had moved to the shoulder, became trapped among displaced vehicles and died from smoke inhalation or burns, while [PERSON_E], who had exited another vehicle and was on the roadway, also died from fire smoke. The initial collision, the stopped vehicle and missing warnings, and later drivers' failures to maintain lookout and following distance each contributed to the chain collisions and fire.
neutral_ko: 2006년 10월 3일 07시 40분경 짙은 안개 속에서 [PERSON_A]가 25톤 [VEHICLE_A]를 운전하다 앞서 서행하던 1톤 [VEHICLE_B]를 들이받고 [VEHICLE_A]를 2차로에 세워 둔 채 후방 경고표지 등 안전조치를 하지 않았다. 07시 41분부터 여러 차량이 연속해 충돌했고 일부 탑승자들은 갓길로 대피하였다. 07시 53분경 [PERSON_B]의 화물차가 갓길과 3차로에 걸쳐 있던 탱크로리를 들이받았고, 돌출된 엔진과 프레임에서 불꽃이 발생해 앞선 차량들에서 유출된 연료에 불이 붙었다. 갓길로 대피한 [PERSON_C]와 [PERSON_D]는 밀려난 차량들 사이에 갇혀 질식 또는 화상으로 사망했고, 다른 차량에서 내려 도로에 있던 [PERSON_E]도 화재 연기를 흡입해 사망하였다. 최초 충돌 뒤의 정차와 안전조치 부재, 이어진 운전자들의 전방주시 및 안전거리 부족이 연쇄충돌과 화재에 각각 기여하였다.

neutral_en: At around 21:00 on September 2, 2004, [PERSON_A] drank alcohol with university club members at a bar called [COMPANY_A], operated by [PERSON_B], on the second floor of a three-story building. When [PERSON_A] became intoxicated and behaved noisily, the people accompanying [PERSON_A] took [PERSON_A] down to the first floor through a door leading to an external staircase. At around 22:50 on the same day, [PERSON_A] entered the bar again through [PROPERTY_B] and picked a quarrel with [PERSON_B], and the two engaged in a mutually violent altercation, including [PERSON_B] hitting [PERSON_A] on the cheek twice. neutral_en: A fire occurred in a drinking establishment in 2012. Since about June 2011, a door and stacked beverage boxes had turned the passage connecting to a second emergency exit beside the main entrance into de facto storage and made passage difficult. During the fire, survivors escaped through the main entrance, but the people who died did not reach either the main entrance or the passage to the second exit and died after inhaling toxic gases in an interior corridor. The layout also made the second-exit sign difficult to see before reaching that corridor. The parties disputed whether the establishment operators, building safety manager, and fire-safety personnel adequately maintained the exit route, lighting, shutoff devices, training, and inspections, and whether an open second exit would have prevented the deaths.

neutral_en: [ORGANIZATION_A] is an unincorporated association whose purposes include projects such as missionary work, social education, social development, social welfare, and international cooperation, and since its establishment in 1903 it has carried out civic movements, environmental movements, movements to protect citizens' rights and interests, and youth movements. [ORGANIZATION_A] sometimes received financial support from government agencies, local governments, and others, and sometimes operated youth-related facilities, sports facilities, and others under entrusted arrangements. [ORGANIZATION_A] initially started as a men's organization corresponding to [ORGANIZATION_A], but when it revised its charter in 1967, it opened membership eligibility to women as well, and as of 2004, the number of female ordinary members exceeded the number of male ordinary members. A person who agreed with the purposes of [ORGANIZATION_A] could become a member through the membership admission procedure. According to the charter and membership regulations of [ORGANIZATION_A], general members with voting rights and other rights were selected from among baptized and confirmed members of Christian churches who had paid a certain membership fee, had participated in [ORGANIZATION_A]'s activities continuously for at least two years as members, and were of a certain age or older, following recommendation by the Membership Committee and deliberation and decision by the Board of Directors. However, the membership department of [ORGANIZATION_A] had entirely excluded female members from the list of general members on the ground that [ORGANIZATION_A] had started as a men's organization and had been maintained and operated as a men's organization, and female members were in practice unable to become general members. In the case of male members, if they satisfied the general requirements described above and had no special grounds for disqualification, they were selected as general members. In response to the demands of female members, [ORGANIZATION_A] decided at its regular general meeting on February 22, 2003, to establish a Special Charter Revision Committee and a Special Reform Committee, and adopted a resolution stating that women and men would participate in the decision-making process on equal terms, that women would be granted the right to vote and the right to stand for election, and that gender-discriminatory factors would be eliminated. The Special Committee for Women proposed that practical steps be taken so that female members could become general members, and the Special Charter Revision Committee submitted a revision proposal to the Board of Directors. The Board of Directors of [ORGANIZATION_A] regarded women's participation in the general meeting as a matter for charter revision and decided that it would be determined by a resolution of the general meeting. It also decided that if more than half of the voters supported recognizing women's participation in the general meeting, the matter would be reflected in the regular general meeting the following year through the charter revision procedure. At the regular general meeting on February 26, 2005, the charter revision proposal was approved as originally proposed, but the votes in favor of recognizing women's participation in the general meeting did not reach more than half of the voters. [PERSON_GROUP_A] sent documents to [ORGANIZATION_A] in 2003, 2004, and 2006 requesting general-member authority or requesting that procedures be carried out to grant general-member status, but had not been selected as general members by those times. As members of [ORGANIZATION_A], [PERSON_GROUP_A] paid membership fees, but continuously lacked the opportunity to exercise voting rights at general meetings and other rights because they were women. After not being selected as general members, [PERSON_GROUP_A] stopped paying membership fees after 2007. In this series of processes, [PERSON_GROUP_A] suffered mental harm. Around March 2004, 21 YMCAs in the Yeongnam and Honam regions recommended that [ORGANIZATION_A] grant female members general-member status. [ORGANIZATION_B] recommended on May 15, 2004, that general-member status be immediately granted to female members, and in June 2006 it resolved to implement withdrawal or equivalent sanctions if such status was not granted. In May 2004, [ORGANIZATION_C] confirmed that [ORGANIZATION_A] had excluded female members from voting rights at general meetings and other rights because they were women, and recommended that [ORGANIZATION_A] correct this. The National Assembly Gender Equality Forum, consisting of 83 lawmakers from governing and opposition parties, also expressed regret in May 2005 regarding [ORGANIZATION_A]'s discriminatory treatment and recommended prompt correction.
neutral_ko: [ORGANIZATION_A]는 선교, 사회교육, 사회개발, 사회복지, 국제협력 등의 사업을 목적으로 하는 비법인사단이며, 1903년 설립 이래 시민운동, 환경운동, 시민권익 보호운동, 청소년운동 등을 펼쳤다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 정부기관이나 지방정부 등으로부터 재정적 지원을 받기도 하고 청소년 관련시설이나 체육시설 등을 위탁받아 운영하기도 하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 당초 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 대칭되는 남성단체로 출발하였으나 1967년 헌장을 개정하면서 회원 자격을 여성에게도 개방하였고, 2004년 기준 여성 일반회원이 남성 일반회원보다 많았다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 목적에 찬동하는 자는 입회절차를 거쳐 회원이 될 수 있었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 헌장과 회원규정에 따르면, 의결권 등을 가지는 총회원은 일정한 회비를 납부하고 2년 이상 계속 회원으로서 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 활동에 참여한 일정 연령 이상의 기독교회 세례입교인 중 회원위원회의 추천과 이사회의 심의·결정을 거쳐 선정되었다. 그러나 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 회원부는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 남성단체로 출발하여 남성단체로 유지·운영되어 왔다는 점을 이유로 총회원 명단에서 여성회원들을 전부 제외해 왔고, 여성회원은 사실상 총회원이 될 수 없었다. 남성회원들의 경우에는 위와 같은 일반적 요건을 충족하고 특별한 결격사유가 없으면 총회원으로 선정되었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 여성회원들의 요구를 받아들여 2003년 2월 22일 정기총회에서 헌장개정특별위원회와 개혁특별위원회를 구성하기로 하고, 의사결정 과정에 여성과 남성이 동등한 자격으로 참여하며 여성에게 선거권과 피선거권을 부여하고 성차별적 요인을 해소하기로 하는 결의문을 채택하였다. 여성특별위원회는 여성회원이 총회원이 될 수 있도록 실무적으로 추진하자는 의견을 제시했고, 헌장개정특별위원회는 개정안을 이사회에 제출하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 이사회는 여성의 총회참여를 헌장개정 사안으로 보아 총회의 결의로 결정하기로 하였고, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 의견이 투표자의 과반수이면 다음 해 헌장개정절차를 거쳐 정기총회에 반영하기로 하였다. 2005년 2월 26일 정기총회에서 헌장개정안은 원안대로 가결되었으나, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 찬성표는 투표자의 과반수에 이르지 못하였다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 2003년, 2004년, 2006년에 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 총회원 권한을 요청하거나 총회원 자격 부여를 위한 절차 수행을 요청하는 서류를 보냈지만, 해당 시점까지 총회원으로 선정되지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 구성원으로서 회비를 부담했지만, 여성이라는 이유로 총회의결권 등을 행사할 기회를 지속적으로 갖지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 총회원으로 선정되지 못한 뒤 2007년 이후 회비 납부를 중단했다. 이러한 일련의 과정에서 [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 정신적 손해를 입었다. 2004년 3월경 영·호남지역 21개 YMCA는 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 부여하도록 권고하였다. [ORGANIZATION_B]은 2004년 5월 15일 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 즉시 부여하도록 권고하였고, 2006년 6월에는 자격을 부여하지 않을 경우 퇴회나 이에 준하는 제재조치를 실행하기로 결의하였다. [ORGANIZATION_C]는 2004년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 여성이라는 이유로 여성회원들의 총회의결권 등을 배제한 사실을 확인하고 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 시정을 권고하였다. 여야 국회의원 83명으로 구성된 국회양성포럼도 2005년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 차별적 처우에 대해 유감을 표명하고 신속한 시정을 권고하였다.
text: [ORGANIZATION_A]는 선교, 사회교육, 사회개발, 사회복지, 국제협력 등의 사업을 목적으로 하는 비법인사단이며, 1903년 설립 이래 시민운동, 환경운동, 시민권익 보호운동, 청소년운동 등을 펼쳤다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 당초 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 대칭되는 남성단체로 출발하였으나 1967년 헌장을 개정하면서 회원 자격을 여성에게도 개방하였고, 2004년 기준 여성 일반회원이 남성 일반회원보다 많았다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 목적에 찬동하는 자는 입회절차를 거쳐 회원이 될 수 있었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 헌장과 회원규정에 따르면, 의결권 등을 가지는 총회원은 일정한 회비를 납부하고 2년 이상 계속 회원으로서 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 활동에 참여한 일정 연령 이상의 기독교회 세례입교인 중 회원위원회의 추천과 이사회의 심의·결정을 거쳐 선정되었다. 그러나 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 회원부는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 남성단체로 출발하여 남성단체로 유지·운영되어 왔다는 점을 이유로 총회원 명단에서 여성회원들을 전부 제외해 왔고, 여성회원은 사실상 총회원이 될 수 없었다. 남성회원들의 경우에는 위와 같은 일반적 요건을 충족하고 특별한 결격사유가 없으면 총회원으로 선정되었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 여성회원들의 요구를 받아들여 2003년 2월 22일 정기총회에서 헌장개정특별위원회와 개혁특별위원회를 구성하기로 하고, 의사결정 과정에 여성과 남성이 동등한 자격으로 참여하며 여성에게 선거권과 피선거권을 부여하고 성차별적 요인을 해소하기로 하는 결의문을 채택하였다. 여성특별위원회는 여성회원이 총회원이 될 수 있도록 실무적으로 추진하자는 의견을 제시했고, 헌장개정특별위원회는 개정안을 이사회에 제출하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 이사회는 여성의 총회참여를 헌장개정 사안으로 보아 총회의 결의로 결정하기로 하였고, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 의견이 투표자의 과반수이면 다음 해 헌장개정절차를 거쳐 정기총회에 반영하기로 하였다. 2005년 2월 26일 정기총회에서 헌장개정안은 원안대로 가결되었으나, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 찬성표는 투표자의 과반수에 이르지 못하였다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 2003년, 2004년, 2006년에 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 총회원 권한을 요청하거나 총회원 자격 부여를 위한 절차 수행을 요청하는 서류를 보냈지만, 해당 시점까지 총회원으로 선정되지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 구성원으로서 회비를 부담했지만, 여성이라는 이유로 총회의결권 등을 행사할 기회를 지속적으로 갖지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 총회원으로 선정되지 못한 뒤 2007년 이후 회비 납부를 중단했다. 이러한 일련의 과정에서 [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 정신적 손해를 입었다. 2004년 3월경 영·호남지역 21개 YMCA는 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 부여하도록 권고하였다. [ORGANIZATION_B]은 2004년 5월 15일 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 즉시 부여하도록 권고하였고, 2006년 6월에는 자격을 부여하지 않을 경우 퇴회나 이에 준하는 제재조치를 실행하기로 결의하였다. [ORGANIZATION_C]는 2004년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 여성이라는 이유로 여성회원들의 총회의결권 등을 배제한 사실을 확인하고 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 시정을 권고하였다. 여야 국회의원 83명으로 구성된 국회양성포럼도 2005년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 차별적 처우에 대해 유감을 표명하고 신속한 시정을 권고하였다.

neutral_en: [ORGANIZATION_A] provided mutual-aid coverage for [VEHICLE_A], and [COMPANY_A] was the insurer for [VEHICLE_B] and [VEHICLE_C]. In January 2019, [VEHICLE_A] collided with [VEHICLE_B], and [VEHICLE_C] then struck [VEHICLE_B] while it was stopped after the first collision. The driver of [VEHICLE_C] died, passengers in [VEHICLE_C] were injured, and several vehicles were damaged. [COMPANY_A] paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] in connection with the death, injuries, and vehicle damage. In connection with an earlier dispute, [ORGANIZATION_A] paid [COMPANY_A] [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_D] and paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_E] in attorney fees. [ORGANIZATION_A] later alleged that the driving conduct of the driver of [VEHICLE_B] also contributed to the accident.
neutral_ko: [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [VEHICLE_A]에 관한 공제사업자였고, [COMPANY_A]는 [VEHICLE_B]와 [VEHICLE_C]에 관한 자동차보험계약을 체결한 보험자였다. 2019년 1월 [VEHICLE_A]가 [VEHICLE_B]와 충돌했고, 그 충돌 뒤 정차해 있던 [VEHICLE_B]를 [VEHICLE_C]가 다시 충격했다. 이 사고로 [VEHICLE_C]의 운전자가 사망하고 동승자들이 다쳤으며 여러 차량이 파손됐다. [COMPANY_A]는 사망, 부상 및 차량 손해와 관련하여 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]와 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]를 지급했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 앞선 분쟁과 관련하여 [COMPANY_A]에 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C]와 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_D]를 지급했고, 변호사비로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_E]를 지급했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 이후 [VEHICLE_B] 운전자의 운전행위도 사고 발생에 영향을 미쳤다고 주장했다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] entered into an agreement with [PERSON_A], the owner of [PROPERTY_A], to receive a first-priority collateral mortgage over [PROPERTY_A], and thereafter [COMPANY_B] also entered into a collateral mortgage agreement with [PERSON_A] concerning [PROPERTY_A]. [COMPANY_B] applied for registration of the creation of the collateral mortgage with [INSTITUTION_A] at around 16:00 on July 29, 1996, before [COMPANY_A] did so, and [COMPANY_A] applied for registration of the creation of the collateral mortgage with the same [INSTITUTION_A] at around 10:00 on July 30, 1996. [PERSON_B] discovered that the registration certificate for [PROPERTY_A] was not attached to [COMPANY_B]'s registration application, while that certificate was available with [COMPANY_A]'s registration application, but used the registration certificate attached to [COMPANY_A]'s application for [COMPANY_B]'s application and completed the registrations of creation of the collateral mortgages, with [COMPANY_B] having priority and [COMPANY_A] having the lower priority, without separately ordering a correction or rejecting the applications. Thereafter, [COMPANY_B] applied for a voluntary auction of [PROPERTY_A] based on the collateral mortgage, and in the auction procedure [INSTITUTION_B] preferentially distributed part of the auction proceeds to [COMPANY_B] on the ground that [COMPANY_B] was a higher-priority collateral mortgagee than [COMPANY_A]. [COMPANY_A] suffered property damage because it did not receive a distribution in the voluntary auction procedure concerning [PROPERTY_A]. As a result of [PERSON_B] overlooking the defect in the registration application and processing the registration using a registration certificate attached to another application, [COMPANY_B]'s registration of the creation of the collateral mortgage was completed first, [COMPANY_A]'s registration became lower in priority, and because of that priority, [COMPANY_A] did not receive a distribution in the voluntary auction procedure concerning [PROPERTY_A].
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_A]는 [PROPERTY_A] 소유자인 [PERSON_A]와 [PROPERTY_A]에 관하여 1순위 근저당권을 설정받기로 하는 계약을 체결했고, 그 후 [COMPANY_B]도 [PERSON_A]와 [PROPERTY_A]에 관한 근저당권설정계약을 체결했다. [COMPANY_B]는 [COMPANY_A]보다 앞서 1996년 7월 29일 16시경 [INSTITUTION_A]에 근저당권설정등기를 신청했고, [COMPANY_A]는 1996년 7월 30일 10시경 같은 [INSTITUTION_A]에 근저당권설정등기를 신청했다. [PERSON_B]는 [COMPANY_B]의 등기신청서에는 [PROPERTY_A]에 관한 등기필증이 첨부되지 않았고 [COMPANY_A]의 등기신청서에는 그 등기필증이 구비되어 있음을 발견했지만, [COMPANY_A]의 신청서에 첨부된 등기필증을 [COMPANY_B]의 신청에 사용했고, 별도로 보정을 명하거나 신청을 각하하지 않은 채 [COMPANY_B]를 선순위로, [COMPANY_A]를 후순위로 하여 각 근저당권설정등기를 완료했다. 그 후 [COMPANY_B]가 해당 근저당권에 기초하여 [PROPERTY_A]에 대한 임의경매를 신청했고, 경매절차에서 [INSTITUTION_B]는 [COMPANY_B]가 [COMPANY_A]보다 선순위 근저당권자라는 이유로 경락대금 중 일부를 [COMPANY_B]에 우선 배당했다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PROPERTY_A]에 대한 임의경매절차에서 배당을 받지 못해 재산상 손해를 입었다. [PERSON_B]가 등기신청상의 흠결을 간과하고 다른 신청에 첨부된 등기필증을 사용해 등기를 처리한 결과, [COMPANY_B]의 근저당권설정등기가 먼저 완료되고 [COMPANY_A]의 등기는 후순위가 되었으며, 그 순위 때문에 [COMPANY_A]는 [PROPERTY_A]의 임의경매절차에서 배당을 받지 못했다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_B]'s sales revenue had decreased substantially from the previous year, it was difficult to cover financial expenses with operating profit, and its financial structure and operating condition were extremely poor, including borrowings at the end of 1995 greatly exceeding sales revenue. In [ORGANIZATION_B]'s credit assessment of [COMPANY_B] at the end of 1995, [COMPANY_B] received a score of 42, and [COMPANY_C]'s internal business regulations classified it as an E-grade company for which credit loans and financing were prohibited. [COMPANY_C] acquired private-placement bonds issued by [COMPANY_B] without a reliable plan to secure the receivable, and prior approval by the representative director was not obtained in the process. As a result, [COMPANY_C] was unable to recover the acquisition price of the private-placement bonds issued by [COMPANY_B], and a loss occurred. When [COMPANY_C] lent an amount equivalent to [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] to [COMPANY_B], a company prohibited from receiving financing like [COMPANY_B], it obtained only [PERSON_B]'s personal joint guarantee without collateral to ensure definite recovery, and thereafter a loss occurred because the acquisition price could not be recovered. [PERSON_A] did not attend the board meeting and subsequently ratified the board resolution.
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_B]는 전년도보다 매출액이 크게 감소했고 영업이익으로 금융비용을 감당하기 어려웠으며, 1995년 말 차입금이 매출액을 크게 초과하는 등 재무구조와 영업상태가 매우 불량했다. 1995년 말 [ORGANIZATION_B]의 신용평가에서 [COMPANY_B]는 42점을 받았고, [COMPANY_C]의 내부 업무규정에서는 이를 신용대출과 융자가 금지되는 E급 업체로 분류했다. [COMPANY_C]는 확실한 채권확보대책 없이 [COMPANY_B]가 발행한 사모사채를 인수했고, 그 과정에서 대표이사의 사전결재는 이루어지지 않았다. [COMPANY_C]는 그 결과 [COMPANY_B]가 발행한 사모사채의 인수대금을 회수하지 못했고 손해가 발생했다. neutral_en: The parties are [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B], [ORGANIZATION_A], and the medical staff affiliated with it. At [INSTITUTION_A], non-stress tests using a fetal monitor were conducted twice from around 11:36 to around 13:40 on the same day. When leaving work at around 18:50 on the same day, [PERSON_D] instructed [PERSON_E] to observe the condition of [PERSON_A] and the fetus using a fetal monitor and to make contact by telephone if there was anything abnormal. From around 19:50 to around 22:00 on the same day, [PERSON_E] continuously observed the condition of [PERSON_A] and the fetus by attaching a fetal monitor to [PERSON_A]'s abdomen. [PERSON_F] observed the condition of [PERSON_A] and the fetus until handing them over to [PERSON_G] and [PERSON_H] at around 07:00 on November 26, 1998, and the medical staff of [INSTITUTION_A] observed the condition using a fetal monitor from immediately after [PERSON_A]'s admission until at least around 08:50 the following day, excluding mealtimes. The nursing progress records of [INSTITUTION_A] recorded the heart rate of the surviving fetus at around 09:30 on the same day, and the delivery records stated that the surviving fetus was monitored during the cesarean section. No material was identified indicating that hypoxia or severe fetal distress had occurred before [PERSON_A] gave birth to [PERSON_B] at [INSTITUTION_A], and the fetal heart rate and variability, which had temporarily decreased before the cesarean section, recovered. At [PERSON_D]'s instruction, [PERSON_F] injected morphine into [PERSON_A] and temporarily discontinued the oxygen supply. Before [PERSON_A] visited [INSTITUTION_A], an opinion was presented that there was a high possibility that the surviving fetus had sustained irreversible brain damage due to the death of one of the twins, and [PERSON_B] developed cerebral palsy.

[PERSON_F]는 1998. 11. 26. 07:00경 [PERSON_G]와 [PERSON_H]에게 인계할 때까지 [PERSON_A]와 태아의 상태를 관찰했고, [INSTITUTION_A]의 의료진은 [PERSON_A]가 입원한 직후부터 식사시간을 제외하고 적어도 다음날 08:50경까지 태아감시장치로 상태를 관찰하였다. [INSTITUTION_A]의 간호진행기록지에는 같은 날 09:30경 생존 태아의 심박동수가 기재되어 있었고, 분만기록지에는 제왕절개술 시행 중 생존 태아를 감시한 것으로 기재되어 있었다. [PERSON_A]가 [INSTITUTION_A]에 입원하여 [PERSON_B]를 분만하기 전까지 태아의 저산소증이나 심각한 태아곤란증이 발생했다는 자료는 확인되지 않았고, 제왕절개술 전 일시적으로 감소한 태아 심박동과 변동성은 다시 회복되었다. [PERSON_F]는 [PERSON_D]의 지시로 [PERSON_A]에게 모르핀을 주사하고 산소공급을 일시적으로 중단하였다. [PERSON_A]가 [INSTITUTION_A]에 내원하기 전에 쌍태아 중 한 태아의 사망으로 생존 태아에게 비가역적인 뇌손상이 발생했을 가능성이 크다는 의견이 제시되었고, [PERSON_B]에게 뇌성마비가 발생하였다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] hired [COMPANY_B] in 2004 to relocate a gas pipeline on a large tract of wooded, unimproved land. On August 7, 2004, [COMPANY_B] drove a small bulldozer, with its blade raised off the ground, through an area containing grave sites. It was alleged that the graves were not indicated on any map, identified in a deed, marked by an obvious sign, included on a government-maintained list, or otherwise reasonably identifiable as an area containing graves. [COMPANY_B] contended that the area was significantly overgrown, contained mostly unmarked grave sites, and had some grave markers buried in forest debris. After the bulldozer operator realized that the bulldozer had passed through the grave-site area, he immediately blocked off the area and relocated the route to connect with the pipeline at a different location. Six affected people claimed that their decedent was buried directly beneath the bulldozer's path, and two others stated that they believed their decedent could be buried beneath that path; however, the affected people' expert was unable to locate a grave shaft directly under the path.
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_A]는 2004년에 숲이 있고 개발되지 않은 넓은 토지에서 가스관을 이전하도록 [COMPANY_B]를 고용했다. 2004년 8월 7일, [COMPANY_B]는 블레이드를 지면에서 들어 올린 상태로 소형 불도저를 묘지가 있는 구역을 통과해 운전했다. 관련 당사자들은 해당 묘지들이 어떤 지도에도 표시되어 있지 않았고, 증서에도 명시되어 있지 않았으며, 눈에 띄는 표지로 표시되어 있지 않았고, 정부가 관리하는 목록에도 포함되어 있지 않았으며, 그 밖에도 묘지가 있는 구역으로 합리적으로 식별할 수 없었다고 주장했다. [COMPANY_B]는 해당 구역이 잡초와 초목이 크게 무성했고, 대부분 표시되지 않은 묘지로 이루어져 있었으며, 일부 묘지 표지가 숲의 잔해에 묻혀 있었다고 주장했다. 불도저 운전자는 불도저가 묘지 구역을 통과했다는 것을 깨달은 후 즉시 해당 구역을 차단하고, 다른 위치에서 가스관과 연결되도록 경로를 변경했다. 관련 가족 6명은 각자의 고인이 불도저의 경로 바로 아래에 묻혀 있었다고 주장했고, 다른 가족 2명은 각자의 고인이 그 경로 아래에 묻혀 있을 수 있다고 믿는다고 진술했다. 그러나 관련 피해자들의 전문가는 그 경로 바로 아래에서 묘혈을 찾지 못했다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a tenant at [PROPERTY_A], a complex owned by [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B]. On June 25, 1999, after returning home from work, [PERSON_A] took [ANIMAL_A] for a walk around the apartment complex. During the walk, [PERSON_A] and [ANIMAL_A] traversed a sidewalk in a common area of the complex. The grass strip was approximately 3.35 meters wide and was elevated above the parking lot approximately 1.22 meters. The grass strip was supported laterally by a white brick retaining wall, and there was no fence or other structure along the edge of the retaining wall. As [PERSON_A] and [ANIMAL_A] walked along the sidewalk, a girl in a nearby apartment unexpectedly let [ANIMAL_B] out of her apartment. [ANIMAL_B] were larger than [ANIMAL_A], and they rushed toward [PERSON_A] and [ANIMAL_A] snarling and snapping. [PERSON_A] quickly retreated backwards to pull [ANIMAL_A] away from the attacking [ANIMAL_B]. [PERSON_A] moved off of the sidewalk and across the grass strip. In her haste, she backed up to the edge of the grass strip, stumbled over the edge of the retaining wall, and fell onto the parking lot below. After falling onto the parking lot below, [PERSON_A] suffered fractures to a rib, a hip, and a femur. Construction of the retaining wall had been completed in 1987, and the retaining wall had remained structurally unchanged since that time. [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] were not the original owners of the apartment complex. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] had failed to design, build, and maintain a reasonably safe retaining wall and had failed to warn her about the hazard. [PERSON_A] alleged medical expenses of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], as well as loss of income and pain and suffering, resulting from the incident. [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] characterized the retaining wall as an improvement completed more than ten years before [PERSON_A]'s injury.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]가 소유한 단지인 [PROPERTY_A]의 임차인이었다. 1999년 6월 25일, [PERSON_A]는 직장에서 집으로 돌아온 후 [ANIMAL_A]를 데리고 아파트 단지 주변을 산책했다. 산책 중 [PERSON_A]와 [ANIMAL_A]는 단지의 공용 구역에 있는 보도를 지나갔다. 잔디 띠의 너비는 약 3.35미터였고 주차장보다 약 1.22미터 높았다. 잔디 띠의 측면은 흰색 벽돌 옹벽으로 지지되어 있었으며, 옹벽의 가장자리를 따라 울타리나 다른 구조물은 없었다. [PERSON_A]와 [ANIMAL_A]가 보도를 따라 걷고 있을 때, 인근 아파트에 있던 한 소녀가 갑자기 자신의 아파트에서 [ANIMAL_B]를 내보냈다. [ANIMAL_B]는 [ANIMAL_A]보다 컸고, 으르렁거리며 이빨을 드러낸 채 [PERSON_A]와 [ANIMAL_A]를 향해 달려들었다. [PERSON_A]는 공격하는 [ANIMAL_B]로부터 [ANIMAL_A]를 떼어 놓기 위해 재빨리 뒤로 물러났다. [PERSON_A]는 보도에서 벗어나 잔디 띠를 가로질러 이동했다. 서두르던 중 [PERSON_A]는 잔디 띠의 가장자리까지 뒤로 물러났고, 옹벽 가장자리에 걸려 아래 주차장으로 떨어졌다. 아래 주차장으로 떨어진 후, [PERSON_A]는 갈비뼈, 엉덩관절 및 대퇴골에 골절을 입었다. 옹벽의 건설은 1987년에 완료되었고, 옹벽은 그때부터 구조적으로 변경되지 않은 상태로 유지되었다. [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]는 아파트 단지의 최초 소유자가 아니었다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]가 합리적으로 안전한 옹벽을 설계하고 건설하며 유지관리하지 못했고, 자신에게 위험을 경고하지 못했다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 해당 사건으로 인해 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]의 의료비와 소득 손실 및 고통과 고생이 발생했다고 주장했다. [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]는 해당 옹벽을 [PERSON_A]의 부상 발생 시점보다 10년 넘게 전에 완공된 개선 시설로 규정했다.

On the same day, [COMPANY_A] filed an employer's report of the injury with [INSTITUTION_A]. [PERSON_A] was aware of the injury and of [PERSON_B]'s report to [COMPANY_A]'s personnel director. In June 1992, when [PERSON_C] asked [PERSON_A] whether he knew about [PERSON_B]'s pending workers' compensation claim, [PERSON_A] said that he knew nothing about a filed claim but knew about the incident and [PERSON_B]'s report. [PERSON_B] initially agreed to sign it, but later declined to execute the release after [PERSON_A] told him that he need not sign it. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] owned and operated [COMPANY_A], a wholesale fresh fish business. [PERSON_B], through [COMPANY_B], owned a cold-storage facility and leased part of it to [PERSON_A] under a two-year agreement that expired in December 2000; the agreement permitted entry for inspection or maintenance at reasonable times. On August 21, 2000, while [PERSON_A] was away, [PERSON_C], [PERSON_B]’s property manager, attempted to contact [PERSON_A] after becoming concerned that the premises might have been abandoned; the call was unsuccessful, and [PERSON_C] hired a locksmith to drill out and replace the storage-unit locks. When the locksmith opened the storage unit, [PERSON_C] directed the locksmith to cut the alarm wires; the audible alarm was disabled, the electricity was verified to be on, and the locksmith secured the unit with new keys. On August 23, 2000, [PERSON_A] discovered that the locks had been changed and that inventory worth between [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]30,000 and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]45,000 was missing; alarm records showed an unaccounted-for entry that morning. [PERSON_A] received [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]33,084 under an insurance policy for the lost inventory. [PERSON_A] stated that the supply disruption led to the demise of [COMPANY_A] in October 2000, approximately two months before the lease expired. After the business’s demise, [PERSON_A] stopped paying rent, removed the remaining inventory, and vacated the storage unit. Evidence showed that after the locks were changed, [PERSON_B]’s representatives were the only people with access to the storage unit, and the inventory was removed during that period of exclusive control.

[PERSON_A]은 분실된 재고에 대한 보험 계약에 따라 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]33,084를 지급받았다. [PERSON_A]은 공급 중단으로 인해 임대차 계약이 만료되기 약 두 달 전인 2000년 10월에 [COMPANY_A]가 몰락했다고 진술했다. 사업체가 몰락한 후, [PERSON_A]은 임대료 지급을 중단하고 남아 있던 재고를 반출했으며 보관 유닛을 비웠다. 증거에 따르면 자물쇠가 교체된 후 [PERSON_B]의 대표자들만 보관 유닛에 출입할 수 있었고, 재고는 그들이 독점적으로 통제하던 기간에 반출되었다.

neutral_en: On January 26, 1991, [PERSON_A] was a passenger in [VEHICLE_A], which was operated by [PERSON_B]. [PERSON_A] sustained serious injuries resulting in quadriplegia. [PERSON_A] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to shield the steep embankment with a guardrail at the accident location and failed to properly design, construct, and maintain the highway. [PERSON_A] further alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to comply with accepted industry or government standards for highway design, construction, maintenance, repair, and guarding; failed to replace previously existing guardrails that had been removed; failed to flatten the severe embankment; and failed to comply with its own and federal highway design and maintenance rules. [PERSON_A] alleged that prevailing engineering standards required guardrails at this location because of the road's curvature and the proximity of [LOCATION_B]. [PERSON_A] alleged that, without a guardrail, an occupant of a vehicle leaving the paved surface would suffer more serious injuries by traveling down [LOCATION_B] than if a guardrail halted the impact. neutral_en: In August 2008, after an evening of alcohol and drug use, [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] with [PERSON_B] as a passenger and crashed into a pole. [PERSON_B] went to an emergency department that morning with hip pain, but the medical history described an injury while preventing a friend from falling down stairs, and an x-ray showed no fracture. [PERSON_B] said he followed that account after a relative of [PERSON_A] asked him to conceal the crash. Continued pain led to further treatment; on September 15, 2009, [PERSON_B] was diagnosed with a hip fracture and ultimately underwent total hip replacement. [PERSON_A] denied being the driver, but a witness reported that a person matching [PERSON_A]'s description left the scene, and [PERSON_A]'s spouse admitted that a vehicle-theft report was false. Clinicians said this type of fracture was consistent with a motor-vehicle collision and could be missed on an initial x-ray, but they could not identify its precise cause.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was [PERSON_B]'s daughter. On March 30, 1996, two-and-a-half-year-old [PERSON_A] fell from a second-floor window of her apartment building and landed on a first-floor balcony. After the fall, [PERSON_A] was treated for a depressed skull fracture, a hematoma of the upper eyelid, a forehead laceration, a left nondisplaced frontal fracture, and a broken left arm and wrist. [PERSON_B] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to properly maintain and repair the window screen in [PERSON_A]'s bedroom and that this caused [PERSON_A]'s injuries. [PERSON_B] testified that around noon on the date of the accident, she put [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_A]'s five-year-old sister down for a nap, opened one bedroom window because the air-conditioning unit in the other window was not working, and went to her own bedroom to sleep. [PERSON_B] testified that 30–45 minutes later, her older daughter screamed that [PERSON_A] had fallen out of the bedroom window; [PERSON_B] entered the bedroom, saw the screen hanging from the top to one side, and saw [PERSON_A] lying on the first-floor balcony below. [PERSON_B] testified that no screen had been on the window for the eight to nine years she lived in the apartment, and that an [ORGANIZATION_A] employee named [PERSON_D] installed a screen two to three days before the accident after she requested one. [PERSON_B] acknowledged signing an [ORGANIZATION_A] work order dated November 25, 1995 for screen installation, approximately five months before the accident. [PERSON_B] testified that the screen appeared properly installed when she opened the window, that she did not know whether it was locked at the bottom before the accident, and that she had not notified [ORGANIZATION_A] that it was improperly installed. [PERSON_C] testified that she saw [PERSON_A] fall out of the window but did not see what caused the fall because [PERSON_A] was already coming out of the window when she looked up. [PERSON_D] testified that the screen was installed on November 25, 1995 by a maintenance crew brought in from other housing developments. [PERSON_D] testified that the maintenance file contained no [ORGANIZATION_A] work request or order from March 1996, that he did not recall installing the screen, and that an order bearing his name would have existed if he had installed it. [PERSON_E] testified that the screens were intended to be decorative and to keep insects out when the window was raised, not to prevent children from falling out. [PERSON_E] testified that the screens fit into two slats on the outside of the window casing and were held in place by two hooks that went over two small pins; he also testified that a maintenance ticket indicated installation in November 1995. [PERSON_E] testified that he never inspected the particular window screen, and a new screen was installed the day after the accident. [PERSON_A]'s treating physician testified that he treated her for excessive bed-wetting on March 5, 1998, believed it was caused by continued urinary tract infections associated with poor hygiene, and testified that the lack of blood in her urine and the [LOCATION_JURISDICTION]-scan results indicated no urinary-tract trauma from the fall.

text: [PERSON_A] was [PERSON_B]'s daughter. On March 30, 1996, two-and-a-half-year-old [PERSON_A] fell from a second-floor window of her apartment building and landed on a first-floor balcony. After the fall, [PERSON_A] was treated for a depressed skull fracture, a hematoma of the upper eyelid, a forehead laceration, a left nondisplaced frontal fracture, and a broken left arm and wrist. [PERSON_B] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to properly maintain and repair the window screen in [PERSON_A]'s bedroom and that this caused [PERSON_A]'s injuries. [PERSON_B] testified that around noon on the date of the accident, she put [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_A]'s five-year-old sister down for a nap, opened one bedroom window because the air-conditioning unit in the other window was not working, and went to her own bedroom to sleep. [PERSON_B] testified that 30–45 minutes later, her older daughter screamed that [PERSON_A] had fallen out of the bedroom window; [PERSON_B] entered the bedroom, saw the screen hanging from the top to one side, and saw [PERSON_A] lying on the first-floor balcony below. [PERSON_B] testified that no screen had been on the window for the eight to nine years she lived in the apartment, and that an [ORGANIZATION_A] employee named [PERSON_D] installed a screen two to three days before the accident after she requested one. [PERSON_B] acknowledged signing an [ORGANIZATION_A] work order dated November 25, 1995 for screen installation, approximately five months before the accident. [PERSON_B] testified that the screen appeared properly installed when she opened the window, that she did not know whether it was locked at the bottom before the accident, and that she had not notified [ORGANIZATION_A] that it was improperly installed. [PERSON_C] testified that she saw [PERSON_A] fall out of the window but did not see what caused the fall because [PERSON_A] was already coming out of the window when she looked up. [PERSON_D] testified that the screen was installed on November 25, 1995 by a maintenance crew brought in from other housing developments. [PERSON_D] testified that the maintenance file contained no [ORGANIZATION_A] work request or order from March 1996, that he did not recall installing the screen, and that an order bearing his name would have existed if he had installed it. [PERSON_E] testified that the screens were intended to be decorative and to keep insects out when the window was raised, not to prevent children from falling out. [PERSON_E] testified that the screens fit into two slats on the outside of the window casing and were held in place by two hooks that went over two small pins; he also testified that a maintenance ticket indicated installation in November 1995. [PERSON_E] testified that he never inspected the particular window screen, and a new screen was installed the day after the accident. [PERSON_A]'s treating physician testified that he treated her for excessive bed-wetting on March 5, 1998, believed it was caused by continued urinary tract infections associated with poor hygiene, and testified that the lack of blood in her urine and the [LOCATION_JURISDICTION]-scan results indicated no urinary-tract trauma from the fall.

neutral_en: On 28 May 1993, [PERSON_A] was a passenger in a truck driven by her husband. Her husband parked the truck next to the curb on [LOCATION_A]. [PERSON_A] exited from the passenger side onto the grass between the street curb and the sidewalk, walked the length of the truck, and stepped off the curb onto the paved roadway. [PERSON_A] alleged that she stepped on cracked and broken pavement on the surface of [LOCATION_A]. [PERSON_A] sustained serious injuries to her right ankle and required several operations. [PERSON_A] alleged that stepping on the cracked and broken pavement caused the serious injuries to her right ankle. On 18 May 1992, [PERSON_C] sustained serious injuries in an automobile accident at the intersection of [LOCATION_B] and [LOCATION_C]. Traffic traveling eastbound and westbound on [LOCATION_B] was not required to stop, but posted signs warned of the approaching intersection. Both [LOCATION_B] and [LOCATION_C] had posted speed-limit signs of 88.5 km/h. [PERSON_C] was driving northbound on [LOCATION_C]. After stopping at the stop signs, [PERSON_C] entered the intersection and collided with a westbound car traveling on [LOCATION_B], which had the right of way. [PERSON_C] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_B] should have installed additional stop signs or traffic signals at the intersection. [PERSON_C] testified that he retained no memory of the accident or the surrounding circumstances. [PERSON_C]'s expert witness declined to express an opinion about whether installing stop signs or traffic signals in all four directions would have prevented the accident.
neutral_ko: 1993년 5월 28일, [PERSON_A]는 남편이 운전하는 트럭의 승객이었다. 남편은 [LOCATION_A]의 연석 옆에 트럭을 주차했다. [PERSON_A]는 승객석 쪽에서 도로 연석과 보도 사이의 잔디로 내린 뒤, 트럭의 길이를 따라 걸어 연석에서 포장된 차도로 내려섰다. [PERSON_A]는 [LOCATION_A] 표면의 갈라지고 깨진 포장 부분을 밟았다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 오른쪽 발목에 중상을 입었고 여러 차례 수술이 필요했다. [PERSON_A]는 갈라지고 깨진 포장 부분을 밟은 것이 오른쪽 발목의 중상을 초래했다고 주장했다. 1992년 5월 18일, [PERSON_C]는 [LOCATION_B]와 [LOCATION_C]의 교차로에서 발생한 자동차 사고로 중상을 입었다. [LOCATION_B]에서 동쪽 및 서쪽으로 이동하는 차량은 정지할 필요가 없었지만, 게시된 표지판은 교차로가 다가오고 있음을 경고했다. [LOCATION_B]와 [LOCATION_C]에는 모두 시속 88.5 km의 제한속도 표지판이 게시되어 있었다. [PERSON_C]는 [LOCATION_C]에서 북쪽으로 운전하고 있었다. [PERSON_C]는 정지 표지판에서 정지한 후 교차로에 진입했고, [LOCATION_B]에서 서쪽으로 이동하던 통행 우선권이 있는 차량과 충돌했다. [PERSON_C]는 [ORGANIZATION_B]가 해당 교차로에 추가 정지 표지판이나 교통 신호를 설치했어야 한다고 주장했다. neutral_en: In December 2010, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] became guardians of their grandchild, [PERSON_C], who lived with them at [LOCATION_A]. An initial document prepared by [ORGANIZATION_A] alleged that [PERSON_F] used violence in front of another child and failed to provide the children with necessary hygiene, food, clothing, supervision, and housing. The document listed [LOCATION_A] as [PERSON_C]'s address but did not identify [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] as guardians. The same day, [INSTITUTION_A] authorized [ORGANIZATION_A] to take temporary care of the children, although [PERSON_C] continued living with the two guardians. Four days later, personnel from [ORGANIZATION_A] directed [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] to bring [PERSON_C] to a scheduled meeting; when they arrived, [ORGANIZATION_A] removed [PERSON_C] from them and began providing custody. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] knew of their guardianship and knew [PERSON_C] was receiving adequate care in their home, yet omitted those facts from the initial document and induced them to bring the child without clearly disclosing the planned custody change, causing separation and emotional harm. [ORGANIZATION_A] disputed this, stating that it told them about abuse and neglect information concerning the home and the temporary custody change and that they later received the relevant documents and had an opportunity to respond.
neutral_ko: 2010년 12월 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 손자녀 [PERSON_C]의 후견을 맡았고, [PERSON_C]는 두 사람과 [LOCATION_A]에서 살았다. [ORGANIZATION_A]가 작성한 초기 문서에는 [PERSON_F]가 다른 자녀 앞에서 폭력을 행사하고 자녀들에게 필요한 위생, 음식, 의복, 감독과 주거를 제공하지 않았다는 내용이 있었고, [PERSON_C]의 주소로 [LOCATION_A]가 적혀 있었지만 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]가 후견인이라는 점은 표시되지 않았다. 같은 날 [INSTITUTION_A]는 자녀들을 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 임시로 보호하도록 정했으나 [PERSON_C]는 계속 두 후견인과 지냈다. 나흘 뒤 [ORGANIZATION_A] 직원들은 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]에게 [PERSON_C]를 데리고 예정된 모임에 오라고 했고, 도착하자 [PERSON_C]를 두 사람에게서 데려가 보호하기 시작했다. [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 자신들의 후견관계와 [PERSON_C]가 집에서 적절히 돌봄받고 있다는 사실을 알고도 이를 초기 문서에서 빠뜨리고, 보호 변경 계획을 분명히 알리지 않은 채 아이를 데려오게 하여 분리와 정서적 손상을 초래했다고 주장하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 집에 관한 학대·방임 정보와 임시 보호 변경을 두 사람에게 알렸으며, 두 사람이 이후 관련 문서를 받고 의견을 제출할 기회도 가졌다고 다투었다.

neutral_en: In May 1991, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_E] purchased a used [PRODUCT_A] from a dealership. In addition to gasoline propulsion engines, [PRODUCT_A] contained a small [PRODUCT_B] that powered its accessories, including the [PRODUCT_C]. On May 29, 1993, during a weekend cruise at [LOCATION_A], [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] secured [PRODUCT_A] alongside a beach, went to sleep in its cabin, and left [PRODUCT_B] running to power [PRODUCT_C]. The next morning, [PERSON_F], a friend staying at the beach, knocked on the cabin door and received no response; later that afternoon, [PERSON_F] boarded [PRODUCT_A] and found [PERSON_A] dead and [PERSON_B] barely breathing. [PERSON_F] testified that the engines were not running during either check, and a subsequent investigation identified [PRODUCT_B], rather than the engines, as the source of the carbon monoxide, which is tasteless and odorless. [PERSON_A] died and [PERSON_B] suffered catastrophic injuries from carbon monoxide poisoning during an overnight outing in [PRODUCT_A] at [LOCATION_A]. The injuries suffered by [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] were caused by odorless and tasteless carbon monoxide fumes from [PRODUCT_B], which powered [PRODUCT_C], rather than by exhaust fumes. Two warnings about carbon monoxide poisoning accompanied the sale of this type of [PRODUCT_A] in 1981: one was written by [ORGANIZATION_A], the generator manufacturer, and the other by [ORGANIZATION_B]. [COMPANY_A] also provided purchasers with other manuals. Both warnings primarily addressed carbon monoxide exposure from engine exhaust. When [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_E] purchased [PRODUCT_A], the dealership service manager, [PERSON_G], and salesperson, [PERSON_H], warned them about exhaust fumes and carbon monoxide and the need to ventilate [PRODUCT_A] to remove hazardous fumes. [PERSON_G] and [PERSON_H] demonstrated flow-through ventilation by opening a window and the hatch, explained that the rear door should remain open when the main propulsion engines were running, and [PERSON_G] stated that idling the engine with the front hatch closed could cause carbon monoxide to accumulate. [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], and [PERSON_D] alleged that "migrating carbon monoxide" caused the incident when carbon monoxide safely exhausted from [PRODUCT_B] into the open air was blown back into [PRODUCT_A] by wind and entered the passenger cabin through small openings. [COMPANY_A]'s expert agreed with this causal explanation but testified that the phenomenon was rare and that ventilation in the passenger cabin had to be obstructed for carbon monoxide to accumulate to dangerous levels. The expert identified three precautions: posting a watch because carbon monoxide detection devices were unavailable in 1981; anchoring [PRODUCT_A] from the bow rather than the side so wind currents would blow away from the stern; or creating flow-through ventilation before sleeping. The expert conceded that [COMPANY_A]'s manual contained none of those instructions or warnings, but testified that no death-causing incident of that type had been reported for the particular [PRODUCT_A] model involved.
neutral_ko: 1991년 5월, [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_E]는 판매점에서 중고 [PRODUCT_A]를 구입했다. [PRODUCT_A]에는 가솔린 추진 엔진 외에도 [PRODUCT_C]를 포함한 부속 장치에 동력을 공급하는 소형 [PRODUCT_B]가 들어 있었다. 1993년 5월 29일, [LOCATION_A]에서 주말 항해를 하던 중 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 해변 옆에 [PRODUCT_A]를 계류하고 그 선실에서 잠들었으며, [PRODUCT_C]에 동력을 공급하기 위해 [PRODUCT_B]를 작동시킨 채로 두었다. 다음 날 아침, 해변에 머물고 있던 친구 [PERSON_F]는 선실 문을 두드렸으나 응답을 받지 못했다. 그날 오후 늦게 [PERSON_F]는 [PRODUCT_A]에 올라 [PERSON_A]가 사망해 있고 [PERSON_B]가 간신히 숨을 쉬고 있는 것을 발견했다. [PERSON_F]는 두 차례 확인 당시 엔진이 작동하고 있지 않았다고 증언했으며, 이후 조사에서는 무색무취인 일산화탄소의 원인이 엔진이 아니라 [PRODUCT_B]인 것으로 확인되었다. [LOCATION_A]에서 [PRODUCT_A]로 하룻밤 외출을 하는 동안 일산화탄소 중독으로 [PERSON_A]는 사망했고 [PERSON_B]는 치명적인 부상을 입었다. [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]가 입은 부상은 배기가스가 아니라 [PRODUCT_C]에 동력을 공급하던 [PRODUCT_B]에서 나온 무취·무미의 일산화탄소 가스로 인해 발생했다. 1981년에 이러한 유형의 [PRODUCT_A]가 판매될 때 일산화탄소 중독에 관한 두 가지 경고가 함께 제공되었다. 하나는 발전기 제조업체인 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 작성했고, 다른 하나는 [ORGANIZATION_B]가 작성했다. [COMPANY_A]는 구매자들에게 다른 설명서도 제공했다. 두 경고는 모두 주로 엔진 배기가스로 인한 일산화탄소 노출을 다루었다. [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_E]가 [PRODUCT_A]를 구입할 당시, 판매점의 서비스 관리자 [PERSON_G]와 영업사원 [PERSON_H]는 배기가스와 일산화탄소, 그리고 위험한 가스를 제거하기 위해 [PRODUCT_A]를 환기해야 할 필요성에 대해 이들에게 경고했다. [PERSON_G]와 [PERSON_H]는 창문과 해치를 열어 공기가 통과하는 환기를 시연했고, 주 추진 엔진이 작동할 때는 뒷문을 열어 둬야 한다고 설명했으며, [PERSON_G]는 앞쪽 해치를 닫은 채 엔진을 공회전시키면 일산화탄소가 축적될 수 있다고 말했다. [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], [PERSON_D]는 [PRODUCT_B]에서 일산화탄소가 안전하게 대기 중으로 배출되었지만 바람에 의해 [PRODUCT_A] 안으로 다시 불어 들어와 작은 틈을 통해 승객 선실에 유입되면서 "이동하는 일산화탄소"가 사건을 일으켰다고 주장했다. [COMPANY_A]의 전문가는 이러한 인과관계 설명에 동의했지만, 그 현상은 드물며 일산화탄소가 위험한 수준으로 축적되려면 승객 선실의 환기가 막혀 있어야 한다고 증언했다. 전문가는 세 가지 예방조치를 제시했다. 1981년에는 일산화탄소 감지 장치를 사용할 수 없었으므로 감시자를 배치하는 것, 바람의 흐름이 선미에서 멀어지는 방향으로 불도록 [PRODUCT_A]를 측면이 아니라 선수에서 계류하는 것, 또는 잠들기 전에 공기가 통과하는 환기를 만드는 것이었다. 전문가는 [COMPANY_A]의 설명서에 그러한 지침이나 경고가 전혀 포함되어 있지 않았다는 점을 인정했지만, 관련된 특정 [PRODUCT_A] 모델에서 그러한 유형의 사망을 초래한 사건은 보고된 적이 없다고 증언했다.
text: In May 1991, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_E] purchased a used [PRODUCT_A] from a dealership. In addition to gasoline propulsion engines, [PRODUCT_A] contained a small [PRODUCT_B] that powered its accessories, including the [PRODUCT_C]. On May 29, 1993, during a weekend cruise at [LOCATION_A], [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] secured [PRODUCT_A] alongside a beach, went to sleep in its cabin, and left [PRODUCT_B] running to power [PRODUCT_C]. The next morning, [PERSON_F], a friend staying at the beach, knocked on the cabin door and received no response; later that afternoon, [PERSON_F] boarded [PRODUCT_A] and found [PERSON_A] dead and [PERSON_B] barely breathing. [PERSON_F] testified that the engines were not running during either check, and a subsequent investigation identified [PRODUCT_B], rather than the engines, as the source of the carbon monoxide, which is tasteless and odorless. [PERSON_A] died and [PERSON_B] suffered catastrophic injuries from carbon monoxide poisoning during an overnight outing in [PRODUCT_A] at [LOCATION_A]. The injuries suffered by [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] were caused by odorless and tasteless carbon monoxide fumes from [PRODUCT_B], which powered [PRODUCT_C], rather than by exhaust fumes. Two warnings about carbon monoxide poisoning accompanied the sale of this type of [PRODUCT_A] in 1981: one was written by [ORGANIZATION_A], the generator manufacturer, and the other by [ORGANIZATION_B]. [COMPANY_A] also provided purchasers with other manuals. Both warnings primarily addressed carbon monoxide exposure from engine exhaust. When [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_E] purchased [PRODUCT_A], the dealership service manager, [PERSON_G], and salesperson, [PERSON_H], warned them about exhaust fumes and carbon monoxide and the need to ventilate [PRODUCT_A] to remove hazardous fumes. [PERSON_G] and [PERSON_H] demonstrated flow-through ventilation by opening a window and the hatch, explained that the rear door should remain open when the main propulsion engines were running, and [PERSON_G] stated that idling the engine with the front hatch closed could cause carbon monoxide to accumulate. [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], and [PERSON_D] alleged that "migrating carbon monoxide" caused the incident when carbon monoxide safely exhausted from [PRODUCT_B] into the open air was blown back into [PRODUCT_A] by wind and entered the passenger cabin through small openings. [COMPANY_A]'s expert agreed with this causal explanation but testified that the phenomenon was rare and that ventilation in the passenger cabin had to be obstructed for carbon monoxide to accumulate to dangerous levels. The expert identified three precautions: posting a watch because carbon monoxide detection devices were unavailable in 1981; anchoring [PRODUCT_A] from the bow rather than the side so wind currents would blow away from the stern; or creating flow-through ventilation before sleeping. The expert conceded that [COMPANY_A]'s manual contained none of those instructions or warnings, but testified that no death-causing incident of that type had been reported for the particular [PRODUCT_A] model involved.

neutral_en: On March 26, 1996, [PERSON_C], a laboratory technician employed by [COMPANY_A], drew blood from [PERSON_A]'s left arm for a complete blood count. [PERSON_A] reported excruciating pain when the needle was inserted and returned on April 1 with bruising, pain, and numbness in the left hand, receiving a diagnosis of a left-arm hematoma. Pain and numbness continued on April 8, leading to a vascular consultation and nerve testing. On August 21, 1996, [PERSON_A] underwent nerve-release surgery in the left forearm and carpal-tunnel-release surgery, but symptoms persisted, and by March 1997 the left arm was purplish and cold. In July 1997, [PERSON_A] was diagnosed with complex regional pain syndrome. A clinician for [PERSON_A] said a needle injury to a nerve could have caused the syndrome, while other clinicians said there was no objective sign of such an injury and that the later wrist surgery or another condition could have been the cause.
neutral_ko: 1996년 3월 26일 [COMPANY_A] 소속 검사실 기술자 [PERSON_C]는 전혈구 검사를 위해 [PERSON_A]의 왼팔에서 채혈하였다. [PERSON_A]는 주사침 삽입 때 극심한 통증이 있었다고 말했고, 4월 1일에는 왼손의 멍, 통증과 무감각으로 다시 진료받아 왼팔 혈종 진단을 받았다. 4월 8일에도 통증과 무감각이 계속되어 혈관외과 진료와 신경검사를 받았다. 1996년 8월 21일 왼쪽 전완 신경유리술과 손목터널 유리술을 받았지만 증상이 계속되었고, 1997년 3월에는 왼팔이 자줏빛을 띠고 차가워졌다. 1997년 7월 [PERSON_A]는 복합부위통증증후군 진단을 받았다. [PERSON_A] 측 의료인은 주사침이 신경을 손상시켜 증후군이 발생했을 가능성을 제시한 반면, 다른 의료인들은 주사침 손상의 객관적 징후가 없고 후속 손목수술이나 다른 상태가 원인일 수 있다고 의견을 밝혔다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_B] was a supervisor at [COMPANY_A]'s assembly plant where [PERSON_A] worked. [PERSON_A] alleged that, while she was working in the summer of 1995, [PERSON_B] exposed himself while masturbating and requested that she perform oral sex. [PERSON_A] further claimed that [PERSON_B] repeatedly grabbed, rubbed, and touched his groin, licked his lips, and made sexually related comments. [PERSON_A] had not filed a formal written report of sexual harassment under [COMPANY_A]'s antiharassment policy; she said that she told two first-line supervisors that [PERSON_B] had exposed himself to her and asked them to keep it secret. A psychologist's letters stated that [PERSON_A] continued to feel uncomfortable with [PERSON_B] and that, in the psychologist's view, she was descending into mental illness due to the harassment she perceived from him. [PERSON_B] testified that he had not sexually harassed [PERSON_A] and that her claims were false. [COMPANY_A] presented evidence that [PERSON_A]'s complaints about [PERSON_B] concerned shift changes and overtime disputes and did not mention sexual harassment. [PERSON_A] testified that she told another supervisor about [PERSON_B] and that she also told coworkers about him; one coworker later spoke with labor-relations personnel in October 1998, and another coworker was called to labor relations in 1996 or 1997 to discuss [PERSON_B]. Labor-relations notes dated August 25 and August 28, 1998, described [PERSON_A] as very upset and scared and recorded her report that [PERSON_B] came near her when no one else was present.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 근무하던 [COMPANY_A]의 조립 공장에서 감독자였다. [PERSON_A]는 1995년 여름에 자신이 근무하던 동안 [PERSON_B]가 자위하면서 자신의 성기를 드러냈고 자신에게 구강성교를 하라고 요구했다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 또한 [PERSON_B]가 자신의 사타구니를 반복해서 움켜쥐고 문지르고 만졌으며, 입술을 핥고 성적인 내용의 발언을 했다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]의 직장 내 괴롭힘 방지 정책에 따른 성희롱에 대한 공식 서면 신고를 하지 않았으며, [PERSON_B]가 자신에게 성기를 드러냈다고 두 명의 일선 감독자에게 말하고 그들에게 비밀로 해 달라고 요청했다고 말했다. 한 심리학자가 보낸 편지에는 [PERSON_A]가 계속 [PERSON_B]를 불편하게 느꼈으며, 그 심리학자의 견해로는 [PERSON_A]가 [PERSON_B]에게서 받았다고 인식한 괴롭힘 때문에 정신질환에 빠져들고 있었다고 적혀 있었다. [PERSON_B]는 자신이 [PERSON_A]를 성희롱하지 않았고 [PERSON_A]의 주장은 거짓이었다고 증언했다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_A]가 [PERSON_B]에 대해 제기한 불만이 근무 교대 변경과 초과근무 분쟁에 관한 것이었으며 성희롱을 언급하지 않았다는 증거를 제시했다. [PERSON_A]는 다른 감독자에게 [PERSON_B]에 대해 말했고 동료들에게도 [PERSON_B]에 대해 말했다고 증언했다. 한 동료는 이후 1998년 10월에 노무 담당자와 이야기했으며, 또 다른 동료는 1996년 또는 1997년에 [PERSON_B]에 대해 논의하기 위해 노무 부서로 불려갔다. 1998년 8월 25일 및 8월 28일자로 작성된 노무 관련 기록에는 [PERSON_A]가 매우 속상하고 두려워했다고 기재되어 있었으며, 다른 사람이 없을 때 [PERSON_B]가 자신에게 가까이 왔다는 [PERSON_A]의 보고가 기록되어 있었다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was traveling westbound on [LOCATION_A] and attempted a left turn at a permissive green light to proceed southbound on [LOCATION_B]. At the same time, [ORGANIZATION_A] Officer [PERSON_B] was driving his patrol vehicle eastbound on [LOCATION_A] approaching [LOCATION_B]. The speed limit on [LOCATION_A] was 72.42 km/h, but Officer [PERSON_B] was traveling between 93.34 km/h and 119.09 km/h. Officer [PERSON_B] did not have his police siren or lights activated. [PERSON_A] apparently did not realize how fast Officer [PERSON_B] was approaching and entered the intersection without enough time to clear it. Officer [PERSON_B] slammed on his brakes, but the two cars collided. As a result of the collision, [PERSON_A] suffered multiple internal injuries and trauma to his brain stem. After spending three weeks in a coma, [PERSON_A] died. A blood sample drawn from [PERSON_A] hours after the crash revealed a BAC of .049 percent, and no blood sample was drawn from or tested for alcohol or other substances for Officer [PERSON_B] after the crash. [PERSON_C], individually and as representative of [PERSON_A]’s estate, and [PERSON_A]’s son and two daughters alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] and Officer [PERSON_B]’s conduct resulted in [PERSON_A]’s death. [ORGANIZATION_A] asserted that [PERSON_A]’s injuries were caused by his own conduct, which [ORGANIZATION_A] described as greater than any negligent conduct by Officer [PERSON_B]. The experts disagreed about how far above the speed limit Officer [PERSON_B] was traveling, but all experts agreed that [PERSON_A] would have passed through the intersection with time to spare if Officer [PERSON_B] had been traveling at the posted speed limit.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [LOCATION_A]에서 서쪽 방향으로 이동 중이었으며, 허용 녹색 신호에서 좌회전하여 [LOCATION_B]에서 남쪽 방향으로 진행하려고 했다. 동시에 [ORGANIZATION_A] 소속 경찰관 [PERSON_B]는 [LOCATION_B]에 접근하면서 [LOCATION_A]에서 동쪽 방향으로 순찰차를 운전하고 있었다. [LOCATION_A]의 제한 속도는 72.42 km/h였지만, 경찰관 [PERSON_B]는 93.34 km/h에서 119.09 km/h 사이의 속도로 주행하고 있었다. 경찰관 [PERSON_B]는 경찰 사이렌이나 경광등을 작동시키지 않았다. [PERSON_A]는 경찰관 [PERSON_B]가 얼마나 빠르게 접근하고 있는지 알지 못했던 것으로 보이며, 교차로를 통과할 충분한 시간이 없는 상태에서 교차로에 진입했다. 경찰관 [PERSON_B]는 급제동했지만 두 차량이 충돌했다. 충돌의 결과로 [PERSON_A]는 여러 내부 손상과 뇌간 외상을 입었다. [PERSON_A]는 3주 동안 혼수상태에 있다가 사망했다. 사고 후 몇 시간 뒤 [PERSON_A]에게서 채취한 혈액 샘플에서는 혈중알코올농도(BAC)가 .049 percent로 나타났으며, 사고 후 경찰관 [PERSON_B]에게서는 혈액 샘플이 채취되지 않았고 알코올 또는 기타 물질에 대한 검사도 이루어지지 않았다. [PERSON_C]는 개인 자격으로, 또한 [PERSON_A]의 유산을 대표하는 자격으로, 그리고 [PERSON_A]의 아들과 두 딸은 [ORGANIZATION_A]와 경찰관 [PERSON_B]의 행위로 인해 [PERSON_A]가 사망했다고 주장했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [PERSON_A]의 부상이 자신의 행위로 인해 발생했으며, 그 행위가 경찰관 [PERSON_B]의 어떠한 과실 행위보다도 더 크다고 주장했다. 전문가들은 경찰관 [PERSON_B]가 제한 속도를 얼마나 초과하여 주행하고 있었는지에 대해서는 의견이 달랐지만, 경찰관 [PERSON_B]가 게시된 제한 속도로 주행했다면 [PERSON_A]가 여유 시간을 두고 교차로를 통과했을 것이라는 점에는 모든 전문가가 동의했다.

neutral_en: During preparation for a 1995 trade show, [PERSON_A] worked as a lighting technician supervising installation at an exhibit booth. Employees of [COMPANY_A] assembled a lighting truss, temporarily secured it with nylon straps, and told other workers that the bolts or clamps needed for final stabilization had not yet been installed. Lighting installation nevertheless continued under the supervision of employees from other companies. Immediately after the second light was hung, the truss swayed and collapsed toward [PERSON_A], knocking him face-first from a forklift about four meters to the ground. [PERSON_A] sustained a fractured skull, fractured sinuses, fractures of both wrists and an elbow, and other serious injuries. The parties disputed how much the temporary securing by [COMPANY_A] and the other companies' decision to proceed before final stabilization contributed to the accident.
neutral_ko: 1995년 전시회 준비 중 [PERSON_A]는 조명기사로서 전시 부스 조명 설치를 감독하였다. text: During preparation for a 1995 trade show, [PERSON_A] worked as a lighting technician supervising installation at an exhibit booth. Employees of [COMPANY_A] assembled a lighting truss, temporarily secured it with nylon straps, and told other workers that the bolts or clamps needed for final stabilization had not yet been installed. Lighting installation nevertheless continued under the supervision of employees from other companies. Immediately after the second light was hung, the truss swayed and collapsed toward [PERSON_A], knocking him face-first from a forklift about four meters to the ground. [PERSON_A] sustained a fractured skull, fractured sinuses, fractures of both wrists and an elbow, and other serious injuries. The parties disputed how much the temporary securing by [COMPANY_A] and the other companies' decision to proceed before final stabilization contributed to the accident.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A], a two-month-old child, died while under the care of pediatrician [PERSON_D] and staff members of [COMPANY_A], [PERSON_D]’s employer. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C], the child’s parents, brought [PERSON_A] to [PERSON_D] for multiple visits after his birth and contacted [PERSON_D]’s office seven times during the week before his death. On July 27, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported to [PERSON_D] that [PERSON_A] was taking only about 118 milliliters of formula instead of the customary 177 or 207 milliliters, cried after feedings, and had a slight cough. On July 29, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported to [COMPANY_A]’s telephone service and later to [PERSON_D] that [PERSON_A] had projectile vomiting, had been fussy for five days, and was tired after feeding. [PERSON_D] considered pyloric stenosis and noted that a barium swallow test might be indicated, but did not order the test after later developments discounted that diagnosis. On July 30, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported that [PERSON_A] continued to have a slight cough and had vomited two or three times daily for four or five days. On August 1, they reported that he was fussy, sometimes vomiting, not sleeping, experiencing pain while feeding, and wheezy afterward. [PERSON_D] considered the symptoms consistent with gastroesophageal reflux, prescribed medication for that condition, and immunized [PERSON_A]. On August 2, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported that [PERSON_A]’s formula consumption had dropped to about 89 milliliters, that he was fussy, not sleeping, and screaming as if in pain, that he had wet only two diapers, and that he had a temperature of 38.3°C despite receiving Tylenol every four hours. [PERSON_D] considered the symptoms consistent with reactions to the previous day’s immunizations and possible acid-reflux pain. On August 3, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] took [PERSON_A] to [INSTITUTION_A], where [PERSON_E] found him in severe respiratory distress and confirmed that his heart rate was dangerously low. Despite intubation, ventilation, and other supportive measures, [PERSON_A] died during the early morning of August 4. A postmortem examination established that [PERSON_A]’s death was caused by diffuse acute viral myocarditis, a viral infection of the heart muscle.

[PERSON_D]는 그 증상들이 위식도 역류와 일치한다고 판단하고 해당 질환에 대한 약을 처방했으며 [PERSON_A]에게 예방접종을 했다. 8월 2일, [PERSON_B]와 [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_A]의 분유 섭취량이 약 89밀리리터로 줄었고, 그가 보채며 잠을 자지 못하고 통증이 있는 것처럼 비명을 지르며, 젖은 기저귀가 두 개뿐이고, 4시간마다 타이레놀을 받았음에도 체온이 38.3°C라고 알렸다. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] stopped for gas at a gas station operated by [COMPANY_A] on a snowy evening. The path between the pump and the building was covered in snow and did not appear to have been shoveled or salted. [PERSON_A] testified that she believed there was ice underneath the snow. [PERSON_A] slipped and fell on the snow-covered path and injured herself. [PERSON_B] was shopping with her husband at a grocery store owned by [COMPANY_B]. An employee of [COMPANY_B] strung a thin cable from a checkout counter to a two-tier wire basket in the middle of an adjacent checkout lane to indicate that the lane was closed. The parties disputed the precise placement and height of the cable when [PERSON_B] was injured. [PERSON_B] tripped over the cable, fell, and injured herself.
