neutral_en: On September 10, 1997, [PERSON_A] was driving her car across [PROPERTY_A] on [LOCATION_A] in [ORGANIZATION_B] when her car collided with a [COMPANY_A] train. [PERSON_A] was killed in the collision. According to eyewitness testimony, [PERSON_A] proceeded through the stop sign without yielding. On September 6, 1995, [ORGANIZATION_A] stated that it planned to install signals at [PROPERTY_A] using funds from a federal safety program and advised [PERSON_E] that [ORGANIZATION_B] had to agree to maintain pavement striping and signs. [ORGANIZATION_A] requested a written commitment from [PERSON_E] before proceeding with the steps to obtain approval for the project, and [PERSON_E] responded on September 13, 1995, agreeing to the September 6, 1995 terms. [ORGANIZATION_A] stated that [PROPERTY_A] was not part of the state highway system and that it could not perform maintenance on off-system roadways. [PROPERTY_A] was owned by [ORGANIZATION_B], not [ORGANIZATION_A]. The railroad provided plans and estimates in April 1996, seven months after [ORGANIZATION_A] agreed to upgrade [PROPERTY_A]. Authorization for the project was not obtained until November 4, 1997, two months after [PERSON_A]’s death. An accident-reconstruction expert and a traffic-engineering expert testified that the collision would not have occurred if [PROPERTY_A] had been equipped with signals.
neutral_ko: 1997년 9월 10일, [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_B] 내 [LOCATION_A]에 있는 [PROPERTY_A]를 가로질러 자신의 차를 운전하던 중 [COMPANY_A] 열차와 충돌했다. [PERSON_A]는 그 충돌로 사망했다. 목격자 증언에 따르면, [PERSON_A]는 양보하지 않고 정지 표지판을 지나갔다. 1995년 9월 6일, [ORGANIZATION_A]는 연방 안전 프로그램의 자금을 사용하여 [PROPERTY_A]에 신호기를 설치할 계획이라고 밝혔고, [ORGANIZATION_B]가 노면 차선 표시와 표지판을 유지관리하는 데 동의해야 한다고 [PERSON_E]에게 알렸다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 해당 사업의 승인을 받기 위한 절차를 진행하기 전에 [PERSON_E]에게 서면 약속을 요청했고, [PERSON_E]는 1995년 9월 13일에 1995년 9월 6일의 조건에 동의한다고 답변했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [PROPERTY_A]가 주 고속도로 시스템의 일부가 아니며 자신은 시스템 외 도로를 유지관리할 수 없다고 밝혔다. [PROPERTY_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 아니라 [ORGANIZATION_B]의 소유였다. 철도회사는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 [PROPERTY_A]를 개선하기로 동의한 지 7개월 후인 1996년 4월에 계획서와 견적서를 제공했다. 해당 사업에 대한 승인은 [PERSON_A]의 사망 2개월 후인 1997년 11월 4일까지 얻어지지 않았다. 사고 재구성 전문가와 교통공학 전문가는 [PROPERTY_A]에 신호기가 설치되어 있었다면 그 충돌은 발생하지 않았을 것이라고 증언했다.

neutral_en: On May 15, 2003, [PERSON_A] purchased [VEHICLE_A] from an approved dealer. [PERSON_A] alleged that, on September 8, 2013, while operating [VEHICLE_A], it suffered engine failure resulting in a complete loss of power. [VEHICLE_A] was left inoperable but was eventually repaired. At the time of the incident, [VEHICLE_A] was ten years and three months old and had 85,295 kilometers on it. [PERSON_A] alleged that the breakdown of [VEHICLE_A] was due to failure of the intermediate drive shaft and bearing. According to [PERSON_A], engine repair cost [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] knowingly concealed that [VEHICLE_A] and its engine were defective, could fail prematurely, and were unsuitable for their intended use. [PERSON_A] alleged that faulty design of the intermediate bearing caused the intermediate drive shaft to undergo metal fatigue and deterioration, which led through a chain of events to loss of power in [VEHICLE_A]. [PERSON_A] stated that he had previously received notice of a class action settlement involving engine failure in vehicles like [VEHICLE_A]. neutral_en: At about 12:51 p.m. on January 13, 2000, [PERSON_A] was driving [VEHICLE_A] at about 97 km/h in the left lane of a construction zone. neutral_en: On March 6, 1998, [PERSON_A] gave birth to [PERSON_B] at [INSTITUTION_A]. [PERSON_D] examined [PERSON_B] and authorized his release from the hospital on March 10, 1998. On March 12, 1998, [PERSON_A] contacted [PERSON_D]'s office about [PERSON_B]'s blisters and took him to [PERSON_C]'s office; [PERSON_C] considered a bacterial or viral infection, believed the blisters were probably bacterial, and obtained a tissue culture. [PERSON_C] prescribed [PRODUCT_A] to treat the blisters, instructed [PERSON_A] to return if they worsened, and told her to follow up with [PERSON_D] when he returned from vacation. On March 16, 1998, [PERSON_A] took [PERSON_B] to [PERSON_D] because the blisters had worsened; [PERSON_D] attributed the worsening to a possible allergic reaction to [PRODUCT_A], instructed [PERSON_A] to stop using it, and prescribed a sterile solution. On March 21, 1998, [PERSON_A] took [PERSON_B] to [INSTITUTION_A] after he began suffering seizures at home; tests determined that a herpes virus had caused the seizures and earlier scalp blisters, and treatment was initiated to prevent encephalitis. The condition had progressed too far, and [PERSON_B] sustained permanent brain damage. After [PERSON_B] was diagnosed with herpes encephalitis, [PERSON_A] selected [PERSON_C] as his treating pediatrician. The laboratory results returned on March 15, 1998, indicating a bacterial infection; this result was disputed on the ground that the determination was due to contamination of the tissue culture. The experts testified that no injury occurred to [PERSON_B] between [PERSON_C]'s examination and [PERSON_D]'s examination on March 16, 1998, and that if [PERSON_D] had properly treated him on March 16, encephalitis would not have developed.

[PERSON_A]는 척추뼈 두 개, 갈비뼈 네 개, 손목과 쇄골 골절을 입었고, 손·팔·다리에 중증 장애가 남는 불완전 사지마비 상태가 되었다. [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 음주와 과속을 알면서도 탑승한 행위도 손해 발생에 기여했다고 주장하였다.
text: On July 21, 2002, [PERSON_A] was a passenger in [VEHICLE_A], driven by [PERSON_B]. While intoxicated and speeding, [PERSON_B] drove off the road, and [VEHICLE_A] overturned and rolled several times. At the time of the crash, [PERSON_B]'s blood-alcohol concentration was 0.31 percent and cocaine metabolite was present in his system. [PERSON_A] sustained fractures of two vertebrae, four ribs, a wrist, and a collarbone and was left with incomplete quadriplegia and severe impairment of the hands, arms, and legs. [PERSON_B] alleged that [PERSON_A]'s decision to ride despite knowing about the alcohol use and speeding also contributed to the harm.

neutral_en: On March 23, 1998, [PERSON_B], manager of [COMPANY_A], fired [PERSON_A], who was [COMPANY_A]’s office manager. [PERSON_B] fired [PERSON_A] for insubordinate behavior and for refusal to adhere to management policies. [PERSON_A] claimed that her termination was in retaliation for her complaining about the falsification and lack of records that [COMPANY_A] was required to maintain. [PERSON_A] indicated that her relationship with [PERSON_B] began deteriorating after she began making complaints about records and activities which, in her view, were inaccurate and potentially violated the law. [PERSON_A] described meetings with [PERSON_B] that were terminated without her being allowed to discuss her position. [PERSON_A] testified that the position she had worked years to obtain, and the salary she had received, were gone overnight after her termination. [PERSON_A] had gone to [ORGANIZATION_A]. After her termination, [PERSON_A] watched the paper and kept her eyes open for available work, but had not gone to apply. After her termination, [PERSON_A] started doing stained glass at home, sold a piece, and had some orders. Jobs that [COMPANY_A] claimed were similar to [PERSON_A]’s job were advertised in a local newspaper during approximately the 20 months after her discharge.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] served as the police chief of [INSTITUTION_A] from March 2002 through November 2007. An internal rule allowed payment for unused sick, personal, and vacation leave, while there was a dispute whether several administrators had agreed to forgo payment during a budget shortfall. In early 2004, [PERSON_A] repeatedly told [PERSON_B], an administrator, and a legal adviser that withholding the accrued payment conflicted with the internal rule, and mentioned a possible criminal report. [INSTITUTION_A] eventually made the payment. [PERSON_B] expressed anger about [PERSON_A]'s pursuit of the personal payment and, after reelection in 2007, did not reappoint [PERSON_A]. [PERSON_A] alleged that the repeated reports caused that decision; [PERSON_B] attributed it to dissatisfaction with several aspects of [PERSON_A]'s performance.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 2002년 3월부터 2007년 11월까지 [INSTITUTION_A]의 경찰 책임자로 근무하였다. 내부 규정은 사용하지 않은 병가·개인휴가·연차에 대한 금전 지급을 허용했지만, 예산 부족 때문에 여러 관리자가 지급을 포기하기로 하였다는 논쟁이 있었다. 2004년 초 [PERSON_A]는 미사용 휴가대금이 지급되지 않은 것이 내부 규정에 어긋난다고 [PERSON_B], 행정담당자 및 법률담당자에게 반복하여 알렸고, 형사 보고 가능성도 언급하였다. [INSTITUTION_A]는 결국 그 금액을 지급하였다. [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 개인적 금전 문제를 강하게 제기한 데 불만을 표시했고, 2007년 재선 뒤 [PERSON_A]를 다시 임명하지 않았다. [PERSON_A]는 반복된 보고가 그 결정의 원인이었다고 주장한 반면, [PERSON_B]는 업무수행의 여러 측면에 대한 불만 때문이었다고 말했다.

neutral_en: In February 1993, [PERSON_A] attended a three-week class provided by [ORGANIZATION_A] in which he was instructed regarding how to climb a wooden utility pole using equipment designed for that purpose. At the end of the course, [PERSON_A] purchased from [ORGANIZATION_A] the equipment that he had used during the course. This equipment consisted of a body belt, gaffs, and a pole strap. Shortly after completing the three-week climbing course, [PERSON_A] was hired by [COMPANY_A] as an apprentice linesman. On April 3, 1993, [PERSON_A] was working on a utility pole. While descending the pole, he fell to the ground from a height of approximately 18.3 meters. [PERSON_A] received serious injuries from the fall. At the time of the fall, [PERSON_A] had disconnected his pole strap to maneuver around a \"cross bar\" extending from the pole. The climbing method taught by [ORGANIZATION_A] involved unhooking the pole strap from the \"D\" ring on the body belt, moving past the obstacle, and rehooking the strap around the pole. [PERSON_A] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] supplied inappropriate climbing equipment and failed to provide adequate instructions, education, and warnings regarding pole climbing. [PERSON_A] testified that the manner in which he attempted to negotiate the obstacle was the only method taught to him by [ORGANIZATION_A]. [ORGANIZATION_A] argued that it had no responsibility to instruct [PERSON_A] to use fall arrest equipment. [PERSON_A] alleged that, while descending the utility pole with the equipment in the manner prescribed by [ORGANIZATION_A], he was injured while descending around the cross-arms, and that he would not have fallen but for [ORGANIZATION_A]'s improper instructions. [PERSON_A]'s expert testified that [PERSON_A] should have been instructed to use a second pole strap and that the second strap would have prevented the accident.
neutral_ko: 1993년 2월, [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 제공한 3주 수업에 참석했으며, 그 수업에서 해당 목적을 위해 설계된 장비를 사용하여 목재 전신주를 오르는 방법에 관한 교육을 받았다. 과정이 끝날 때 [PERSON_A]는 과정 중 사용했던 장비를 [ORGANIZATION_A]로부터 구입했다. 이 장비는 안전벨트, 가프 및 전주 스트랩으로 구성되어 있었다. 3주간의 등반 과정을 마친 직후, [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]에 견습 전선공으로 고용되었다. 1993년 4월 3일, [PERSON_A]는 전신주에서 작업하고 있었다. 전신주를 내려오던 중 그는 약 18.3미터 높이에서 지면으로 추락했다. [PERSON_A]는 추락으로 중상을 입었다. 추락 당시 [PERSON_A]는 전신주에서 뻗어 나온 \"크로스 바\"를 돌아 이동하기 위해 전주 스트랩을 분리한 상태였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]가 가르친 등반 방법은 안전벨트의 \"D\" 링에서 전주 스트랩의 고리를 풀고, 장애물을 지나 이동한 다음, 전신주 주위에 스트랩을 다시 거는 것이었다. [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 부적절한 등반 장비를 제공했고 전신주 등반에 관한 적절한 지시, 교육 및 경고를 제공하지 않았다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 자신이 장애물을 통과하려고 시도한 방식이 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 자신에게 가르친 유일한 방법이었다고 증언했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [PERSON_A]에게 추락 방지 장비를 사용하도록 지시할 책임이 없다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 정한 방식으로 장비를 착용하고 전신주를 내려오던 중 크로스암 주위를 내려오다가 부상을 입었으며, [ORGANIZATION_A]의 부적절한 지시가 없었다면 추락하지 않았을 것이라고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]의 전문가는 [PERSON_A]에게 두 번째 전주 스트랩을 사용하도록 지시했어야 하며, 두 번째 스트랩이 사고를 방지했을 것이라고 증언했다.

neutral_en: On July 14, 2011, [PERSON_A] was injured when [PERSON_A]’s vehicle collided with a truck owned by [COMPANY_A] and operated by [PERSON_B]. [PERSON_B] testified that he arrived at a jobsite at [LOCATION_A] to retrieve a [PRODUCT_A] being leased and utilized by [COMPANY_B]. He testified that stacks of bricks and vehicles blocked the main entrance, so he used a construction entrance, where the clearance was partially obstructed by the [PRODUCT_A] and a [VEHICLE_B]. [PERSON_B] stopped his truck while it protruded into the main roadway, exited it, and adjusted the truck’s axle to make a tighter turn into the jobsite and clear the [VEHICLE_B] and [PRODUCT_A]. When [PERSON_B] returned to his truck and continued pulling into the jobsite, [PERSON_A] collided with the truck and sustained serious injuries. [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] entered into a lease agreement for the [PRODUCT_A]. Under the lease agreement, [COMPANY_B] was required to provide free and clear access for delivery and return of the [PRODUCT_A] by standard mobile transport vehicles. There was conflicting testimony about whether the main entrance to the school was blocked. [PERSON_A] suffered a head injury and had no memory of the collision. During testimony, [PERSON_A] offered little resistance to the suggestion that he was distracted at the time of the collision.

[PERSON_B]는 [COMPANY_B]가 임대하여 사용하고 있던 [PRODUCT_A]를 회수하기 위해 [LOCATION_A]의 작업 현장에 도착했다고 증언했다. 그는 벽돌 더미와 차량들이 주 출입구를 막고 있어서 공사 출입구를 이용했으며, 그곳에서는 [PRODUCT_A]와 [VEHICLE_B]로 인해 통과 공간이 일부 막혀 있었다고 증언했다. [PERSON_B]는 자신의 트럭이 주 도로로 돌출된 상태에서 트럭을 멈추고 내린 뒤, 작업 현장으로 더 좁게 회전하여 [VEHICLE_B]와 [PRODUCT_A]를 피할 수 있도록 트럭의 차축을 조정했다. [PERSON_B]가 트럭으로 돌아와 작업 현장 안으로 계속 진입하던 중, [PERSON_A]가 그 트럭과 충돌하여 중상을 입었다. [COMPANY_A]와 [COMPANY_B]는 [PRODUCT_A]에 관한 임대 계약을 체결했다. 임대 계약에 따라 [COMPANY_B]는 일반 이동식 운송 차량이 [PRODUCT_A]를 배송하고 반환할 수 있도록 방해물이 없는 통행로를 제공해야 했다. 학교의 주 출입구가 막혀 있었는지에 관해 증언이 엇갈렸다. [PERSON_A]는 머리 부상을 입었고 충돌에 대한 기억이 없었다. 증언 중 [PERSON_A]는 충돌 당시 자신이 주의가 산만했다는 취지의 제안에 거의 이의를 제기하지 않았다.

neutral_en: In December 1999, [PERSON_A] suffered a fatal accident while driving an off-highway dump truck within the scope of his employment with [COMPANY_A], the general contractor on a construction site owned by [ORGANIZATION_A]. On the afternoon of December 1, 1999, [COMPANY_A] asked [PERSON_A], who usually drove water trucks on the site, to drive a loaded, heavy-duty, off-highway dump truck up a hill on a haul road, even though he had never driven that type of truck on this worksite. Testimony indicated that [PERSON_A] was apprehensive about driving that type of truck but accepted the assignment. [COMPANY_A] constructed temporary unpaved haul roads to transport materials between sections of the project. Testimony indicated that [COMPANY_B] inspectors had authority to act regarding safety violations on haul roads and could stop work if they perceived a dangerous condition. [COMPANY_A] had no contractual relationship with [COMPANY_B], and its contract with [ORGANIZATION_A] assigned [COMPANY_A] responsibility for the safety of its employees on site. [COMPANY_B] contended that [PERSON_A] drove off the road to avoid an oncoming grader despite having sufficient room to pass. [PERSON_B] asserted that the haul road collapsed because instability in the hill caused by coal seams. [PERSON_B] alleged that the haul road should have had flaggers, barricades, or radio contact for truck drivers. She also alleged that [COMPANY_B] failed to require proper construction and maintenance of the haul road and failed to inspect it. neutral_en: [PERSON_B] was driving [VEHICLE_B] when [PERSON_A]’s rented [VEHICLE_A] collided with it; [PERSON_B] died, and her children [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] and their friend [PERSON_E] were injured. [PERSON_A] later stated that he had been given [VEHICLE_C] with instructions to drive to [LOCATION_A] and pick up six people from a parking lot, and that he had been paid to make the trip. By March 21, [PERSON_A] had made one out-and-back trip to [LOCATION_A]. Around noon on March 21, [PERSON_A] brought [VEHICLE_C] to a branch of [COMPANY_A] after it had been driven approximately 12,392 kilometers since [PERSON_F] rented it on March 13; [PERSON_A] reported a bad transmission and requested another vehicle. [PERSON_G], a branch manager for [COMPANY_A], checked the company’s internal computer system, saw [PERSON_A] listed as an additional driver, viewed his unexpired driver’s license, and later attested that [PERSON_A] did not appear impaired, intoxicated, or otherwise unfit to drive. [PERSON_A] attested that he gave [COMPANY_A] personnel no reason to believe that he was under the influence of drugs or alcohol or incapable of driving; [PERSON_G] accepted [VEHICLE_C], provided [VEHICLE_A] to [PERSON_A], and watched him drive away. [PERSON_A] later stated that he ingested cocaine overnight and “rested but he didn’t sleep.” [PERSON_A] stated that he told [PERSON_F] he was tired and that [PERSON_F] told him to continue driving; roughly twenty-four hours after obtaining [VEHICLE_A], [PERSON_A] drove it northward in a southbound lane while [PERSON_B] drove [VEHICLE_B] southward in that lane, and the vehicles collided. The collision killed [PERSON_B], seriously injured [PERSON_C], [PERSON_D], and [PERSON_E], and caused minor injuries to [PERSON_A]. [COMPANY_B] insured supplemental coverage, [COMPANY_C] investigated the collision, and a claims supervisor first denied coverage because [PERSON_A] was not listed as an authorized driver before rescinding that disclaimer and reserving coverage rights.

[COMPANY_A]의 지점장인 [PERSON_G]는 증언에서 회사의 내부 컴퓨터 시스템을 확인하여 [PERSON_A]가 추가 운전자로 기재된 것을 보고, 만료되지 않은 [PERSON_A]의 운전면허증을 확인했으며, 나중에 [PERSON_A]가 판단력이 저하되었거나, 취했거나, 그 밖에 운전하기에 부적합해 보이지 않았다고 증언했다. text: [PERSON_B] was driving [VEHICLE_B] when [PERSON_A]’s rented [VEHICLE_A] collided with it; [PERSON_B] died, and her children [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] and their friend [PERSON_E] were injured. [PERSON_F] rented [VEHICLE_C] from [COMPANY_A], and the rental agreement did not specify that anyone other than [PERSON_F] was permitted to drive it. Under [COMPANY_A]’s rental guidelines, [PERSON_A] did not qualify as an authorized additional driver because he lacked credit and proof of a permanent address; [PERSON_F] nevertheless gave [VEHICLE_C] to [PERSON_A] on March 13 or early the next morning to drive another man to a job opportunity. [PERSON_A] later stated that he had been given [VEHICLE_C] with instructions to drive to [LOCATION_A] and pick up six people from a parking lot, and that he had been paid to make the trip. By March 21, [PERSON_A] had made one out-and-back trip to [LOCATION_A]. Around noon on March 21, [PERSON_A] brought [VEHICLE_C] to a branch of [COMPANY_A] after it had been driven approximately 12,392 kilometers since [PERSON_F] rented it on March 13; [PERSON_A] reported a bad transmission and requested another vehicle. [PERSON_G], a branch manager for [COMPANY_A], checked the company’s internal computer system, saw [PERSON_A] listed as an additional driver, viewed his unexpired driver’s license, and later attested that [PERSON_A] did not appear impaired, intoxicated, or otherwise unfit to drive. [PERSON_A] attested that he gave [COMPANY_A] personnel no reason to believe that he was under the influence of drugs or alcohol or incapable of driving; [PERSON_G] accepted [VEHICLE_C], provided [VEHICLE_A] to [PERSON_A], and watched him drive away. [PERSON_A] later stated that he ingested cocaine overnight and “rested but he didn’t sleep.” [PERSON_A] stated that he told [PERSON_F] he was tired and that [PERSON_F] told him to continue driving; roughly twenty-four hours after obtaining [VEHICLE_A], [PERSON_A] drove it northward in a southbound lane while [PERSON_B] drove [VEHICLE_B] southward in that lane, and the vehicles collided. The collision killed [PERSON_B], seriously injured [PERSON_C], [PERSON_D], and [PERSON_E], and caused minor injuries to [PERSON_A]. [COMPANY_B] insured supplemental coverage, [COMPANY_C] investigated the collision, and a claims supervisor first denied coverage because [PERSON_A] was not listed as an authorized driver before rescinding that disclaimer and reserving coverage rights.

neutral_en: In April 1999, [PERSON_A] purchased a spray bottle of [PRODUCT_A] from [COMPANY_A]. [COMPANY_C], later acquired by [COMPANY_D], packaged and labeled [PRODUCT_A], a spray-on body and hair moisturizer containing eight natural oils. The label warned users not to spray the product near sparks or an open flame, but it did not state that the product could be harmful or fatal if swallowed or that it should be kept out of reach of children. [PERSON_A]'s 11-month-old son, [PERSON_B], was left unattended and obtained the bottle, which had been within his reach. He put an unknown amount of the product into his mouth, and some entered his lungs. He was admitted to a hospital with hydrocarbon ingestion and chemical pneumonitis and died about one month later from multisystem organ failure associated with chemical pneumonitis after hydrocarbon ingestion. [PERSON_A] stated that the bottle had been intact when she last used it earlier that day; when she later saw [PERSON_B] with the bottle, the plastic top and pump actuator were missing, and the plastic base of the pump actuator was cracked. [PERSON_A] also stated that she generally read product labels because she had two small children and kept products she knew to be toxic in locked storage.

[PERSON_A]의 11개월 된 아들 [PERSON_B]는 보호자 없이 있던 중 손이 닿는 곳에 있던 제품 병을 손에 넣었다. [PERSON_B]는 알 수 없는 양의 제품을 입에 넣었고 일부가 폐로 들어갔다. [PERSON_B]는 탄화수소 섭취와 화학성 폐렴으로 병원에 입원했고, 약 한 달 뒤 탄화수소 섭취에 따른 화학성 폐렴과 관련된 다기관 장기부전으로 사망했다. neutral_en: [PERSON_B] had dysphagia, a condition that made swallowing difficult, so a doctor ordered a feeding tube. After the tube was placed, [PERSON_B] was admitted to [ORGANIZATION_A] on March 20, 2014. [ORGANIZATION_A] had a standing order for treating patients with nausea and vomiting. In 2014, [PERSON_B] was a patient at [ORGANIZATION_A], a nursing home. On June 2, 2014, at about 5:00 p.m., [PERSON_C], a registered nurse working for [ORGANIZATION_A], noticed that [PERSON_B] had vomited and consequently did not administer the medication or feeding tube. [PERSON_C] checked [PERSON_B]’s vital signs, monitored him for a period, and notified other nurses. About 90 minutes later, [PERSON_C] found [PERSON_B] hunched over a small tub after another vomiting episode. [ORGANIZATION_A] had a standing order directing staff to administer antinausea medication and to notify the patient’s doctor immediately if the patient had more than one vomiting episode within 24 hours. Pursuant to the standing order, [PERSON_C] administered antinausea medication to [PERSON_B]. About 20 to 30 minutes after [PERSON_B]’s second vomiting episode, [PERSON_C] called a physician pursuant to the standing order. When [PERSON_C] could not reach the physician, he notified his supervisor and then took a 30-minute break. [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B]’s daughter, had been in contact with him throughout the day. After unsuccessfully attempting to have someone sent to [PERSON_B]’s room, [PERSON_A] went to [ORGANIZATION_A] at around 6:45 p.m. and found [PERSON_B] violently shaking and struggling to breathe. After [PERSON_B] was found struggling to breathe, emergency personnel rushed him to the hospital, where he died from hypoxia due to aspiration.

[ORGANIZATION_A]에는 메스꺼움과 구토가 있는 환자를 치료하기 위한 상시 지시가 있었다. 2014년에 [PERSON_B]는 요양원인 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 환자였다. 2014년 6월 2일 오후 약 5시에 [ORGANIZATION_A]에서 근무하는 등록 간호사 [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_B]가 구토한 것을 알아차렸고, 그 결과 약물이나 영양 공급관을 투여하지 않았다. [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_B]의 활력 징후를 확인하고 일정 시간 동안 그를 관찰했으며 다른 간호사들에게 알렸다. 약 90분 후 [PERSON_C]는 또 한 차례 구토가 발생한 뒤 [PERSON_B]가 작은 통 위로 몸을 구부리고 있는 것을 발견했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]에는 환자가 24시간 이내에 한 번을 초과하여 구토하면 직원이 구토 방지 약물을 투여하고 환자의 의사에게 즉시 알리도록 지시하는 상시 지시가 있었다. [PERSON_C]는 그 상시 지시에 따라 [PERSON_B]에게 구토 방지 약물을 투여했다. [PERSON_B]가 두 번째로 구토한 후 약 20~30분 뒤, [PERSON_C]는 상시 지시에 따라 의사에게 전화했다. [PERSON_C]가 의사와 연락할 수 없자 그는 자신의 상급자에게 알린 후 30분간 휴식을 취했다. [PERSON_B]의 딸인 [PERSON_A]는 하루 종일 그와 연락하고 있었다. [PERSON_A]는 누군가를 [PERSON_B]의 방으로 보내 달라고 시도했으나 실패한 후, 오후 약 6시 45분에 [ORGANIZATION_A]로 가서 [PERSON_B]가 심하게 떨며 호흡 곤란을 겪고 있는 것을 발견했다. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was the mother of [PERSON_B] and sought redress individually and on behalf of [PERSON_B]'s half-siblings, [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D]. [PERSON_B] was involved in an ongoing feud with [PERSON_E]. Before the incident, [PERSON_B] had been expelled from [ORGANIZATION_A] and was attending [ORGANIZATION_B]. On December 14, 2009, [PERSON_B] was dropped off behind [ORGANIZATION_A] after classes at [ORGANIZATION_B] had ended and began walking home. [PERSON_F] allegedly instigated a fight between [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_E], and the two then fought on the sidewalk behind [ORGANIZATION_A]. During the altercation, [PERSON_B] was allegedly either pushed by [PERSON_E] or fell from the sidewalk, and was struck by an oncoming [ORGANIZATION_C] driven by [PERSON_G]. [PERSON_B] died from the injuries allegedly caused by being struck by the bus. The alleged push or fall from the sidewalk placed [PERSON_B] in the path of the oncoming bus, which allegedly struck her and caused the injuries from which she died. The bus carrying [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] stopped, and they were forced to exit it and saw [PERSON_B]'s injured body. It was alleged that no teachers were on duty in or around the bus area of [ORGANIZATION_A] when the accident occurred. It was alleged that [ORGANIZATION_D] personnel failed to supervise the children, failed to respond to the fight promptly, and failed to staff the bus area adequately with teachers or other school employees. It was alleged that [PERSON_G] saw or should have seen the large student gathering and the fight between [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_E], yet continued operating the bus near the crowd without regard for the children's safety. It was alleged that [PERSON_F]'s role in inciting the fight and [PERSON_E]'s alleged push of [PERSON_B], which allegedly caused her to fall, contributed to the resulting harm. It was alleged that [COMPANY_A] issued [ORGANIZATION_D] a liability insurance policy covering [PERSON_G]'s alleged negligent acts.

neutral_en: In February 1992, [PERSON_A] was 42 years old, had worked as a registered nurse for about 20 years, and owned a small business and a home with her husband. According to [PERSON_A]'s deposition testimony, [PERSON_B] presented [PRODUCT_A] as a savings vehicle that could generate approximately [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] at age 65 through monthly payments of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], and said that life insurance was part of the plan. After [PERSON_A] expressed interest, [PERSON_B] had her complete and sign an application for life insurance; the following month, [PERSON_A] received [PRODUCT_B] from [COMPANY_A]. [PRODUCT_B] was identified as a whole life policy with a face amount of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], life insurance payable at the insured's death, premiums payable for a stated period, and annual dividends. [PRODUCT_B] stated a guaranteed cash value at age 65 of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] based on a 4% annual guaranteed interest rate. [PERSON_A] looked only at [PRODUCT_B]'s cover sheet, paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] in premiums to [COMPANY_A], stopped making payments in 1994 after becoming concerned that she had purchased life insurance, and [PRODUCT_B] lapsed. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] and [PERSON_B] marketed [PRODUCT_B] as a savings or investment vehicle rather than as life insurance. [PERSON_A] alleged that she purchased unwanted life insurance and did not obtain the retirement product she needed. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] and [PERSON_B]'s misrepresentations caused her to purchase unwanted life insurance and prevented her from obtaining the retirement product she needed. [PERSON_A] asserted that [PERSON_B] told her that the [COMPANY_A] product she was purchasing included a life insurance component.

[PERSON_A] later reported physical and psychological symptoms, loss of income, and a need for long-term treatment and care. [INSTITUTION_A] did not dispute the shelf incident but disputed whether the later symptoms and the asserted scope of future care resulted from it.

neutral_en: [PERSON_B] took a prescription for [PRODUCT_A] to be refilled at [COMPANY_A] for his wife, [PERSON_A], who was taking the medication on her physician's orders to control symptoms of restless leg syndrome. [PERSON_C] was allegedly an employee of [COMPANY_A], allegedly was not a licensed pharmacist, and allegedly was not acting under a pharmacist's supervision. On November 13, 2000, [PERSON_A] took one [PRODUCT_A] tablet in the afternoon and two in the early evening. [PERSON_A] became dizzy, agitated, and nauseated in the evening and lost consciousness during the night. At the emergency room, [PERSON_A]'s symptoms were determined to be an adverse reaction to the excessive dosage of [PRODUCT_A]. It was alleged that [COMPANY_A] failed to timely recognize the dispensing error. The alleged dispensing occurred without the supervision of a pharmacist.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] operated a timber-removal business, and [PERSON_A] was employed by [COMPANY_A] as a timber cutter. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] were [PERSON_A]’s parents and co-administrators of his estate. On December 2, 2003, [PERSON_A] cut a large maple tree, then cut a hickory tree approximately 38.1 centimeters in diameter that became lodged about 6.1 meters above the ground, and then cut a third tree, a hickory approximately 45.7 centimeters in diameter that also became lodged. After cutting the third tree, [PERSON_A] walked back toward the first tree under the butt end of the lodged hickory. The lodged hickory broke loose and fell, striking [PERSON_A] on the head. The head injury [PERSON_A] sustained was fatal. After the fatal injury, [ORGANIZATION_A] inspected the workplace and issued eleven citations, including one concerning employee training. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that [COMPANY_A]’s workplace practices were supported by numerous citations issued after [PERSON_A]’s death. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that [COMPANY_A] could not produce records showing what training [PERSON_A] had received, and that [PERSON_D] described only his general training of employees rather than [PERSON_A]’s specific training. [PERSON_G] testified that [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_F] had not been properly trained and that supervision had been inadequate. [PERSON_G] testified that [PERSON_A]’s failure to stop after a tree became lodged, and [PERSON_F]’s failure to stop [PERSON_A], formed part of his opinion that [PERSON_A] had been inadequately trained. [COMPANY_A] characterized the unsafe condition as the lodged hickory and [PERSON_A]’s decision to walk beneath it. [PERSON_D] testified that he worked beside each timber cutter he hired for two weeks to review work practices; [PERSON_E] testified that he saw [PERSON_D] train all timber cutters [COMPANY_A] had employed; and [PERSON_F] testified that [PERSON_D] had trained him.

text: [COMPANY_A] operated a timber-removal business, and [PERSON_A] was employed by [COMPANY_A] as a timber cutter. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] were [PERSON_A]’s parents and co-administrators of his estate. On December 2, 2003, [PERSON_A] cut a large maple tree, then cut a hickory tree approximately 38.1 centimeters in diameter that became lodged about 6.1 meters above the ground, and then cut a third tree, a hickory approximately 45.7 centimeters in diameter that also became lodged. After cutting the third tree, [PERSON_A] walked back toward the first tree under the butt end of the lodged hickory. The lodged hickory broke loose and fell, striking [PERSON_A] on the head. The head injury [PERSON_A] sustained was fatal. After the fatal injury, [ORGANIZATION_A] inspected the workplace and issued eleven citations, including one concerning employee training. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that [COMPANY_A]’s workplace practices were supported by numerous citations issued after [PERSON_A]’s death. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that [COMPANY_A] could not produce records showing what training [PERSON_A] had received, and that [PERSON_D] described only his general training of employees rather than [PERSON_A]’s specific training. [PERSON_G] testified that [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_F] had not been properly trained and that supervision had been inadequate. [PERSON_G] testified that [PERSON_A]’s failure to stop after a tree became lodged, and [PERSON_F]’s failure to stop [PERSON_A], formed part of his opinion that [PERSON_A] had been inadequately trained. [COMPANY_A] characterized the unsafe condition as the lodged hickory and [PERSON_A]’s decision to walk beneath it. [PERSON_D] testified that he worked beside each timber cutter he hired for two weeks to review work practices; [PERSON_E] testified that he saw [PERSON_D] train all timber cutters [COMPANY_A] had employed; and [PERSON_F] testified that [PERSON_D] had trained him.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] were spouses. [PERSON_A] ate several [PRODUCT_A] that [COMPANY_A] designed, manufactured, and sold. After eating the [PRODUCT_A], [PERSON_A] felt as though chips had lodged in his throat and sought emergency hospital care. Medical procedures showed that [PERSON_A] suffered an esophageal tear resulting in serious physical injuries. The [PRODUCT_A] that [PERSON_A] had eaten allegedly caused the esophageal tear. [PERSON_C] opined that [COMPANY_A] failed to warn about the dangers of eating [PRODUCT_A]. [PERSON_C] tested the compressive strength of dry [PRODUCT_A] by pressing each chip's triangular tip onto a padded platform scale until the chip snapped. [PERSON_C] tested how long saliva took to soften [PRODUCT_A] by holding chips in his mouth for 15, 30, 45, and 60 seconds. [PERSON_C] opined that the uneven and dangerous characteristics of [PRODUCT_A] caused [PERSON_A]'s esophageal tear and resulting injuries. [PERSON_D] opined that the [PRODUCT_A] [PERSON_A] ate lacerated his esophagus while passing to his stomach and that the laceration caused [PERSON_A]'s injuries. [COMPANY_A] alleged that [PERSON_A] had not produced sufficient evidence that [PRODUCT_A] had a defect, was improperly designed or manufactured, or caused [PERSON_A]'s esophagus to tear, and that expert testimony was necessary to prove those matters. [COMPANY_A]'s expert, Martin R. Okos, questioned the validity of [PERSON_C]'s tests and the accuracy of his results.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 배우자였다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]가 설계하고 제조하여 판매한 [PRODUCT_A]를 여러 개 먹었다. [PERSON_C]는 [COMPANY_A]가 [PRODUCT_A]를 먹는 것의 위험성을 경고하지 않았다고 의견을 제시했다. [PERSON_C]는 각각의 마른 [PRODUCT_A] 칩의 삼각형 끝부분을 완충된 플랫폼 저울에 칩이 부러질 때까지 눌러 압축 강도를 시험했다. [PERSON_C]는 칩을 입안에 15초, 30초, 45초, 60초 동안 넣어 두어 침이 [PRODUCT_A]를 부드럽게 만드는 데 얼마나 걸리는지 시험했다. [PERSON_C]는 [PRODUCT_A]의 고르지 않고 위험한 특성이 [PERSON_A]의 식도 파열과 그로 인한 부상을 일으켰다고 의견을 제시했다. [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]가 먹은 [PRODUCT_A]가 위로 지나가는 동안 [PERSON_A]의 식도를 찢었고, 그 열상으로 인해 [PERSON_A]가 부상을 입었다고 의견을 제시했다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_A]가 [PRODUCT_A]에 결함이 있었거나 부적절하게 설계 또는 제조되었거나 [PERSON_A]의 식도를 찢게 했다는 점을 입증할 충분한 증거를 제출하지 않았으며, 그러한 사항을 입증하려면 전문가의 증언이 필요하다고 주장했다. [COMPANY_A]의 전문가인 Martin R. Okos는 [PERSON_C]의 시험의 타당성과 그 결과의 정확성에 의문을 제기했다.

neutral_en: The parents of five-year-old [PERSON_A] held a birthday party at [COMPANY_A], an indoor play facility with inflatable equipment. Before the party, [PERSON_B], the child's father, signed a risk-notice and release form as a parent, with [PERSON_A] listed as the participant. During the party, [PERSON_A] jumped from a slide and broke one leg. The form stated that participation carried risks including bodily injury, and [COMPANY_A] said [PERSON_B] knew and accepted those risks. [PERSON_A]'s side disputed that the form eliminated the facility's responsibility to protect a young participant.
neutral_ko: 다섯 살인 [PERSON_A]의 부모는 공기주입식 놀이기구가 있는 실내 놀이시설 [COMPANY_A]에서 생일파티를 열었다. 파티 전 아버지 [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]를 참가자로 적은 위험고지·면제 양식에 부모 자격으로 서명하였다. 파티 중 [PERSON_A]가 미끄럼틀에서 뛰어내리다 한쪽 다리가 부러졌다. 양식에는 놀이 참여에 신체 상해 등의 위험이 수반된다고 적혀 있었고, [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_B]가 그 위험을 알고 동의했다고 주장하였다. [PERSON_A] 측은 어린 참가자의 안전을 확보할 책임까지 사라진 것은 아니라고 다투었다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] is the child of [PERSON_B], and [COMPANY_A], [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], [PERSON_C], and [PERSON_D] were involved in the events surrounding [PERSON_A]’s birth. [PERSON_B] received prenatal care from [COMPANY_C], whose obstetricians included [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D]. [PERSON_B] was primarily attended by [PERSON_C] during [PERSON_A]’s delivery. [PERSON_B]’s amniotic and chorionic membranes ruptured at approximately 5:30 a.m. on July 16, 1980, and she was admitted to [COMPANY_A] within 30 minutes. A resident doctor noted that [PERSON_A]’s fetal heart tones were within a normal range. [PERSON_C] gave a single order for Pitocin that, according to [PERSON_G]’s testimony, was filled twice: once through the 5% Ringer’s lactate solution and once through a D5W solution. Medical records indicated that [PERSON_B] inadvertently received two doses of Pitocin, with the first administered shortly after 11:00 a.m. on [PERSON_C]’s order. [PERSON_A] has cerebral palsy, mental retardation, and other neurological and physical ailments. [PERSON_G] testified that excessive and severe contractions reduced the flow of oxygenated blood to [PERSON_A] by compressing the umbilical cord and reducing oxygenation periods between contractions, resulting in hypoxia and related heart-rate decelerations. According to [PERSON_H]’s testimony, [PERSON_A] suffered trauma when successive, high-pressure uterine contractions pounded or ground his head into the pelvic rim, causing marked heart-rate decelerations; [PERSON_H] also testified that the described events would not have occurred without Pitocin.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [PERSON_B]의 자녀이며, [COMPANY_A], [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], [PERSON_C], 및 [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]의 출생을 둘러싼 사건에 관여했다. [PERSON_B]는 [COMPANY_C]에서 산전 관리를 받았으며, 그곳의 산과 의사에는 [PERSON_C]와 [PERSON_D]가 포함되어 있었다. [PERSON_A]의 분만 중에는 주로 [PERSON_C]가 [PERSON_B]를 진료했다. [PERSON_B]의 양막과 융모막은 1980년 7월 16일 오전 5시 30분경 파열되었고, [PERSON_B]는 30분 이내에 [COMPANY_A]에 입원했다. 레지던트 의사는 [PERSON_A]의 태아 심박음이 정상 범위 내에 있었다고 기록했다. [PERSON_C]는 피토신을 한 번만 처방했으나, [PERSON_G]의 증언에 따르면 그 처방은 두 번 조제되었다. 한 번은 5% 링거 젖산 용액을 통해, 또 한 번은 D5W 용액을 통해 조제되었다. 의료 기록에는 [PERSON_B]가 의도하지 않게 피토신을 두 차례 투여받았으며, 첫 번째 투여는 [PERSON_C]의 처방에 따라 오전 11시 직후에 이루어졌다고 기재되어 있었다. [PERSON_A]는 뇌성마비, 정신지체 및 기타 신경학적·신체적 질환을 앓고 있다. [PERSON_G]는 과도하고 심한 수축이 탯줄을 압박하고 수축 사이의 산소 공급 기간을 줄여 [PERSON_A]에게 산소가 공급된 혈액의 흐름을 감소시켰으며, 그 결과 저산소증과 이에 따른 심박수 감속이 발생했다고 증언했다. [PERSON_H]의 증언에 따르면, 연속적인 고압 자궁 수축이 [PERSON_A]의 머리를 골반 가장자리에 두드리거나 짓눌러 현저한 심박수 감속을 일으켰을 때 [PERSON_A]는 외상을 입었다고 한다. [PERSON_H]는 또한 피토신이 없었다면 기술된 사건들은 발생하지 않았을 것이라고 증언했다.

neutral_en: Before 1997, [COMPANY_A], a corporation with its principal place of business in [LOCATION_A], owned all of the stock of three health maintenance organizations. The three subsidiary HMOs were [ORGANIZATION_A], [ORGANIZATION_B], and [ORGANIZATION_C]. In 1997, [COMPANY_B] acquired [COMPANY_A]. After the change of ownership was approved, on the following business day, [COMPANY_B] used its authority over the bank accounts to transfer funds from [ORGANIZATION_A], [ORGANIZATION_B], and [ORGANIZATION_C] to itself. After the sale, [ORGANIZATION_A] had equity below the required minimum amount. After the transfer of funds, none of the three HMOs again met the applicable regulatory or statutory financial requirements. After the sale, the transfer of [COMPANY_B]’s reserves for future health care costs was followed by cash-flow difficulties at the three HMOs, which were still losing money. The regulatory approvals for the ownership change were coordinated to occur on the same day, and the ownership change of [ORGANIZATION_C] from [COMPANY_B] to [COMPANY_C] was approved on April 30, 1999. [PERSON_A] warned [COMPANY_B]’s representative and other recipients that regulators were increasingly concerned about the large intercompany payables recorded by the HMOs, and later requested an immediate infusion of cash and capital to continue operations.

[PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_B]의 대표자와 다른 수령인들에게 규제기관들이 HMO에 기록된 큰 규모의 관계회사 간 미지급금에 대해 점점 더 우려하고 있다고 경고했으며, 이후 운영을 계속하기 위해 현금과 자본을 즉시 투입해 달라고 요청했다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a nine-year-old student at [ORGANIZATION_A] when he participated in a relay race during gym class. During the relay race, [PERSON_A] tripped and fell into the concrete wall at the end of the gym. The gym wall had no padding and was made of concrete. The impact caused [PERSON_A] to hit and cut his head and lose consciousness; he was later diagnosed with a concussion, missed school for one to two months, and continued to experience headaches and memory problems years later. [PERSON_A]’s fall propelled him into the unpadded concrete wall, which caused the head impact and resulting loss of consciousness. [PERSON_B] alleged that [ORGANIZATION_A] and [ORGANIZATION_B] failed to install padded safety mats to cushion the concrete gym wall. [PERSON_B] alleged that [PERSON_A]’s injuries were caused by the defective and dangerous condition of the gym wall resulting from [ORGANIZATION_A] and [ORGANIZATION_B]’s alleged failure to install safety mats. [ORGANIZATION_B] alleged that the wall had no defect or condition that caused [PERSON_A]’s injury and that the injury instead resulted from a teacher directing students to run toward the wall and from [PERSON_A] tripping and falling. [PERSON_A] testified that he was injured because he was running too fast, tripped, and fell.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 9세 학생으로 체육 수업 중 이어달리기 경주에 참가했다. 이어달리기 경주 중 [PERSON_A]는 발을 헛디뎌 체육관 끝의 콘크리트 벽에 부딪혀 넘어졌다. 체육관 벽에는 완충재가 없었고 콘크리트로 되어 있었다. 충격으로 [PERSON_A]는 머리를 부딪혀 머리에 상처를 입고 의식을 잃었으며, 이후 뇌진탕 진단을 받고 1~2개월 동안 학교에 결석했고, 수년 후에도 계속 두통과 기억력 문제를 겪었다. neutral_en: On March 7, 1996, [PERSON_A] was prescribed 5 mg of [MEDICATION_A] once daily. [PERSON_B] at [PHARMACY_A] incorrectly labeled the medication for a 20 mg daily dose. [PERSON_A]'s parents administered 20 mg on March 9, 10, and 11 and reported that [PERSON_A] became increasingly aggressive and irrational and threatened harm to others and himself. A treating professional confirmed on March 11 that the prescription was for 5 mg, and [PERSON_A] was admitted that day for observation and testing and released the next afternoon. [PHARMACY_A] admitted the labeling error but disputed whether the subsequent behavioral changes and any lasting harm resulted from the excess doses.

neutral_en: On May 29, 1980, [PERSON_A] received a blood transfusion during childbirth at [INSTITUTION_A]. About a decade and a half later, [PERSON_A]'s doctor informed her that she had hepatitis C. [PERSON_A]'s doctor informed her that the most likely cause of her hepatitis C was the 1980 blood transfusion. [PERSON_A] alleged that [INSTITUTION_A] sold and administered defective blood or blood products in 1980. [PERSON_A] also received fibrinogen, another blood product. [PERSON_A] received the additional blood product during the 1980 transfusion. Hepatitis C was not specifically identified until 1989, nine years after the transfusion. The disease-identifying PCR test was not developed until 1993 or 1994, thirteen to fourteen years after the transfusion. The disease takes thirteen to fourteen years to develop symptoms from the date of infection and up to twenty years to develop into Hepatitis C cirrhosis of the liver.

C형 간염은 수혈 후 9년이 지난 1989년까지 구체적으로 식별되지 않았다. 질병을 식별하는 PCR 검사는 수혈 후 13년에서 14년이 지난 1993년 또는 1994년까지 개발되지 않았다. 이 질병은 감염일로부터 증상이 나타나기까지 13년에서 14년이 걸리며, C형 간염성 간경변으로 진행되기까지는 최대 20년이 걸린다.
text: On May 29, 1980, [PERSON_A] received a blood transfusion during childbirth at [INSTITUTION_A]. About a decade and a half later, [PERSON_A]'s doctor informed her that she had hepatitis C. [PERSON_A]'s doctor informed her that the most likely cause of her hepatitis C was the 1980 blood transfusion. [PERSON_A] alleged that [INSTITUTION_A] sold and administered defective blood or blood products in 1980. [PERSON_A] also received fibrinogen, another blood product. [PERSON_A] received the additional blood product during the 1980 transfusion. Hepatitis C was not specifically identified until 1989, nine years after the transfusion. The disease-identifying PCR test was not developed until 1993 or 1994, thirteen to fourteen years after the transfusion. The disease takes thirteen to fourteen years to develop symptoms from the date of infection and up to twenty years to develop into Hepatitis C cirrhosis of the liver.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] were spouses, and [PERSON_A] received chemotherapy treatment from [PERSON_C], members of his staff, and [COMPANY_A]. In July 2005, [PERSON_A] was diagnosed with breast cancer, underwent a mastectomy, and had a catheter surgically placed in her chest wall for the infusion of chemotherapy medications. The catheter could be accessed via needle to inject chemotherapy medications into [PERSON_A]'s subclavian vein, and [PERSON_A] became a patient of [PERSON_C] and his employees, registered nurse [PERSON_D] and nurse practitioners [PERSON_E] and [PERSON_F], for chemotherapy administration. The Fierles alleged that on [PERSON_A]'s third visit to [PERSON_C]'s office, [PERSON_D]'s administration of the chemotherapy medications did not infuse into the catheter but instead infused into [PERSON_A]'s tissue, causing a subcutaneous burn called an "extravasation." [PERSON_A] alleged that she complained of pain but [PERSON_C]'s staff failed to give her medical attention. A day later, [PERSON_A] was referred to a radiologist after a nurse in [PERSON_C]'s office noted redness and swelling of [PERSON_A]'s chest; an ultrasound revealed that the catheter tip was not in the subclavian vein but had coiled in the tissues. Within two weeks of the alleged extravasation, [PERSON_A] sought treatment from another doctor, who referred her to [PERSON_G] for further treatment. [PERSON_G] referred [PERSON_A] to [INSTITUTION_A], where [PERSON_A] was diagnosed with "a severe extravasation of chemotherapy over the right shoulder and subclavian region." The Fierles alleged that [PERSON_D]'s administration of the chemotherapy caused [PERSON_A] to be burned with epirubicin. The Fierles alleged that [PERSON_D]'s administration of the chemotherapy caused "a complete extravasation of chemotherapy drugs resulting in severe pain, burning, and permanent injury" of [PERSON_A]'s skin, including "second-degree internal burns [and] permanent scar tissues."

[PERSON_A]는 자신이 통증을 호소했지만 [PERSON_C]의 직원들이 자신에게 의료적 처치를 하지 않았다고 주장했다. 그 다음 날, [PERSON_C]의 사무실 간호사가 [PERSON_A]의 가슴에 발적과 부종이 있음을 확인한 후 [PERSON_A]는 영상의학과 전문의에게 의뢰되었으며, 초음파 검사에서 카테터 끝이 쇄골하정맥 안에 있지 않고 조직 안에서 말려 있는 것으로 나타났다. 주장된 혈관 외 유출이 발생한 지 2주 이내에 [PERSON_A]는 다른 의사에게 치료를 받으려 했고, 그 의사는 추가 치료를 위해 [PERSON_A]를 [PERSON_G]에게 의뢰했다. [PERSON_G]는 [PERSON_A]를 [INSTITUTION_A]에 의뢰했고, 그곳에서 [PERSON_A]는 "오른쪽 어깨와 쇄골하 부위에 발생한 중증 화학요법 약물의 혈관 외 유출" 진단을 받았다. 피얼스 부부는 [PERSON_D]의 화학요법 투여로 인해 [PERSON_A]가 에피루비신에 의해 화상을 입었다고 주장했다. 피얼스 부부는 [PERSON_D]의 화학요법 투여로 인해 [PERSON_A]의 피부에 "심한 통증, 화상 및 영구적인 손상을 초래한 화학요법 약물의 완전한 혈관 외 유출"이 발생했으며, 여기에는 "2도 내부 화상 [및] 영구적인 흉터 조직"이 포함되었다고 주장했다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was an operating engineer for [COMPANY_A]. [PERSON_B] was his co-worker and followed him in a pickup truck. [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] along the shoulder of [LOCATION_A] to deliver it to another company. [PERSON_A] passed the entrance to [COMPANY_B], continued along the shoulder, and then made a sharp right turn into [COMPANY_C]'s driveway. [VEHICLE_A] tipped to the left during the turn. [VEHICLE_A] fell on top of [PERSON_A], killing him. [PERSON_A]'s wife and children alleged that a 5-10 cm depression in the asphalt caused [VEHICLE_A] to flip over. [PERSON_B] testified that [PERSON_A] traveled on the shoulder at approximately 29–32 km/h, while [VEHICLE_A]'s maximum speed was approximately 32 km/h, and that [PERSON_A] was driving too fast for the sharp turn. A police officer testified that he believed [PERSON_A] was traveling too fast to make the turn, which caused [VEHICLE_A] to overturn, and that the police report did not identify the shoulder's condition as a cause. An expert testified that the driveway was approximately 21 m wide, the paved shoulder was approximately 3 m wide, and the asphalt contained a depression of approximately 5–10 cm. He described [VEHICLE_A] as having a high center of gravity and a tendency to rock front to back when its outriggers were raised. The expert testified that [VEHICLE_A] had no springs or shock absorbers and could overturn at speeds as low as approximately 16 km/h. He believed the shoulder's condition could have caused the front end to bounce and could have increased [PERSON_A]'s steering input during the turn.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_A]의 장비 운전기사였다. [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]의 동료였으며 픽업트럭을 타고 그를 따라갔다. [PERSON_A]는 [VEHICLE_A]를 다른 회사에 인도하기 위해 [LOCATION_A]의 갓길을 따라 운전했다. [PERSON_A]는 [COMPANY_B]의 입구를 지나 갓길을 따라 계속 주행한 후 [COMPANY_C]의 진입로로 급하게 우회전했다. [VEHICLE_A]는 회전 중 왼쪽으로 기울어졌다. [VEHICLE_A]가 [PERSON_A] 위로 넘어져 그가 사망했다. [PERSON_A]의 아내와 자녀들은 아스팔트의 5-10cm 패인 부분 때문에 [VEHICLE_A]가 전복되었다고 주장했다. [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 갓길에서 약 29–32km/h로 이동했으며, [VEHICLE_A]의 최대 속도는 약 32km/h였고, [PERSON_A]가 급회전을 하기에는 너무 빠르게 운전하고 있었다고 증언했다. 한 경찰관은 [PERSON_A]가 회전하기에는 너무 빠르게 이동했고, 그로 인해 [VEHICLE_A]가 전복되었다고 믿었다고 증언했으며, 경찰 보고서는 갓길의 상태를 원인으로 특정하지 않았다고 증언했다. 한 전문가는 진입로의 폭이 약 21m이고, 포장된 갓길의 폭이 약 3m이며, 아스팔트에 약 5–10cm 깊이의 패인 부분이 있었다고 증언했다. 그는 [VEHICLE_A]가 무게중심이 높고 아웃트리거를 올리면 앞뒤로 흔들리는 경향이 있다고 설명했다. 그 전문가는 [VEHICLE_A]에 스프링이나 충격 흡수 장치가 없었고 약 16km/h만큼 낮은 속도에서도 전복될 수 있었다고 증언했다. 그는 갓길의 상태로 인해 앞부분이 튀어 오르고 회전 중 [PERSON_A]의 조향 입력이 증가했을 수 있다고 믿었다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A], age sixty-five, had chronic lung disease, sleep apnea, and carbon-dioxide retention and had recovered during an earlier admission after positive-pressure ventilation and breathing treatments. On September 3, 2010, the same pulmonary condition worsened and [PERSON_A] was admitted to [INSTITUTION_A]; the record noted a prior excessive-sedation reaction to 50 mg of [MEDICATION_A]. Staff first administered 5 mg of [MEDICATION_B] and about two hours later administered 100 mg of [MEDICATION_A]. [PERSON_A] became more confused and agitated, then heavily sedated while lying in wrist restraints, and received another 25 mg of [MEDICATION_A] the next day. Initial testing showed very high blood carbon-dioxide levels, but no follow-up arterial-blood-gas study was ordered and no pulmonary specialist was consulted. Positive-pressure ventilation was not ordered until 10:00 p.m. on September 4. Without fully awakening, [PERSON_A] developed arrhythmia, bradycardia, and cardiac arrest and died at 7:00 a.m. on September 5. The death record identified acute-on-chronic hypercapnic respiratory failure associated with an adverse reaction to [MEDICATION_A].

[PERSON_A]는 더 혼란스럽고 흥분한 뒤 심하게 진정되어 손목을 고정한 채 누워 있었고, 다음 날 [MEDICATION_A] 25mg을 추가로 받았다. 초기 검사에서 혈중 이산화탄소가 매우 높았지만 후속 동맥혈가스 검사는 없었고 호흡 전문의도 참여하지 않았다. 필요한 양압환기 처방은 9월 4일 22시에야 이루어졌다. [PERSON_A]는 완전히 깨어나지 못한 채 9월 5일 부정맥, 서맥과 심정지를 겪고 07시에 사망하였다. 사망기록에는 만성 고탄산혈증성 호흡부전의 악화와 [MEDICATION_A] 부작용이 기재되었다.

text: On March 15, 2008, a multi-vehicle accident occurred. [PERSON_A] sustained injuries and sought redress against [PERSON_B], who was alleged to have caused the accident. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_C], the alleged manufacturer and distributor of [VEHICLE_A], failed to deploy the airbag, and that [COMPANY_A] and [COMPANY_B] failed to preserve [VEHICLE_A] for inspection despite notice that preservation was needed to determine whether defects existed. [PERSON_A] alleged that shortly after the accident, [COMPANY_B], acting as the storage facility or custodian of [PERSON_A]’s vehicle on behalf of or in connection with [COMPANY_A], failed to maintain custody of or preserve the vehicle despite notice that it was to be preserved as evidence for the dispute. [PERSON_A] alleged that the involved entities’ actions impaired his requests for redress, prejudiced his ability to pursue and prove his assertion that the vehicle was defective, and caused the loss of a right and opportunity. [PERSON_A] alleged serious prejudice from the involved entities’ conduct and sought medical expenses, lost wages, and compensation for injuries including pain and suffering, mental anguish, trauma, and disability. [COMPANY_A] paid [PERSON_A] what was owed under the insurance policy and received title to the totaled vehicle. [COMPANY_B] then received the vehicle and disposed of it by auctioning it to a salvage yard for spare parts. The passage states that longer storage by an insurer or auction company could increase costs and that delayed auction proceeds could delay funds used to offset the total-loss payment to the insured.

neutral_en: On September 13, 2011, [PERSON_A] was driving [VEHICLE_A] home from work when a van driven by [PERSON_B] turned across her path at an intersection. [PERSON_A] could not avoid the van, and the impact spun [VEHICLE_A] into a third vehicle. [PERSON_A] received emergency care at the scene and was transported to a hospital, then continued to report neck and back pain, radiating arm pain, and burning sensations. Treatment included orthopedic care, physical therapy, a pain-control device, about thirty chiropractic sessions, and injections, and [PERSON_A] remained off work for a period. Pain and reduced range of motion persisted after she returned to work, and one clinician described the injury as permanent with recurring flare-ups. [PERSON_B] admitted that his driving caused the collision but disputed the extent of [PERSON_A]'s symptoms and losses.

neutral_en: In September 2007, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] purchased a home from [PERSON_E] and [PERSON_F] and obtained a homeowner’s insurance policy for it from [COMPANY_A]. The policy covered [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] and their two minor children, [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D], and included an endorsement covering physical loss to the property caused by mold. The rider obligated [COMPANY_A] to pay the Brunos up to [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] for direct physical loss to the property caused by mold or necessary increased costs. The rider required [COMPANY_A] to pay for testing the air and covered property to determine the presence or level of mold and, if mold was present, to pay for its removal, including tearing out property needed to access it. On October 5, 2007, after [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] moved into the property, [PERSON_A], assisted by a contractor, began renovating the basement and removed part of the wood paneling covering the basement’s block walls. After the paneling was detached, [PERSON_A] discovered two areas of black mold on the block walls near leaking water pipes. [PERSON_A] informed [COMPANY_A] and said he wished to initiate a claim under the homeowner’s policy. [COMPANY_A] sent an adjuster to view the mold, and two days later the adjuster returned with an engineer employed by [COMPANY_B], which [COMPANY_A] had retained to investigate the mold, determine its severity, and assess the extent of remediation required. The adjuster refused payment, stating that he lacked authorization and that no coverage determination had been made. Based on the adjuster’s and engineer’s assurances that the mold was not a health hazard, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] continued living in the property, and [PERSON_A] continued renovating it. During October, [PERSON_A] and a contractor attempted to eradicate the mold and removed additional paneling, revealing more leaking pipes and additional mold. [PERSON_A] informed [COMPANY_A] of the further discoveries. [COMPANY_A] sent the same engineer, who visually inspected the newly discovered mold and performed tests but did not disclose the results. During October, each family member began experiencing respiratory ailments that worsened over the following months. By January 2008, [PERSON_B] had developed severe coughing, difficulty breathing and clearing her throat, and intense headaches. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] then paid for mold testing, which revealed that the mold was toxic and hazardous to human health. In April 2008, [COMPANY_A] paid [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] under the mold endorsement. [PERSON_B] was later diagnosed with throat and esophageal cancer, which her treating physicians attributed to exposure to toxic mold. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] later left the property, which they subsequently demolished because the mold could not be eradicated. [COMPANY_A] retained [COMPANY_B] to provide engineering services to [COMPANY_A] to evaluate mold damage to the property.

neutral_en: On October 29, 2002, [PERSON_A] was 28.4 weeks pregnant. On November 3, 2002, she went to the emergency department of [INSTITUTION_A] with severe abdominal cramping and bleeding. Staff recorded a fetal heart rate of 143, but [INSTITUTION_A] lacked the monitoring and surgical equipment needed for the pregnancy, so a transfer was arranged to [INSTITUTION_B] for higher-level neonatal care. A 5:30 a.m. transfer form stated that material deterioration was not expected, and the fetal heart rate was 170 during transport. No heartbeat was detected immediately after arrival at 6:29 a.m., although later readings ranged from 60 to 144 and from 160 to 180. [PERSON_B] found no heartbeat by ultrasound at 6:55 a.m.; after a scalp electrode recorded 60 to 144 at 7:13 a.m., [PERSON_B] ordered a cesarean delivery at 7:14 a.m. Surgery began at 7:25 a.m., and a stillborn fetus was delivered at 7:33 a.m. [PERSON_A] alleged that delay in [PERSON_B]'s arrival and surgery caused the death; [PERSON_B] disputed this and said the fetus had already deteriorated during transfer and earlier intervention would not have changed the outcome.
neutral_ko: 2002년 10월 29일 임신 28.4주였던 [PERSON_A]는 2002년 11월 3일 심한 복부경련과 출혈로 [INSTITUTION_A] 응급실에 갔다. 의료진은 태아 심박수 143회를 기록했지만 [INSTITUTION_A]에 필요한 감시장비와 수술장비가 없어 더 높은 수준의 신생아 진료가 가능한 [INSTITUTION_B]로 이송하기로 하였다. 05시 30분 이송서에는 상태 악화 가능성이 없다고 기재되었고, 이송 중 태아 심박수는 170회였다. 06시 29분 도착 직후에는 심박동이 잡히지 않았으나 이후 60~144회와 160~180회의 기록이 있었다. neutral_en: The affected people were water users and property owners in [LOCATION_A]. The involved entities included [PERSON_A], the public administration, [ORGANIZATION_B], the public health agency, and formerly appointed managers [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C]. On April 16, 2013, [PERSON_A] authorized a contract to explore an alternative water-delivery system. It was alleged that [PERSON_A] and various public officials knew that [LOCATION_B] would be an interim drinking-water source and knew of a 2011 study cautioning against its use as drinking water. On April 25, 2014, under the direction of [PERSON_B] and [ORGANIZATION_B], [LOCATION_A] switched its water source from [ORGANIZATION_A] to [LOCATION_B], and residents began receiving [LOCATION_B] water from their taps. It was alleged that this occurred despite warnings that the water-treatment plant was not fit to begin operations and despite a study stating that the plant required facility upgrades costing [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. The water-treatment plant’s laboratory and water-quality supervisor warned that the plant was not fit to begin operations. Less than a month after the switch, public officials received complaints about tap-water quality, and in June 2014 residents complained that they were becoming ill after drinking the tap water. On October 13, 2014, [ORGANIZATION_D] discontinued use of [LOCATION_A] water at its [LOCATION_A] plant because of concerns about the water’s corrosive nature. That month, local public officials expressed concern about a legionellosis outbreak and possible links between the outbreak and the switch to [LOCATION_B] water. On February 26, 2015, [ORGANIZATION_C] advised [ORGANIZATION_B] that the water supply contained iron at levels too high for testing instruments to measure exactly. That month, [ORGANIZATION_B] was advised that black sediment in some tap water was lead. During this period, public officials did not take significant remedial measures, advised residents that the tap water was safe to drink, and arranged for state employees to drink water from coolers installed in state buildings. It was alleged that [ORGANIZATION_B] told [ORGANIZATION_C] that [LOCATION_A] was using a corrosion-control additive while knowing that statement was false. affected people also alleged that by early March 2015 public officials knew of a public health emergency involving lead poisoning and Legionella bacteria, concealed the health threats, failed to effectively address them, and publicly stated that the water was safe and that there was no widespread lead leaching despite knowing those statements were false. It was alleged that through the summer and fall of 2015 public officials continued concealing the health emergency, discrediting reports confirming serious lead contamination, concealing information about lead in the water system, and advising the public that the drinking water was safe despite knowing otherwise. A hospital doctor’s findings reflected a spike in the percentage of [LOCATION_A] children with elevated blood lead levels from blood drawn in the second and third quarters of 2014. In early October 2015, [PERSON_A] acknowledged that the water supply was contaminated with dangerous levels of lead, ordered reconnection to [ORGANIZATION_A] on October 8, 2015, and the reconnection occurred on October 16, 2015. It was alleged that although the public entities knew that [LOCATION_B] water was toxic and corrosive, the public entities authorized the local public entities to supply that water to their property. It was alleged that their pipes, service lines, and water heaters were damaged as a result. It was alleged that their property values substantially declined after the water crisis became public knowledge. They also alleged that despite knowing the dangers and serious medical risks associated with switching to [LOCATION_B] water, involved entities made the switch, misled and deceived the public, and concealed information about the water’s toxicity and corrosiveness. It was alleged that using and ingesting [LOCATION_A] water as a result of involved entities’ actions caused personal injuries, including neuropathy, sleepiness, gastrointestinal discomfort, dermatological disorders, hair loss, and other symptoms. They also alleged substantial economic losses from medical expenses and lost wages, and that some residents suffered life-threatening and irreversible bodily injuries. [PERSON_A] testified that [ORGANIZATION_B] repeatedly assured him that the water was safe, and that there was no broad consensus that using [LOCATION_B] as a water source would cause a serious public health crisis.
neutral_ko: 관련 당사자들은 [LOCATION_A]의 물 사용자이자 부동산 소유자였다. 관련 기관에는 [PERSON_A], 공공행정기관, [ORGANIZATION_B], 공중보건기관, 그리고 전직 임명 관리자 [PERSON_B] 및 [PERSON_C]가 포함되었다. 2013년 4월 16일, [PERSON_A]는 대체 물 공급 시스템을 검토하기 위한 계약을 승인했다. 관련 당사자들은 [PERSON_A]와 여러 공공기관 관계자들이 [LOCATION_B]가 임시 식수원이 될 것임을 알고 있었고, 이를 식수로 사용하는 것에 대해 주의를 당부한 2011년 연구도 알고 있었다고 주장했다. 2014년 4월 25일, [PERSON_B]와 [ORGANIZATION_B]의 지시에 따라 [LOCATION_A]는 수원을 [ORGANIZATION_A]에서 [LOCATION_B]로 전환했고, 주민들은 수도꼭지에서 [LOCATION_B]의 물을 받기 시작했다. 관련 당사자들은 수처리 시설이 가동을 시작하기에 적합하지 않다는 경고와 해당 시설에 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]의 비용이 드는 시설 개선이 필요하다고 밝힌 연구에도 불구하고 이러한 일이 발생했다고 주장했다. 수처리 시설의 실험실 및 수질 감독자는 해당 시설이 가동을 시작하기에 적합하지 않다고 경고했다. 전환 후 한 달도 지나지 않아 공공기관 관계자들은 수돗물 수질에 관한 민원을 접수했고, 2014년 6월 주민들은 수돗물을 마신 후 병이 나고 있다고 호소했다. 2014년 10월 13일, [ORGANIZATION_D]는 물의 부식성에 대한 우려 때문에 [LOCATION_A]에 있는 자사 시설에서 [LOCATION_A]의 물 사용을 중단했다. 그달 지역 공공기관 관계자들은 레지오넬라증 발생과 그 발생 및 [LOCATION_B] 물로의 전환 사이의 연관 가능성에 대해 우려를 표명했다. 2015년 2월 26일, [ORGANIZATION_C]는 [ORGANIZATION_B]에 수돗물에 시험 장비가 정확히 측정하기에는 너무 높은 수준의 철이 포함되어 있다고 알렸다. 그달 [ORGANIZATION_B]는 일부 수돗물에 있는 검은 침전물이 납이라는 통보를 받았다. 이 기간 동안 공공기관 관계자들은 중대한 시정 조치를 취하지 않았고, 주민들에게 수돗물이 마시기에 안전하다고 알렸으며, 주 건물에 설치된 냉수기에서 주 직원들이 물을 마시도록 마련했다. 관련 당사자들은 [ORGANIZATION_B]가 그 진술이 거짓임을 알면서도 [ORGANIZATION_C]에 [LOCATION_A]가 부식 방지 첨가제를 사용하고 있다고 말했다고 주장했다. 관련 당사자들은 또한 2015년 3월 초까지 공공기관 관계자들이 납 중독 및 레지오넬라균과 관련된 공중보건 비상사태를 알고 있었고, 보건상의 위협을 은폐했으며, 이를 효과적으로 해결하지 못했고, 그러한 진술이 거짓임을 알면서도 물이 안전하고 광범위한 납 용출이 없다고 공개적으로 말했다고 주장했다. 관련 당사자들은 2015년 여름과 가을 내내 공공기관 관계자들이 보건 비상사태를 계속 은폐하고, 심각한 납 오염을 확인하는 보고서의 신뢰성을 떨어뜨리며, 상수도 시스템의 납에 관한 정보를 은폐하고, 그렇지 않다는 것을 알면서도 대중에게 식수가 안전하다고 알렸다고 주장했다. 한 병원 의사의 소견은 2014년 2분기와 3분기에 채취한 혈액에서 혈중 납 수치가 상승한 [LOCATION_A] 아동의 비율이 급증했음을 보여주었다. 2015년 10월 초, [PERSON_A]는 상수도가 위험한 수준의 납으로 오염되었음을 인정했고, 2015년 10월 8일 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 다시 연결하도록 명령했으며, 재연결은 2015년 10월 16일에 이루어졌다. 관련 당사자들은 공공기관들이 [LOCATION_B]의 물이 유독하고 부식성이 있다는 것을 알고 있었음에도 공공기관들이 지역 기관들에게 해당 물을 자신들의 부동산에 공급하도록 승인했다고 주장했다. 관련 당사자들은 그 결과 자신들의 배관, 급수관 및 온수기가 손상되었다고 주장했다. 관련 당사자들은 물 위기가 대중에게 알려진 후 자신들의 부동산 가치가 크게 하락했다고 주장했다. 또한 관련 당사자들은 관련 기관들이 [LOCATION_B]의 물로 전환하는 것과 관련된 위험과 심각한 의학적 위험을 알고 있었음에도 전환을 진행하고, 대중을 오도하고 기만했으며, 물의 유독성과 부식성에 관한 정보를 은폐했다고 주장했다. 관련 당사자들은 관련 기관들의 행위로 인해 [LOCATION_A]의 물을 사용하고 섭취한 것이 신경병증, 졸림, 위장 불편, 피부 질환, 탈모 및 기타 증상을 포함한 신체 상해를 초래했다고 주장했다. 또한 관련 당사자들은 의료비와 임금 손실로 인해 상당한 경제적 손실을 입었고, 일부 주민들은 생명을 위협하고 되돌릴 수 없는 신체 상해를 입었다고 주장했다. [PERSON_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_B]가 자신에게 물이 안전하다고 거듭 확언했으며, [LOCATION_B]를 수원으로 사용하는 것이 심각한 공중보건 위기를 초래할 것이라는 광범위한 합의는 없었다고 증언했다.

neutral_en: In three of the cases, [GROUP_A] were casino employees, including nonsmokers and former smokers. [GROUP_A] claim that they were exposed to environmental or secondhand [SUBSTANCE_A] at [LOCATION_A]. [GROUP_A] seek medical monitoring to detect whether they have diseases that they attribute to exposure to [SUBSTANCE_A]. [GROUP_A] allege that exposure to [SUBSTANCE_A] resulted in diseases they seek to detect through medical monitoring. Scientific evidence links tobacco use with serious diseases and adverse health outcomes, including cancers, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, coronary heart disease, stroke, intrauterine growth retardation, low-birth-weight babies, and unsuccessful pregnancies. Some members of [GROUP_A] fear that exposure to environmental tobacco smoke, particularly in the workplace, may lead to future ill-health. The length and intensity of exposure to environmental tobacco smoke affect whether the exposure creates a significant increased risk of harm.
neutral_ko: 세 사건에서 [GROUP_A]는 비흡연자와 과거 흡연자를 포함한 카지노 직원들이었다. [GROUP_A]는 [LOCATION_A]에서 환경성 또는 간접 [SUBSTANCE_A]에 노출되었다고 주장한다. [GROUP_A]는 [SUBSTANCE_A]에 대한 노출로 인해 발생했다고 보는 질병이 있는지 확인하기 위해 의료 모니터링을 받고자 한다. [GROUP_A]는 [SUBSTANCE_A]에 대한 노출로 인해 의료 모니터링을 통해 확인하고자 하는 질병이 발생했다고 주장한다. 과학적 증거는 담배 사용이 암, 만성 폐쇄성 폐질환, 관상동맥 심장질환, 뇌졸중, 자궁 내 성장 지연, 저체중 출생아 및 임신 실패를 포함한 심각한 질병과 부정적인 건강 결과와 관련이 있음을 보여준다. [GROUP_A]의 일부 구성원들은 특히 직장에서 환경성 담배 연기에 노출되면 장래에 건강 악화로 이어질 수 있다고 우려한다. 환경성 담배 연기에 대한 노출 기간과 강도는 해당 노출이 위해의 위험을 유의하게 증가시키는지에 영향을 미친다.

neutral_en: [COMPANY_A] manufactures and markets sertraline hydrochloride as the antidepressant [PRODUCT_A], and [COMPANY_C] sells a generic version. It was alleged that after [PERSON_B] took [PRODUCT_A] during pregnancy, [PERSON_A] sustained in-utero injury and resulting birth defects. The 2009 product label did not state that use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of birth defects or that contraception should be used while taking the medication. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] possessed reports suggesting risks from use during pregnancy and included contraception language on packaging sold elsewhere but omitted it from the relevant label. [COMPANY_A] disputed this, noting that [PRODUCT_A] had been approved by [INSTITUTION_A], that the required labeling specifications were followed, and that an association between exposure and the birth defects had not been established.
neutral_ko: [COMPANY_A]는 세르트랄린 염산염을 항우울제 [PRODUCT_A]로 제조·판매하고, [COMPANY_C]는 그 제네릭 제품을 판매한다. [PERSON_B]가 임신 중 [PRODUCT_A]를 복용한 뒤 [PERSON_A]에게 자궁 내 손상과 선천적 결함이 발생했다고 주장되었다. 2009년 제품표시에는 임신 중 사용과 선천적 결함 위험 증가의 관련성이나 복용 중 피임 필요성에 관한 문구가 없었다. text: [COMPANY_A] manufactures and markets sertraline hydrochloride as the antidepressant [PRODUCT_A], and [COMPANY_C] sells a generic version. It was alleged that after [PERSON_B] took [PRODUCT_A] during pregnancy, [PERSON_A] sustained in-utero injury and resulting birth defects. The 2009 product label did not state that use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of birth defects or that contraception should be used while taking the medication. [PERSON_A] alleged that [COMPANY_A] possessed reports suggesting risks from use during pregnancy and included contraception language on packaging sold elsewhere but omitted it from the relevant label. [COMPANY_A] disputed this, noting that [PRODUCT_A] had been approved by [INSTITUTION_A], that the required labeling specifications were followed, and that an association between exposure and the birth defects had not been established.

neutral_en: On September 28, 1989, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], who were spouses, were traveling on [LOCATION_A]. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] encountered standing traffic occupying all four lanes of the highway. [PERSON_A] applied the brakes of [VEHICLE_A] to avoid the stopped traffic, lost control of [VEHICLE_A], and struck the highway's center median. [PERSON_A] died in the accident, and [PERSON_B] suffered serious permanent injuries. The road construction was approximately 4.83 kilometers ahead of the accident site.

neutral_en: [PERSON_A] worked as a groundskeeper and golf course superintendent for nearly forty years. His work involved regularly applying [PRODUCT_GROUP_A], primarily insecticides and fungicides. During this period, [PERSON_A] kept a detailed record of the products used and their application dates. [PERSON_B], a coworker, testified about how [PERSON_A] applied the pesticides, the products and concentrations used, and the protective gear they wore. Initially, they used only gloves; later, they also used overalls, rubber boots, masks, and eventually disposable protective gear. [PERSON_B] explained that, despite the protective gear, [PERSON_A] was exposed to dust from the pesticide products while opening bags and mixing chemicals. On October 5, 2008, [PERSON_A] arrived at an emergency room with fever, chills, and a cough. A bone marrow biopsy resulted in a diagnosis of Acute Myelogenous Leukemia (AML). Cytogenetic testing revealed significant chromosomal aberrations. [PERSON_A] died on February 2, 2009. [PERSON_C] later opined that [PERSON_A]’s extensive exposure to pesticides raised a high degree of suspicion that the exposure played a significant role in the development of [PERSON_A]’s AML. [PERSON_A]’s expert identified studies stating that the active ingredients in the specific pesticides were genotoxic and caused chromosomal abnormalities. The expert further stated that pesticide or benzene exposure causing AML is associated with abnormalities of the fifth and seventh chromosomes, which initiate a carcinogenic process, and that this pattern was identified in [PERSON_A]’s cytogenetic testing. The expert conducted product-specific analyses of each [PRODUCT_GROUP_A], evaluated the chemical components individually, and concluded that each product contained chemicals that were genotoxic or caused DNA damage and were therefore carcinogenic. The expert concluded that exposure to organophosphate pesticide formulations, individually or in combination, was causally related to an increased risk of leukemia in exposed humans.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 거의 40년 동안 코스 관리원 및 골프장 관리자로 일했다. [PERSON_A]의 업무에는 [PRODUCT_GROUP_A], 주로 살충제와 살균제를 정기적으로 살포하는 일이 포함되었다. 이 기간 동안 [PERSON_A]는 사용한 제품과 그 살포 날짜를 상세히 기록했다. 동료인 [PERSON_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 살충제를 어떻게 살포했는지, 사용한 제품과 농도, 그리고 그들이 착용한 보호 장비에 대해 증언했다. 처음에는 그들은 장갑만 사용했지만, 나중에는 작업복, 고무 장화, 마스크, 그리고 결국 일회용 보호 장비도 사용했다. [PERSON_B]는 보호 장비에도 불구하고 [PERSON_A]가 봉지를 열고 화학물질을 혼합하는 동안 살충제 제품에서 나온 먼지에 노출되었다고 설명했다. 2008년 10월 5일, [PERSON_A]는 발열, 오한 및 기침 증상으로 응급실에 도착했다. 골수 생검 결과 급성 골수성 백혈병(AML) 진단을 받았다. 세포유전학적 검사에서 상당한 염색체 이상이 확인되었다. [PERSON_A]는 2009년 2월 2일 사망했다. [PERSON_C]는 나중에 [PERSON_A]의 광범위한 살충제 노출로 인해 그 노출이 [PERSON_A]의 AML 발병에 중요한 역할을 했다는 강한 의심이 제기된다는 의견을 밝혔다. [PERSON_A]의 전문가는 특정 살충제의 유효성분이 유전독성이 있고 염색체 이상을 유발한다고 밝힌 연구들을 제시했다. 전문가는 또한 AML을 유발하는 살충제 또는 벤젠 노출은 제5번 및 제7번 염색체의 이상과 관련되어 있으며, 이러한 이상이 발암 과정을 시작하고, 이 패턴이 [PERSON_A]의 세포유전학적 검사에서 확인되었다고 말했다. 전문가는 각 [PRODUCT_GROUP_A]에 대해 제품별 분석을 실시하고 화학 성분을 개별적으로 평가한 후, 각 제품에 유전독성이 있거나 DNA 손상을 유발하는 화학물질이 포함되어 있으며 따라서 발암성이라고 결론 내렸다. 전문가는 유기인계 살충제 제형에 개별적으로 또는 복합적으로 노출되는 것이 노출된 사람의 백혈병 위험 증가와 인과관계가 있다고 결론 내렸다.

neutral_en: In 1977, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_D] were married and acquired certain real property in [LOCATION_A]. [PERSON_D] employed [PERSON_C] to represent him in divorce proceedings against [PERSON_B]. [PERSON_B] drafted a contract setting forth the division of the marital property. [PERSON_B] relinquished her interest in the property, and [PERSON_D] agreed to will his interest in real property owned in [LOCATION_A] to their children. [PERSON_C] drafted a property settlement agreement that was contrary to the contract, and the divorce was finalized in 1978. In 1993, [PERSON_D] began a romantic relationship with [PERSON_A] that continued until [PERSON_D]'s death on April 27, 2006; [PERSON_D] executed a will naming [PERSON_A] as his sole heir. In 1997, [PERSON_C] gave [PERSON_B] [PERSON_D]'s divorce file, which included a copy of the signed contract. [PERSON_A] asserted that she lost her undivided interest in the property that [PERSON_D] bequeathed to her as a result of [PERSON_C]'s allegedly inadequate professional work. [PERSON_A] alleged that [PERSON_C] failed to include language in the divorce property settlement that modified or nullified the contract.

[PERSON_C]는 해당 계약에 반하는 재산 합의서를 작성했고, 이혼은 1978년에 최종 확정되었다. 1993년에 [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]와 연인 관계를 시작했으며, 그 관계는 2006년 4월 27일 [PERSON_D]가 사망할 때까지 계속되었다. [PERSON_D]는 [PERSON_A]를 [PERSON_D]의 유일한 상속인으로 지정하는 유언장을 작성했다. 1997년에 [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_D]의 이혼 서류철을 [PERSON_B]에게 건넸고, 그 서류철에는 서명된 계약서 사본이 포함되어 있었다. neutral_en: [PERSON_A] was a correctional officer employed for approximately seven years and was a member of a tactical unit trained to respond to inmate riots or disturbances. [PERSON_A] was injured during a training exercise on October 19, 1995, while training with tactical units from other institutions. Five training exercises were conducted that day as simulations to prepare officers for inmate disturbances or riots; [PERSON_A] completed the first two exercises without injury. During the third exercise, called the "angry crowd exercise," [PERSON_A] and his unit role-played as inmates while other units role-played as guards. In prior exercises, batons were wrapped in Styrofoam and officers wore protective pads; during this exercise, unpadded batons were used and officers wore only helmets. [PERSON_A] testified that someone grabbed him and struck his left arm at full force; after he shouted the code word intended to stop the activity, he continued to be struck with unpadded batons. He was later seen in an emergency room, where he complained of pain in his left arm, shoulder, and neck. The tactical-unit commander testified that he knew batons would be used but did not expect full-force strikes; he expected that a participant might get "banged up" or "hurt." He learned of [PERSON_A]'s injury at the end of the last exercise when [PERSON_A] reported being struck in the arm. Medical records documented injuries to [PERSON_A]'s forearm, neck, and/or shoulder. He underwent cervical spine procedures on February 5, 1996, and July 14, 1997, and shoulder surgeries on May 16, 1996, and January 30, 1997. [COMPANY_A] maintained that [PERSON_A] consented to being struck by volunteering for the tactical unit and receiving premium pay. The record states that he had not previously participated in exercises involving full-force strikes or unpadded batons. [PERSON_A] testified that he did not expect a full-force altercation during the exercise and did not expect or consent to being struck with an unpadded baton at full force.
neutral_ko: [PERSON_A]는 약 7년 동안 교정 공무원으로 고용되어 있었으며, 수용자 폭동이나 소요에 대응하도록 훈련받은 전술 부대의 구성원이었다. [PERSON_A]는 1995년 10월 19일 다른 기관의 전술 부대들과 함께 훈련하던 중 훈련에서 부상을 입었다. 그날 수용자 소요나 폭동에 대비해 공무원들을 준비시키기 위한 모의 훈련 5회가 실시되었으며, [PERSON_A]는 처음 2회의 훈련을 부상 없이 마쳤다. "성난 군중 훈련"이라고 불린 세 번째 훈련에서 [PERSON_A]와 그가 속한 부대는 수용자 역할을 했고 다른 부대들은 경비원 역할을 했다. 이전 훈련에서는 곤봉을 스티로폼으로 감싸고 공무원들이 보호 패드를 착용했지만, 이 훈련에서는 패드가 없는 곤봉이 사용되었고 공무원들은 헬멧만 착용했다. [PERSON_A]는 누군가가 자신을 붙잡고 왼팔을 전력을 다해 때렸다고 증언했다. 활동을 중단시키기 위한 암호를 소리쳐 외친 후에도 그는 패드가 없는 곤봉으로 계속 맞았다. 이후 그는 응급실에서 진료를 받았으며, 그곳에서 왼팔, 어깨 및 목의 통증을 호소했다. 전술 부대 지휘관은 곤봉이 사용될 것이라는 점은 알고 있었지만 전력을 다한 타격은 예상하지 못했다고 증언했다. 그는 참가자가 "두들겨 맞거나" "다칠" 수는 있다고 예상했다. 그는 마지막 훈련이 끝날 무렵 [PERSON_A]가 팔을 맞았다고 보고했을 때 [PERSON_A]의 부상 사실을 알게 되었다. 의료 기록에는 [PERSON_A]의 아래팔, 목 및/또는 어깨 부상이 기록되어 있었다. 그는 1996년 2월 5일과 1997년 7월 14일에 경추 시술을 받았고, 1996년 5월 16일과 1997년 1월 30일에 어깨 수술을 받았다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_A]가 전술 부대에 자원하고 추가 수당을 받음으로써 자신이 맞는 것에 동의했다고 주장했다. 기록에는 그가 이전에 전력을 다한 타격이나 패드가 없는 곤봉이 포함된 훈련에 참여한 적이 없다고 기재되어 있다. [PERSON_A]는 훈련 중 전력을 다한 충돌을 예상하지 않았으며, 패드가 없는 곤봉으로 전력을 다해 맞을 것을 예상하거나 이에 동의하지 않았다고 증언했다.

neutral_en: [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] owned and lived on a farm. They were not involved in pruning or cutting the trees on the property. They hired [PERSON_D], an independent contractor, to fell and delimb small poplar trees and clean up tree tops left by a previous logger. [PERSON_D] hired [PERSON_A] to help with the work on [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C]’s property. The parties had not discussed how the felling and delimbing would be performed. Under the arrangement, [PERSON_D] would keep the tree tops for firewood and pay [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] for the poplar he cut. On [PERSON_A]’s first day of work, while he was delimbing trees, he heard someone yelling, turned around, and testified that he saw a tree falling toward him as [PERSON_D] felled it. The falling tree hit [PERSON_A]’s shoulder, then struck logs on the ground; one log spun, struck him in the back, and pinned him between the log and the fallen tree. neutral_en: [COMPANY_B] was a professional consulting engineering firm, [PERSON_B] was its president, and [PERSON_A] had worked for [COMPANY_B] as a professional land surveyor for many years and headed its survey department during the relevant events.
